name: Virata Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM virATanagare mama pUrvapitAmahAH |
aj~nAtavAsamuShitA duryodhanabhayArditAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA tu sa varA.NllabdhvA dharmAddharmabhRRitAM varaH |
gatvAshramaM brAhmaNebhya Achakhyau sarvameva tat
shlokas.3:
kathayitvA tu tatsarvaM brAhmaNebhyo yudhiShThiraH |
araNIsahitaM tasmai brAhmaNAya nyavedayat
shlokas.4:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA dharmaputro mahAmanAH |
saMnivartyAnujAnsarvAniti hovAcha bhArata
shlokas.5:
dvAdashemAni varShANi rAShTrAdviproShitA vayam |
trayodasho.ayaM samprAptaH kRRichChraH paramadurvasaH
shlokas.6:
sa sAdhu kaunteya ito vAsamarjuna rochaya |
yatremA vasatIH sarvA vasemAviditAH paraiH
shlokas.7:
arjuna uvAcha||
tasyaiva varadAnena dharmasya manujAdhipa |
aj~nAtA vichariShyAmo narANAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
kiM tu vAsAya rAShTrANi kIrtayiShyAmi kAnichit |
ramaNIyAni guptAni teShAM ki~nchitsma rochaya
shlokas.9:
santi ramyA janapadA bahvannAH paritaH kurUn |
pA~nchAlAshchedimatsyAshcha shUrasenAH paTachcharAH
dashArNA navarAShTraM cha mallAH shAlvA yugandharAH
shlokas.10:
eteShAM katamo rAjannivAsastava rochate |
vatsyAmo yatra rAjendra sa.nvatsaramimaM vayam
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho yathA sa bhagavAnprabhuH |
abravItsarvabhUteshastattathA na tadanyathA
shlokas.12:
avashyaM tveva vAsArthaM ramaNIyaM shivaM sukham |
saMmantrya sahitaiH sarvairdraShTavyamakutobhayam
shlokas.13:
matsyo virATo balavAnabhirakShetsa pANDavAn |
dharmashIlo vadAnyashcha vRRiddhashcha sumahAdhanaH
shlokas.14:
virATanagare tAta sa.nvatsaramimaM vayam |
kurvantastasya karmANi vihariShyAma bhArata
shlokas.15:
yAni yAni cha karmANi tasya shakShyAmahe vayam |
kartuM yo yatsa tatkarma bravItu kurunandanAH
shlokas.16:
arjuna uvAcha||
naradeva kathaM karma rAShTre tasya kariShyasi |
virATanRRipateH sAdho ra.nsyase kena karmaNA
shlokas.17:
mRRidurvadAnyo hrImA.nshcha dhArmikaH satyavikramaH |
rAja.nstvamApadA kliShTaH kiM kariShyasi pANDava
shlokas.18:
na duHkhamuchitaM ki~nchidrAjanveda yathA janaH |
sa imAmApadaM prApya kathaM ghorAM tariShyasi
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shRRiNudhvaM yatkariShyAmi karma vai kurunandanAH |
virATamanusamprApya rAjAnaM puruSharShabham
shlokas.20:
sabhAstAro bhaviShyAmi tasya rAj~no mahAtmanaH |
ka~Nko nAma dvijo bhUtvA matAkShaH priyadevitA
shlokas.21:
vaiDUryAnkA~nchanAndAntAnphalairjyotIrasaiH saha |
kRRiShNAkShA.NllohitAkShA.nshcha nirvartsyAmi manoramAn
shlokas.22:
AsaM yudhiShThirasyAhaM purA prANasamaH sakhA |
iti vakShyAmi rAjAnaM yadi mAmanuyokShyate
shlokas.23:
ityetadvo mayAkhyAtaM vihariShyAmyahaM yathA |
vRRikodara virATe tvaM ra.nsyase kena karmaNA

shlokas.1:
bhIma uvAcha||
paurogavo bruvANo.ahaM ballavo nAma nAmataH |
upasthAsyAmi rAjAnaM virATamiti me matiH
shlokas.2:
sUpAnasya kariShyAmi kushalo.asmi mahAnase |
kRRitapUrvANi yairasya vya~njanAni sushikShitaiH
tAnapyabhibhaviShyAmi prItiM sa~njanayannaham
shlokas.3:
AhariShyAmi dArUNAM nichayAnmahato.api cha |
tatprekShya vipulaM karma rAjA prIto bhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
dvipA vA balino rAjanvRRiShabhA vA mahAbalAH |
vinigrAhyA yadi mayA nigrahIShyAmi tAnapi
shlokas.5:
ye cha kechinniyotsyanti samAjeShu niyodhakAH |
tAnahaM nihaniShyAmi prItiM tasya vivardhayan
shlokas.6:
na tvetAnyudhyamAnAnvai haniShyAmi katha~nchana |
tathaitAnpAtayiShyAmi yathA yAsyanti na kShayam
shlokas.7:
ArAliko govikartA sUpakartA niyodhakaH |
AsaM yudhiShThirasyAhamiti vakShyAmi pRRichChataH
shlokas.8:
AtmAnamAtmanA rakSha.nshchariShyAmi vishAM pate |
ityetatpratijAnAmi vihariShyAmyahaM yathA
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yamagnirbrAhmaNo bhUtvA samAgachChannRRiNAM varam |
didhakShuH khANDavaM dAvaM dAshArhasahitaM purA
shlokas.10:
mahAbalaM mahAbAhumajitaM kurunandanam |
so.ayaM kiM karma kaunteyaH kariShyati dhana~njayaH
shlokas.11:
yo.ayamAsAdya taM dAvaM tarpayAmAsa pAvakam |
vijityaikarathenendraM hatvA pannagarAkShasAn
shreShThaH pratiyudhAM nAma so.arjunaH kiM kariShyati
shlokas.12:
sUryaH pratapatAM shreShTho dvipadAM brAhmaNo varaH |
AshIviShashcha sarpANAmagnistejasvinAM varaH
shlokas.13:
AyudhAnAM varo varjaH kakudmI cha gavAM varaH |
hradAnAmudadhiH shreShThaH parjanyo varShatAM varaH
shlokas.14:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha nAgAnAM hastiShvairAvato varaH |
putraH priyANAmadhiko bhAryA cha suhRRidAM varA
shlokas.15:
yathaitAni vishiShTAni jAtyAM jAtyAM vRRikodara |
evaM yuvA guDAkeshaH shreShThaH sarvadhanuShmatAm
shlokas.16:
so.ayamindrAdanavaro vAsudevAchcha bhArata |
gANDIvadhanvA shvetAshvo bIbhatsuH kiM kariShyati
shlokas.17:
uShitvA pa~ncha varShANi sahasrAkShasya veshmani |
divyAnyastrANyavAptAni devarUpeNa bhAsvatA
shlokas.18:
yaM manye dvAdashaM rudramAdityAnAM trayodasham |
yasya bAhU samau dIrghau jyAghAtakaThinatvachau
dakShiNe chaiva savye cha gavAmiva vahaH kRRitaH
shlokas.19:
himavAniva shailAnAM samudraH saritAmiva |
tridashAnAM yathA shakro vasUnAmiva havyavAT
shlokas.20:
mRRigANAmiva shArdUlo garuDaH patatAmiva |
varaH saMnahyamAnAnAmarjunaH kiM kariShyati
shlokas.21:
arjuna uvAcha||
pratij~nAM ShaNDhako.asmIti kariShyAmi mahIpate |
jyAghAtau hi mahAntau me sa.nvartuM nRRipa duShkarau
shlokas.22:
karNayoH pratimuchyAhaM kuNDale jvalanopame |
veNIkRRitashirA rAjannAmnA chaiva bRRihannaDA
shlokas.23:
paThannAkhyAyikAM nAma strIbhAvena punaH punaH |
ramayiShye mahIpAlamanyA.nshchAntaHpure janAn
shlokas.24:
gItaM nRRittaM vichitraM cha vAditraM vividhaM tathA |
shikShayiShyAmyahaM rAjanvirATabhavane striyaH
shlokas.25:
prajAnAM samudAchAraM bahu karmakRRitaM vadan |
ChAdayiShyAmi kaunteya mAyayAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThirasya gehe.asmi draupadyAH parichArikA |
uShitAsmIti vakShyAmi pRRiShTo rAj~nA cha bhArata
shlokas.27:
etena vidhinA ChannaH kRRitakena yathA nalaH |
vihariShyAmi rAjendra virATabhavane sukham

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM tvaM nakula kurvANastatra tAta chariShyasi |
sukumArashcha shUrashcha darshanIyaH sukhochitaH
shlokas.2:
nakula uvAcha||
ashvabandho bhaviShyAmi virATanRRipateraham |
granthiko nAma nAmnAhaM karmaitatsupriyaM mama
shlokas.3:
kushalo.asmyashvashikShAyAM tathaivAshvachikitsite |
priyAshcha satataM me.ashvAH kururAja yathA tava
shlokas.4:
ye mAmAmantrayiShyanti virATanagare janAH |
tebhya evaM pravakShyAmi vihariShyAmyahaM yathA
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sahadeva kathaM tasya samIpe vihariShyasi |
kiM vA tvaM tAta kurvANaH prachChanno vichariShyasi
shlokas.6:
sahadeva uvAcha||
gosa~NkhyAtA bhaviShyAmi virATasya mahIpateH |
pratiSheddhA cha dogdhA cha sa~NkhyAne kushalo gavAm
shlokas.7:
tantipAla iti khyAto nAmnA viditamastu te |
nipuNaM cha chariShyAmi vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.8:
ahaM hi bhavatA goShu satataM prakRRitaH purA |
tatra me kaushalaM karma avabuddhaM vishAM pate
shlokas.9:
lakShaNaM charitaM chApi gavAM yachchApi ma~Ngalam |
tatsarvaM me suviditamanyachchApi mahIpate
shlokas.10:
vRRiShabhAnapi jAnAmi rAjanpUjitalakShaNAn |
yeShAM mUtramupAghrAya api vandhyA prasUyate
shlokas.11:
so.ahamevaM chariShyAmi prItiratra hi me sadA |
na cha mAM vetsyati parastatte rochatu pArthiva
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
iyaM tu naH priyA bhAryA prANebhyo.api garIyasI |
mAteva paripAlyA cha pUjyA jyeShTheva cha svasA
shlokas.13:
kena sma karmaNA kRRiShNA draupadI vichariShyati |
na hi ki~nchidvijAnAti karma kartuM yathA striyaH
shlokas.14:
sukumArI cha bAlA cha rAjaputrI yashasvinI |
pativratA mahAbhAgA kathaM nu vichariShyati
shlokas.15:
mAlyagandhAnala~NkArAnvastrANi vividhAni cha |
etAnyevAbhijAnAti yato jAtA hi bhAminI
shlokas.16:
draupadyuvAcha||
sairandhryo.arakShitA loke bhujiShyAH santi bhArata |
naivamanyAH striyo yAnti iti lokasya nishchayaH
shlokas.17:
sAhaM bruvANA sairandhrI kushalA keshakarmaNi |
AtmaguptA chariShyAmi yanmAM tvamanupRRichChasi
shlokas.18:
sudeShNAM pratyupasthAsye rAjabhAryAM yashasvinIm |
sA rakShiShyati mAM prAptAM mA te bhUdduHkhamIdRRisham
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kalyANaM bhAShase kRRiShNe kule jAtA yathA vadet |
na pApamabhijAnAsi sAdhu sAdhvIvrate sthitA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
karmANyuktAni yuShmAbhiryAni tAni kariShyatha |
mama chApi yathAbuddhi ruchitAni vinishchayAt
shlokas.2:
purohito.ayamasmAkamagnihotrANi rakShatu |
sUdapaurogavaiH sArdhaM drupadasya niveshane
shlokas.3:
indrasenamukhAshcheme rathAnAdAya kevalAn |
yAntu dvAravatIM shIghramiti me vartate matiH
shlokas.4:
imAshcha nAryo draupadyAH sarvashaH parichArikAH |
pA~nchAlAneva gachChantu sUdapaurogavaiH saha
shlokas.5:
sarvairapi cha vaktavyaM na praj~nAyanta pANDavAH |
gatA hyasmAnapAkIrya sarve dvaitavanAditi
shlokas.6:
dhaumya uvAcha||
vidite chApi vaktavyaM suhRRidbhiranurAgataH |
ato.ahamapi vakShyAmi hetumAtraM nibodhata
shlokas.7:
hantemAM rAjavasatiM rAjaputrA bravImi vaH |
yathA rAjakulaM prApya charanpreShyo na riShyati
shlokas.8:
durvasaM tveva kauravyA jAnatA rAjaveshmani |
amAnitaiH sumAnArhA aj~nAtaiH parivatsaram
shlokas.9:
diShTadvAro labheddvAraM na cha rAjasu vishvaset |
tadevAsanamanvichChedyatra nAbhiShajetparaH
shlokas.10:
nAsya yAnaM na parya~NkaM na pIThaM na gajaM ratham |
ArohetsaMmato.asmIti sa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.11:
atha yatrainamAsInaM sha~NkeranduShTachAriNaH |
na tatropavishejjAtu sa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.12:
na chAnushiShyedrAjAnamapRRichChantaM kadAchana |
tUShNIM tvenamupAsIta kAle samabhipUjayan
shlokas.13:
asUyanti hi rAjAno janAnanRRitavAdinaH |
tathaiva chAvamanyante mantriNaM vAdinaM mRRiShA
shlokas.14:
naiShAM dAreShu kurvIta maitrIM prAj~naH katha~nchana |
antaHpuracharA ye cha dveShTi yAnahitAshcha ye
shlokas.15:
vidite chAsya kurvIta kAryANi sulaghUnyapi |
evaM vicharato rAj~no na kShatirjAyate kvachit
shlokas.16:
yatnAchchopacharedenamagnivaddevavachcha ha |
anRRitenopachIrNo hi hi.nsyAdenamasa.nshayam
shlokas.17:
yachcha bhartAnuyu~njIta tadevAbhyanuvartayet |
pramAdamavahelAM cha kopaM cha parivarjayet
shlokas.18:
samarthanAsu sarvAsu hitaM cha priyameva cha |
sa.nvarNayettadevAsya priyAdapi hitaM vadet
shlokas.19:
anukUlo bhavechchAsya sarvArtheShu kathAsu cha |
apriyaM chAhitaM yatsyAttadasmai nAnuvarNayet
shlokas.20:
nAhamasya priyo.asmIti matvA seveta paNDitaH |
apramattashcha yattashcha hitaM kuryAtpriyaM cha yat
shlokas.21:
nAsyAniShTAni seveta nAhitaiH saha sa.nvaset |
svasthAnAnna vikampeta sa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.22:
dakShiNaM vAtha vAmaM vA pArshvamAsIta paNDitaH |
rakShiNAM hyAttashastrANAM sthAnaM pashchAdvidhIyate
nityaM vipratiShiddhaM tu purastAdAsanaM mahat
shlokas.23:
na cha sa.ndarshane ki~nchitpravRRiddhamapi sa~njapet |
api hyetaddaridrANAM vyalIkasthAnamuttamam
shlokas.24:
na mRRiShAbhihitaM rAj~no manuShyeShu prakAshayet |
yaM chAsUyanti rAjAnaH puruShaM na vadechcha tam
shlokas.25:
shUro.asmIti na dRRiptaH syAdbuddhimAniti vA punaH |
priyamevAcharanrAj~naH priyo bhavati bhogavAn
shlokas.26:
aishvaryaM prApya duShprApaM priyaM prApya cha rAjataH |
apramatto bhavedrAj~naH priyeShu cha hiteShu cha
shlokas.27:
yasya kopo mahAbAdhaH prasAdashcha mahAphalaH |
kastasya manasApIchChedanarthaM prAj~nasaMmataH
shlokas.28:
na choShThau nirbhujejjAtu na cha vAkyaM samAkShipet |
sadA kShutaM cha vAtaM cha ShThIvanaM chAcharechChanaiH
shlokas.29:
hAsyavastuShu chApyasya vartamAneShu keShuchit |
nAtigADhaM prahRRiShyeta na chApyunmattavaddhaset
shlokas.30:
na chAtidhairyeNa charedgurutAM hi vrajettathA |
smitaM tu mRRidupUrveNa darshayeta prasAdajam
shlokas.31:
lAbhe na harShayedyastu na vyathedyo.avamAnitaH |
asaMmUDhashcha yo nityaM sa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.32:
rAjAnaM rAjaputraM vA sa.nvartayati yaH sadA |
amAtyaH paNDito bhUtvA sa chiraM tiShThati shriyam
shlokas.33:
pragRRihItashcha yo.amAtyo nigRRihItashcha kAraNaiH |
na nirbadhnAti rAjAnaM labhate pragrahaM punaH
shlokas.34:
pratyakShaM cha parokShaM cha guNavAdI vichakShaNaH |
upajIvI bhavedrAj~no viShaye chApi yo vaset
shlokas.35:
amAtyo hi balAdbhoktuM rAjAnaM prArthayettu yaH |
na sa tiShThechchiraM sthAnaM gachChechcha prANasa.nshayam
shlokas.36:
shreyaH sadAtmano dRRiShTvA paraM rAj~nA na sa.nvadet |
visheShayenna rAjAnaM yogyAbhUmiShu sarvadA
shlokas.37:
amlAno balavA~nshUrashChAyevAnapagaH sadA |
satyavAdI mRRidurdAntaH sa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.38:
anyasminpreShyamANe tu purastAdyaH samutpatet |
ahaM kiM karavANIti sa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.39:
uShNe vA yadi vA shIte rAtrau vA yadi vA divA |
AdiShTo na vikalpeta sa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.40:
yo vai gRRihebhyaH pravasanpriyANAM nAnusa.nsmaret |
duHkhena sukhamanvichChetsa rAjavasatiM vaset
shlokas.41:
samaveShaM na kurvIta nAtyuchchaiH saMnidhau haset |
mantraM na bahudhA kuryAdevaM rAj~naH priyo bhavet
shlokas.42:
na karmaNi niyuktaH sandhanaM ki~nchidupaspRRishet |
prApnoti hi harandravyaM bandhanaM yadi vA vadham
shlokas.43:
yAnaM vastramala~NkAraM yachchAnyatsamprayachChati |
tadeva dhArayennityamevaM priyataro bhavet
shlokas.44:
sa.nvatsaramimaM tAta tathAshIlA bubhUShavaH |
atha svaviShayaM prApya yathAkAmaM chariShyatha
shlokas.45:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
anushiShTAH sma bhadraM te naitadvaktAsti kashchana |
kuntImRRite mAtaraM no viduraM cha mahAmatim
shlokas.46:
yadevAnantaraM kAryaM tadbhavAnkartumarhati |
tAraNAyAsya duHkhasya prasthAnAya jayAya cha
shlokas.47:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastato rAj~nA dhaumyo.atha dvijasattamaH |
akarodvidhivatsarvaM prasthAne yadvidhIyate
shlokas.48:
teShAM samidhya tAnagnInmantravachcha juhAva saH |
samRRiddhivRRiddhilAbhAya pRRithivIvijayAya cha
shlokas.49:
agniM pradakShiNaM kRRitvA brAhmaNA.nshcha tapodhanAn |
yAj~nasenIM puraskRRitya ShaDevAtha pravavrajuH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te vIrA baddhanistri.nshAstatAyudhakalApinaH |
baddhagodhA~NgulitrANAH kAlindImabhito yayuH
shlokas.2:
tataste dakShiNaM tIramanvagachChanpadAtayaH |
vasanto giridurgeShu vanadurgeShu dhanvinaH
shlokas.3:
vidhyanto mRRigajAtAni maheShvAsA mahAbalAH |
uttareNa dashArNA.nste pA~nchAlAndakShiNena tu
shlokas.4:
antareNa yakRRillomA~nshUrasenA.nshcha pANDavAH |
lubdhA bruvANA matsyasya viShayaM prAvishanvanAt
shlokas.5:
tato janapadaM prApya kRRiShNA rAjAnamabravIt |
pashyaikapadyo dRRishyante kShetrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.6:
vyaktaM dUre virATasya rAjadhAnI bhaviShyati |
vasAmeha parAM rAtriM balavAnme parishramaH
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dhana~njaya samudyamya pA~nchAlIM vaha bhArata |
rAjadhAnyAM nivatsyAmo vimuktAshcha vanAditaH
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAmAdAyArjunastUrNaM draupadIM gajarADiva |
samprApya nagarAbhyAshamavatArayadarjunaH
shlokas.9:
sa rAjadhAnIM samprApya kaunteyo.arjunamabravIt |
kvAyudhAni samAsajya pravekShyAmaH puraM vayam
shlokas.10:
sAyudhAshcha vayaM tAta pravekShyAmaH puraM yadi |
samudvegaM janasyAsya kariShyAmo na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
tato dvAdasha varShANi praveShTavyaM vanaM punaH |
ekasminnapi vij~nAte pratij~nAtaM hi nastathA
shlokas.12:
arjuna uvAcha||
iyaM kUTe manuShyendra gahanA mahatI shamI |
bhImashAkhA durArohA shmashAnasya samIpataH
shlokas.13:
na chApi vidyate kashchinmanuShya iha pArthiva |
utpathe hi vane jAtA mRRigavyAlaniShevite
shlokas.14:
samAsajyAyudhAnyasyAM gachChAmo nagaraM prati |
evamatra yathAjoShaM vihariShyAma bhArata
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA sa rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
prachakrame nidhAnAya shastrANAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
yena devAnmanuShyA.nshcha sarpA.nshchaikaratho.ajayat |
sphItA~njanapadA.nshchAnyAnajayatkurunandanaH
shlokas.17:
tadudAraM mahAghoShaM sapatnagaNasUdanam |
apajyamakarotpArtho gANDIvamabhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.18:
yena vIraH kurukShetramabhyarakShatparantapaH |
amu~nchaddhanuShastasya jyAmakShayyAM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.19:
pA~nchAlAnyena sa~NgrAme bhImaseno.ajayatprabhuH |
pratyaShedhadbahUnekaH sapatnA.nshchaiva digjaye
shlokas.20:
nishamya yasya visphAraM vyadravanta raNe pare |
parvatasyeva dIrNasya visphoTamashaneriva
shlokas.21:
saindhavaM yena rAjAnaM parAmRRiShata chAnagha |
jyApAshaM dhanuShastasya bhImaseno.avatArayat
shlokas.22:
ajayatpashchimAmAshAM dhanuShA yena pANDavaH |
tasya maurvImapAkarShachChUraH sa~Nkrandano yudhi
shlokas.23:
dakShiNAM dakShiNAchAro dishaM yenAjayatprabhuH |
apajyamakarodvIraH sahadevastadAyudham
shlokas.24:
khaDgA.nshcha pItAndIrghA.nshcha kalApA.nshcha mahAdhanAn |
vipAThAnkShuradhArA.nshcha dhanurbhirnidadhuH saha
shlokas.25:
tAmupAruhya nakulo dhanUMShi nidadhatsvayam |
yAni tasyAvakAshAni dRRiDharUpANyamanyata
shlokas.26:
yatra chApashyata sa vai tiro varShANi varShati |
tatra tAni dRRiDhaiH pAshaiH sugADhaM paryabandhata
shlokas.27:
sharIraM cha mRRitasyaikaM samabadhnanta pANDavAH |
vivarjayiShyanti narA dUrAdeva shamImimAm
AbaddhaM shavamatreti gandhamAghrAya pUtikam
shlokas.28:
ashItishatavarSheyaM mAtA na iti vAdinaH |
kuladharmo.ayamasmAkaM pUrvairAcharito.api cha
samAsajAnA vRRikShe.asminniti vai vyAharanti te
shlokas.29:
A gopAlAvipAlebhya AchakShANAH parantapAH |
AjagmurnagarAbhyAshaM pArthAH shatrunibarhaNAH
shlokas.30:
jayo jayanto vijayo jayatseno jayadbalaH |
iti guhyAni nAmAni chakre teShAM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.31:
tato yathApratij~nAbhiH prAvishannagaraM mahat |
aj~nAtacharyAM vatsyanto rAShTre varShaM trayodasham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato virATaM prathamaM yudhiShThiro; rAjA sabhAyAmupaviShTamAvrajat |
vaiDUryarUpAnpratimuchya kA~nchanA;nakShAnsa kakShe parigRRihya vAsasA
shlokas.2:
narAdhipo rAShTrapatiM yashasvinaM; mahAyashAH kauravava.nshavardhanaH |
mahAnubhAvo nararAjasatkRRito; durAsadastIkShNaviSho yathoragaH
shlokas.3:
bAlena rUpeNa nararShabho mahA;nathArchirUpeNa yathAmarastathA |
mahAbhrajAlairiva sa.nvRRito ravi;ryathAnalo bhasmavRRitashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.4:
tamApatantaM prasamIkShya pANDavaM; virATarADindumivAbhrasa.nvRRitam |
mantridvijAnsUtamukhAnvishastathA; ye chApi kechitpariShatsamAsate
paprachCha ko.ayaM prathamaM sameyivA;nanena yo.ayaM prasamIkShate sabhAm
shlokas.5:
na tu dvijo.ayaM bhavitA narottamaH; patiH pRRithivyA iti me manogatam |
na chAsya dAso na ratho na kuNDale; samIpato bhrAjati chAyamindravat
shlokas.6:
sharIrali~NgairupasUchito hyayaM; mUrdhAbhiShikto.ayamitIva mAnasam |
samIpamAyAti cha me gatavyatho; yathA gajastAmarasIM madotkaTaH
shlokas.7:
vitarkayantaM tu nararShabhastadA; yudhiShThiro.abhyetya virATamabravIt |
samrADvijAnAtviha jIvitArthinaM; vinaShTasarvasvamupAgataM dvijam
shlokas.8:
ihAhamichChAmi tavAnaghAntike; vastuM yathA kAmacharastathA vibho |
tamabravItsvAgatamityanantaraM; rAjA prahRRiShTaH pratisa~NgRRihANa cha
shlokas.9:
kAmena tAtAbhivadAmyahaM tvAM; kasyAsi rAj~no viShayAdihAgataH |
gotraM cha nAmApi cha sha.nsa tattvataH; kiM chApi shilpaM tava vidyate kRRitam
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yudhiShThirasyAsamahaM purA sakhA; vaiyAghrapadyaH punarasmi brAhmaNaH |
akShAnpravaptuM kushalo.asmi devitA; ka~Nketi nAmnAsmi virATa vishrutaH
shlokas.11:
virATa uvAcha||
dadAmi te hanta varaM yamichChasi; prashAdhi matsyAnvashago hyahaM tava |
priyA hi dhUrtA mama devinaH sadA; bhavA.nshcha devopama rAjyamarhati
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
Apto vivAdaH paramo vishAM pate; na vidyate ki~nchana matsya hInataH |
na me jitaH kashchana dhArayeddhanaM; varo mamaiSho.astu tava prasAdataH
shlokas.13:
virATa uvAcha||
hanyAmavadhyaM yadi te.apriyaM chare;tpravrAjayeyaM viShayAddvijA.nstathA |
shRRiNvantu me jAnapadAH samAgatAH; ka~Nko yathAhaM viShaye prabhustathA
shlokas.14:
samAnayAno bhavitAsi me sakhA; prabhUtavastro bahupAnabhojanaH |
pashyestvamantashcha bahishcha sarvadA; kRRitaM cha te dvAramapAvRRitaM mayA
shlokas.15:
ye tvAnuvAdeyuravRRittikarshitA; brUyAshcha teShAM vachanena me sadA |
dAsyAmi sarvaM tadahaM na sa.nshayo; na te bhayaM vidyati saMnidhau mama
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sa labdhvA tu varaM samAgamaM; virATarAjena nararShabhastadA |
uvAsa vIraH paramArchitaH sukhI; na chApi kashchichcharitaM bubodha tat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAparo bhImabalaH shriyA jvala;nnupAyayau siMhavilAsavikramaH |
khajaM cha darvIM cha kareNa dhAraya;nnasiM cha kAlA~NgamakoshamavraNam
shlokas.2:
sa sUdarUpaH parameNa varchasA; raviryathA lokamimaM prabhAsayan |
sukRRiShNavAsA girirAjasAravA;nsa matsyarAjaM samupetya tasthivAn
shlokas.3:
taM prekShya rAjA varayannupAgataM; tato.abravIjjAnapadAnsamAgatAn |
siMhonnatA.nso.ayamatIva rUpavA;npradRRishyate ko nu nararShabho yuvA
shlokas.4:
adRRiShTapUrvaH puruSho raviryathA; vitarkayannAsya labhAmi sampadam |
tathAsya chittaM hyapi sa.nvitarkaya;nnararShabhasyAdya na yAmi tattvataH
shlokas.5:
tato virATaM samupetya pANDavaH; sudInarUpo vachanaM mahAmanAH |
uvAcha sUdo.asmi narendra ballavo; bhajasva mAM vya~njanakAramuttamam
shlokas.6:
virATa uvAcha||
na sUdatAM mAnada shraddadhAmi te; sahasranetrapratimo hi dRRishyase |
shriyA cha rUpeNa cha vikrameNa cha; prabhAsi tAtAnavaro nareShviha
shlokas.7:
bhIma uvAcha||
narendra sUdaH parichArako.asmi te; jAnAmi sUpAnprathamena kevalAn |
AsvAditA ye nRRipate purAbhava;nyudhiShThireNApi nRRipeNa sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
balena tulyashcha na vidyate mayA; niyuddhashIlashcha sadaiva pArthiva |
gajaishcha siMhaishcha sameyivAnahaM; sadA kariShyAmi tavAnagha priyam
shlokas.9:
virATa uvAcha||
dadAmi te hanta varaM mahAnase; tathA cha kuryAH kushalaM hi bhAShase |
na chaiva manye tava karma tatsamaM; samudranemiM pRRithivIM tvamarhasi
shlokas.10:
yathA hi kAmastava tattathA kRRitaM; mahAnase tvaM bhava me puraskRRitaH |
narAshcha ye tatra mamochitAH purA; bhavasva teShAmadhipo mayA kRRitaH
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA sa bhImo vihito mahAnase; virATarAj~no dayito.abhavaddRRiDham |
uvAsa rAjanna cha taM pRRithagjano; bubodha tatrAnucharashcha kashchana

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH keshAnsamutkShipya vellitAgrAnaninditAn |
jugUha dakShiNe pArshve mRRidUnasitalochanA
shlokas.2:
vAsashcha paridhAyaikaM kRRiShNaM sumalinaM mahat |
kRRitvA veShaM cha sairandhryAH kRRiShNA vyacharadArtavat
shlokas.3:
tAM narAH paridhAvantIM striyashcha samupAdravan |
apRRichCha.nshchaiva tAM dRRiShTvA kA tvaM kiM cha chikIrShasi
shlokas.4:
sA tAnuvAcha rAjendra sairandhryahamupAgatA |
karma chechChAmi vai kartuM tasya yo mAM pupukShati
shlokas.5:
tasyA rUpeNa veSheNa shlakShNayA cha tathA girA |
nAshraddadhata tAM dAsImannahetorupasthitAm
shlokas.6:
virATasya tu kaikeyI bhAryA paramasaMmatA |
avalokayantI dadRRishe prAsAdAddrupadAtmajAm
shlokas.7:
sA samIkShya tathArUpAmanAthAmekavAsasam |
samAhUyAbravIdbhadre kA tvaM kiM cha chikIrShasi
shlokas.8:
sA tAmuvAcha rAjendra sairandhryahamupAgatA |
karma chechChAmyahaM kartuM tasya yo mAM pupukShati
shlokas.9:
sudeShNovAcha||
naiva.nrUpA bhavantyevaM yathA vadasi bhAmini |
preShayanti cha vai dAsIrdAsA.nshchaiva.nvidhAnbahUn
shlokas.10:
gUDhagulphA saMhatorustrigambhIrA ShaDunnatA |
raktA pa~nchasu rakteShu ha.nsagadgadabhAShiNI
shlokas.11:
sukeshI sustanI shyAmA pInashroNipayodharA |
tena tenaiva sampannA kAshmIrIva tura~NgamA
shlokas.12:
svarAlapakShmanayanA bimboShThI tanumadhyamA |
kambugrIvA gUDhasirA pUrNachandranibhAnanA
shlokas.13:
kA tvaM brUhi yathA bhadre nAsi dAsI katha~nchana |
yakShI vA yadi vA devI gandharvI yadi vApsarAH
shlokas.14:
alambusA mishrakeshI puNDarIkAtha mAlinI |
indrANI vAruNI vA tvaM tvaShTurdhAtuH prajApateH
devyo deveShu vikhyAtAstAsAM tvaM katamA shubhe
shlokas.15:
draupadyuvAcha||
nAsmi devI na gandharvI nAsurI na cha rAkShasI |
sairandhrI tu bhujiShyAsmi satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.16:
keshA~njAnAmyahaM kartuM piMShe sAdhu vilepanam |
grathayiShye vichitrAshcha srajaH paramashobhanAH
shlokas.17:
ArAdhayaM satyabhAmAM kRRiShNasya mahiShIM priyAm |
kRRiShNAM cha bhAryAM pANDUnAM kurUNAmekasundarIm
shlokas.18:
tatra tatra charAmyevaM labhamAnA sushobhanam |
vAsA.nsi yAvachcha labhe tAvattAvadrame tathA
shlokas.19:
mAlinItyeva me nAma svayaM devI chakAra sA |
sAhamabhyAgatA devi sudeShNe tvanniveshanam
shlokas.20:
sudeShNovAcha||
mUrdhni tvAM vAsayeyaM vai sa.nshayo me na vidyate |
no chediha tu rAjA tvAM gachChetsarveNa chetasA
shlokas.21:
striyo rAjakule pashya yAshchemA mama veshmani |
prasaktAstvAM nirIkShante pumA.nsaM kaM na mohayeH
shlokas.22:
vRRikShA.nshchAvasthitAnpashya ya ime mama veshmani |
te.api tvAM saMnamantIva pumA.nsaM kaM na mohayeH
shlokas.23:
rAjA virATaH sushroNi dRRiShTvA vapuramAnuSham |
vihAya mAM varArohe tvAM gachChetsarvachetasA
shlokas.24:
yaM hi tvamanavadyA~Ngi naramAyatalochane |
prasaktamabhivIkShethAH sa kAmavashago bhavet
shlokas.25:
yashcha tvAM satataM pashyetpuruShashchAruhAsini |
evaM sarvAnavadyA~Ngi sa chAna~Ngavasho bhavet
shlokas.26:
yathA karkaTakI garbhamAdhatte mRRityumAtmanaH |
tathAvidhamahaM manye vAsaM tava shuchismite
shlokas.27:
draupadyuvAcha||
nAsmi labhyA virATena na chAnyena katha~nchana |
gandharvAH patayo mahyaM yuvAnaH pa~ncha bhAmini
shlokas.28:
putrA gandharvarAjasya mahAsattvasya kasyachit |
rakShanti te cha mAM nityaM duHkhAchArA tathA nvaham
shlokas.29:
yo me na dadyAduchChiShTaM na cha pAdau pradhAvayet |
prIyeyustena vAsena gandharvAH patayo mama
shlokas.30:
yo hi mAM puruSho gRRidhyedyathAnyAH prAkRRitastriyaH |
tAmeva sa tato rAtriM pravishedaparAM tanum
shlokas.31:
na chApyahaM chAlayituM shakyA kenachida~Ngane |
duHkhashIlA hi gandharvAste cha me balavattarAH
shlokas.32:
sudeShNovAcha||
evaM tvAM vAsayiShyAmi yathA tvaM nandinIchChasi |
na cha pAdau na chochChiShTaM sprakShyasi tvaM katha~nchana
shlokas.33:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM kRRiShNA virATasya bhAryayA parisAntvitA |
na chainAM veda tatrAnyastattvena janamejaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sahadevo.api gopAnAM kRRitvA veShamanuttamam |
bhAShAM chaiShAM samAsthAya virATamupayAdatha
shlokas.2:
tamAyAntamabhiprekShya bhrAjamAnaM nararShabham |
samupasthAya vai rAjA paprachCha kurunandanam
shlokas.3:
kasya vA tvaM kuto vA tvaM kiM vA tAta chikIrShasi |
na hi me dRRiShTapUrvastvaM tattvaM brUhi nararShabha
shlokas.4:
sa prApya rAjAnamamitratApana;stato.abravInmeghamahaughaniHsvanaH |
vaishyo.asmi nAmnAhamariShTanemi;rgosa~Nkhya AsaM kurupu~NgavAnAm
shlokas.5:
vastuM tvayIchChAmi vishAM variShTha; tAnrAjasiMhAnna hi vedmi pArthAn |
na shakyate jIvitumanyakarmaNA; na cha tvadanyo mama rochate nRRipaH
shlokas.6:
virATa uvAcha||
tvaM brAhmaNo yadi vA kShatriyo.asi; samudranemIshvararUpavAnasi |
AchakShva me tattvamamitrakarshana; na vaishyakarma tvayi vidyate samam
shlokas.7:
kasyAsi rAj~no viShayAdihAgataH; kiM chApi shilpaM tava vidyate kRRitam |
kathaM tvamasmAsu nivatsyase sadA; vadasva kiM chApi taveha vetanam
shlokas.8:
sahadeva uvAcha||
pa~nchAnAM pANDuputrANAM jyeShTho rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
tasyAShTashatasAhasrA gavAM vargAH shataM shatAH
shlokas.9:
apare dashasAhasrA dvistAvantastathApare |
teShAM gosa~Nkhya AsaM vai tantipAleti mAM viduH
shlokas.10:
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha yachcha sa~NkhyAgataM kvachit |
na me.astyaviditaM ki~nchitsamantAddashayojanam
shlokas.11:
guNAH suviditA hyAsanmama tasya mahAtmanaH |
AsIchcha sa mayA tuShTaH kururAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
kShipraM hi gAvo bahulA bhavanti; na tAsu rogo bhavatIha kashchit |
taistairupAyairviditaM mayaita;detAni shilpAni mayi sthitAni
shlokas.13:
vRRiShabhA.nshchApi jAnAmi rAjanpUjitalakShaNAn |
yeShAM mUtramupAghrAya api vandhyA prasUyate
shlokas.14:
virATa uvAcha||
shataM sahasrANi samAhitAni; varNasya varNasya vinishchitA guNaiH |
pashUnsapAlAnbhavate dadAmyahaM; tvadAshrayA me pashavo bhavantviha
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA sa rAj~no.avidito vishAM pate; uvAsa tatraiva sukhaM nareshvaraH |
na chainamanye.api viduH katha~nchana; prAdAchcha tasmai bharaNaM yathepsitam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAparo.adRRishyata rUpasampadA; strINAmala~NkAradharo bRRihatpumAn |
prAkAravapre pratimuchya kuNDale; dIrghe cha kambU parihATake shubhe
shlokas.2:
bahU.nshcha dIrghA.nshcha vikIrya mUrdhajA;nmahAbhujo vAraNamattavikramaH |
gatena bhUmimabhikampaya.nstadA; virATamAsAdya sabhAsamIpataH
shlokas.3:
taM prekShya rAjopagataM sabhAtale; satrapratichChannamaripramAthinam |
virAjamAnaM parameNa varchasA; sutaM mahendrasya gajendravikramam
shlokas.4:
sarvAnapRRichChachcha samIpachAriNaH; kuto.ayamAyAti na me purA shrutaH |
na chainamUchurviditaM tadA narAH; savismitaM vAkyamidaM nRRipo.abravIt
shlokas.5:
sarvopapannaH puruSho manoramaH; shyAmo yuvA vAraNayUthapopamaH |
vimuchya kambU parihATake shubhe; vimuchya veNImapinahya kuNDale
shlokas.6:
shikhI sukeshaH paridhAya chAnyathA; bhavasva dhanvI kavachI sharI tathA |
Aruhya yAnaM paridhAvatAM bhavA;nsutaiH samo me bhava vA mayA samaH
shlokas.7:
vRRiddho hyahaM vai parihArakAmaH; sarvAnmatsyA.nstarasA pAlayasva |
naiva.nvidhAH klIbarUpA bhavanti; katha~nchaneti pratibhAti me manaH
shlokas.8:
arjuna uvAcha||
gAyAmi nRRityAmyatha vAdayAmi; bhadro.asmi nRRitte kushalo.asmi gIte |
tvamuttarAyAH paridatsva mAM svayaM; bhavAmi devyA naradeva nartakaH
shlokas.9:
idaM tu rUpaM mama yena kiM nu ta;tprakIrtayitvA bhRRishashokavardhanam |
bRRihannaDAM vai naradeva viddhi mAM; sutaM sutAM vA pitRRimAtRRivarjitAm
shlokas.10:
virATa uvAcha||
dadAmi te hanta varaM bRRihannaDe; sutAM cha me nartaya yAshcha tAdRRishIH |
idaM tu te karma samaM na me mataM; samudranemiM pRRithivIM tvamarhasi
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bRRihannaDAM tAmabhivIkShya matsyarA;TkalAsu nRRitte cha tathaiva vAdite |
apu.nstvamapyasya nishamya cha sthiraM; tataH kumArIpuramutsasarja tam
shlokas.12:
sa shikShayAmAsa cha gItavAditaM; sutAM virATasya dhana~njayaH prabhuH |
sakhIshcha tasyAH parichArikAstathA; priyashcha tAsAM sa babhUva pANDavaH
shlokas.13:
tathA sa satreNa dhana~njayo.avasa;tpriyANi kurvansaha tAbhirAtmavAn |
tathAgataM tatra na jaj~nire janA; bahishcharA vApyathavAntarecharAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAparo.adRRishyata pANDavaH prabhu;rvirATarAj~nasturagAnsamIkShataH |
tamApatantaM dadRRishe pRRithagjano; vimuktamabhrAdiva sUryamaNDalam
shlokas.2:
sa vai hayAnaikShata tA.nstatastataH; samIkShamANaM cha dadarsha matsyarAT |
tato.abravIttAnanugAnamitrahA; kuto.ayamAyAti naro.amaraprabhaH
shlokas.3:
ayaM hayAnvIkShati mAmakAndRRiDhaM; dhruvaM hayaj~no bhavitA vichakShaNaH |
praveshyatAmeSha samIpamAshu me; vibhAti vIro hi yathAmarastathA
shlokas.4:
abhyetya rAjAnamamitrahAbravI;jjayo.astu te pArthiva bhadramastu cha |
hayeShu yukto nRRipa saMmataH sadA; tavAshvasUto nipuNo bhavAmyaham
shlokas.5:
virATa uvAcha||
dadAmi yAnAni dhanaM niveshanaM; mamAshvasUto bhavituM tvamarhasi |
kuto.asi kasyAsi kathaM tvamAgataH; prabrUhi shilpaM tava vidyate cha yat
shlokas.6:
nakula uvAcha||
pa~nchAnAM pANDuputrANAM jyeShTho rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
tenAhamashveShu purA prakRRitaH shatrukarshana
shlokas.7:
ashvAnAM prakRRitiM vedmi vinayaM chApi sarvashaH |
duShTAnAM pratipattiM cha kRRitsnaM chaiva chikitsitam
shlokas.8:
na kAtaraM syAnmama jAtu vAhanaM; na me.asti duShTA vaDavA kuto hayAH |
janastu mAmAha sa chApi pANDavo; yudhiShThiro granthikameva nAmataH
shlokas.9:
virATa uvAcha||
yadasti ki~nchinmama vAjivAhanaM; tadastu sarvaM tvadadhInamadya vai |
ye chApi kechinmama vAjiyojakA;stvadAshrayAH sArathayashcha santu me
shlokas.10:
idaM taveShTaM yadi vai suropama; bravIhi yatte prasamIkShitaM vasu |
na te.anurUpaM hayakarma vidyate; prabhAsi rAjeva hi saMmato mama
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThirasyeva hi darshanena me; samaM tavedaM priyadarsha darshanam |
kathaM tu bhRRityaiH sa vinAkRRito vane; vasatyanindyo ramate cha pANDavaH
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA sa gandharvavaropamo yuvA; virATarAj~nA muditena pUjitaH |
na chainamanye.api viduH katha~nchana; priyAbhirAmaM vicharantamantarA
shlokas.13:
evaM hi matsye nyavasanta pANDavA; yathApratij~nAbhiramoghadarshanAH |
aj~nAtacharyAM vyacharansamAhitAH; samudranemIpatayo.atiduHkhitAH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM matsyasya nagare vasantastatra pANDavAH |
ata UrdhvaM mahAvIryAH kimakurvanta vai dvija
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM te nyavasa.nstatra prachChannAH kurunandanAH |
ArAdhayanto rAjAnaM yadakurvanta tachChRRiNu
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThiraH sabhAstAraH sabhyAnAmabhavatpriyaH |
tathaiva cha virATasya saputrasya vishAM pate
shlokas.4:
sa hyakShahRRidayaj~nastAnkrIDayAmAsa pANDavaH |
akShavatyAM yathAkAmaM sUtrabaddhAniva dvijAn
shlokas.5:
aj~nAtaM cha virATasya vijitya vasu dharmarAT |
bhrAtRRibhyaH puruShavyAghro yathArhaM sma prayachChati
shlokas.6:
bhImaseno.api mA.nsAni bhakShyANi vividhAni cha |
atisRRiShTAni matsyena vikrINAti yudhiShThire
shlokas.7:
vAsA.nsi parijIrNAni labdhAnyantaHpure.arjunaH |
vikrINAnashcha sarvebhyaH pANDavebhyaH prayachChati
shlokas.8:
sahadevo.api gopAnAM veShamAsthAya pANDavaH |
dadhi kShIraM ghRRitaM chaiva pANDavebhyaH prayachChati
shlokas.9:
nakulo.api dhanaM labdhvA kRRite karmaNi vAjinAm |
tuShTe tasminnarapatau pANDavebhyaH prayachChati
shlokas.10:
kRRiShNApi sarvAnbhrAtR^I.nstAnnirIkShantI tapasvinI |
yathA punaravij~nAtA tathA charati bhAminI
shlokas.11:
evaM sampAdayantaste tathAnyonyaM mahArathAH |
prekShamANAstadA kRRiShNAmUShushChannA narAdhipa
shlokas.12:
atha mAse chaturthe tu brahmaNaH sumahotsavaH |
AsItsamRRiddho matsyeShu puruShANAM susaMmataH
shlokas.13:
tatra mallAH samApeturdigbhyo rAjansahasrashaH |
mahAkAyA mahAvIryAH kAlakha~njA ivAsurAH
shlokas.14:
vIryonnaddhA balodagrA rAj~nA samabhipUjitAH |
siMhaskandhakaTigrIvAH svavadAtA manasvinaH
asakRRillabdhalakShAste ra~Nge pArthivasaMnidhau
shlokas.15:
teShAmeko mahAnAsItsarvamallAnsamAhvayat |
AvalgamAnaM taM ra~Nge nopatiShThati kashchana
shlokas.16:
yadA sarve vimanasaste mallA hatachetasaH |
atha sUdena taM mallaM yodhayAmAsa matsyarAT
shlokas.17:
chodyamAnastato bhImo duHkhenaivAkaronmatim |
na hi shaknoti vivRRite pratyAkhyAtuM narAdhipam
shlokas.18:
tataH sa puruShavyAghraH shArdUlashithilaM charan |
pravivesha mahAra~NgaM virATamabhiharShayan
shlokas.19:
babandha kakShyAM kaunteyastatastaM harShaya~njanam |
tatastaM vRRitrasa~NkAshaM bhImo mallaM samAhvayat
shlokas.20:
tAvubhau sumahotsAhAvubhau tIvraparAkramau |
mattAviva mahAkAyau vAraNau ShaShTihAyanau
shlokas.21:
chakarSha dorbhyAmutpATya bhImo mallamamitrahA |
vinadantamabhikrosha~nshArdUla iva vAraNam
shlokas.22:
tamudyamya mahAbAhurbhrAmayAmAsa vIryavAn |
tato mallAshcha matsyAshcha vismayaM chakrire param
shlokas.23:
bhrAmayitvA shataguNaM gatasattvamachetanam |
pratyapiMShanmahAbAhurmallaM bhuvi vRRikodaraH
shlokas.24:
tasminvinihate malle jImUte lokavishrute |
virATaH paramaM harShamagachChadbAndhavaiH saha
shlokas.25:
saMharShAtpradadau vittaM bahu rAjA mahAmanAH |
ballavAya mahAra~Nge yathA vaishravaNastathA
shlokas.26:
evaM sa subahUnmallAnpuruShA.nshcha mahAbalAn |
vinighnanmatsyarAjasya prItimAvahaduttamAm
shlokas.27:
yadAsya tulyaH puruSho na kashchittatra vidyate |
tato vyAghraishcha siMhaishcha dviradaishchApyayodhayat
shlokas.28:
punarantaHpuragataH strINAM madhye vRRikodaraH |
yodhyate sma virATena siMhairmattairmahAbalaiH
shlokas.29:
bIbhatsurapi gItena sunRRittena cha pANDavaH |
virATaM toShayAmAsa sarvAshchAntaHpurastriyaH
shlokas.30:
ashvairvinItairjavanaistatra tatra samAgataiH |
toShayAmAsa nakulo rAjAnaM rAjasattama
shlokas.31:
tasmai pradeyaM prAyachChatprIto rAjA dhanaM bahu |
vinItAnvRRiShabhAndRRiShTvA sahadevasya chAbhibho
shlokas.32:
evaM te nyavasa.nstatra prachChannAH puruSharShabhAH |
karmANi tasya kurvANA virATanRRipatestadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vasamAneShu pArtheShu matsyasya nagare tadA |
mahAratheShu ChanneShu mAsA dasha samatyayuH
shlokas.2:
yAj~nasenI sudeShNAM tu shushrUShantI vishAM pate |
avasatparichArArhA suduHkhaM janamejaya
shlokas.3:
tathA charantIM pA~nchAlIM sudeShNAyA niveshane |
senApatirvirATasya dadarsha jalajAnanAm
shlokas.4:
tAM dRRiShTvA devagarbhAbhAM charantIM devatAmiva |
kIchakaH kAmayAmAsa kAmabANaprapIDitaH
shlokas.5:
sa tu kAmAgnisantaptaH sudeShNAmabhigamya vai |
prahasanniva senAnIridaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
neyaM purA jAtu mayeha dRRiShTA; rAj~no virATasya niveshane shubhA |
rUpeNa chonmAdayatIva mAM bhRRishaM; gandhena jAtA madireva bhAminI
shlokas.7:
kA devarUpA hRRidaya~NgamA shubhe; AchakShva me kA cha kutashcha shobhanA |
chittaM hi nirmathya karoti mAM vashe; na chAnyadatrauShadhamadya me matam
shlokas.8:
aho taveyaM parichArikA shubhA; pratyagrarUpA pratibhAti mAmiyam |
ayuktarUpaM hi karoti karma te; prashAstu mAM yachcha mamAsti ki~nchana
shlokas.9:
prabhUtanAgAshvarathaM mahAdhanaM; samRRiddhiyuktaM bahupAnabhojanam |
manoharaM kA~nchanachitrabhUShaNaM; gRRihaM mahachChobhayatAmiyaM mama
shlokas.10:
tataH sudeShNAmanumantrya kIchaka;stataH samabhyetya narAdhipAtmajAm |
uvAcha kRRiShNAmabhisAntvaya.nstadA; mRRigendrakanyAmiva jambuko vane
shlokas.11:
idaM cha rUpaM prathamaM cha te vayo; nirarthakaM kevalamadya bhAmini |
adhAryamANA sragivottamA yathA; na shobhase sundari shobhanA satI
shlokas.12:
tyajAmi dArAnmama ye purAtanA; bhavantu dAsyastava chAruhAsini |
ahaM cha te sundari dAsavatsthitaH; sadA bhaviShye vashago varAnane
shlokas.13:
draupadyuvAcha||
aprArthanIyAmiha mAM sUtaputrAbhimanyase |
vihInavarNAM sairandhrIM bIbhatsAM keshakArikAm
shlokas.14:
paradArAsmi bhadraM te na yuktaM tvayi sAmpratam |
dayitAH prANinAM dArA dharmaM samanuchintaya
shlokas.15:
paradAre na te buddhirjAtu kAryA katha~nchana |
vivarjanaM hyakAryANAmetatsatpuruShavratam
shlokas.16:
mithyAbhigRRidhno hi naraH pApAtmA mohamAsthitaH |
ayashaH prApnuyAdghoraM sumahatprApnuyAdbhayam
shlokas.17:
mA sUtaputra hRRiShyasva mAdya tyakShyasi jIvitam |
durlabhAmabhimanvAno mAM vIrairabhirakShitAm
shlokas.18:
na chApyahaM tvayA shakyA gandharvAH patayo mama |
te tvAM nihanyuH kupitAH sAdhvalaM mA vyanInashaH
shlokas.19:
ashakyarUpaiH puruShairadhvAnaM gantumichChasi |
yathA nishchetano bAlaH kUlasthaH kUlamuttaram
tartumichChati mandAtmA tathA tvaM kartumichChasi
shlokas.20:
antarmahIM vA yadi vordhvamutpateH; samudrapAraM yadi vA pradhAvasi |
tathApi teShAM na vimokShamarhasi; pramAthino devasutA hi me varAH
shlokas.21:
tvaM kAlarAtrImiva kashchidAturaH; kiM mAM dRRiDhaM prArthayase.adya kIchaka |
kiM mAtura~Nke shayito yathA shishu;shchandraM jighRRikShuriva manyase hi mAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pratyAkhyAto rAjaputryA sudeShNAM kIchako.abravIt |
amaryAdena kAmena ghoreNAbhipariplutaH
shlokas.2:
yathA kaikeyi sairandhryA sameyAM tadvidhIyatAm |
tAM sudeShNe parIpsasva mAhaM prANAnprahAsiSham
shlokas.3:
tasya tAM bahushaH shrutvA vAchaM vilapatastadA |
virATamahiShI devI kRRipAM chakre manasvinI
shlokas.4:
svamarthamabhisandhAya tasyArthamanuchintya cha |
udvegaM chaiva kRRiShNAyAH sudeShNA sUtamabravIt
shlokas.5:
parviNIM tvaM samuddiShya surAmannaM cha kAraya |
tatrainAM preShayiShyAmi surAhArIM tavAntikam
shlokas.6:
tatra sampreShitAmenAM vijane niravagrahAm |
sAntvayethA yathAkAmaM sAntvyamAnA ramedyadi
shlokas.7:
kIchakastu gRRihaM gatvA bhaginyA vachanAttadA |
surAmAhArayAmAsa rAjArhAM suparisrutAm
shlokas.8:
AjaurabhraM cha subhRRishaM bahU.nshchochchAvachAnmRRigAn |
kArayAmAsa kushalairannapAnaM sushobhanam
shlokas.9:
tasminkRRite tadA devI kIchakenopamantritA |
sudeShNA preShayAmAsa sairandhrIM kIchakAlayam
shlokas.10:
sudeShNovAcha||
uttiShTha gachCha sairandhri kIchakasya niveshanam |
pAnamAnaya kalyANi pipAsA mAM prabAdhate
shlokas.11:
draupadyuvAcha||
na gachCheyamahaM tasya rAjaputri niveshanam |
tvameva rAj~ni jAnAsi yathA sa nirapatrapaH
shlokas.12:
na chAhamanavadyA~Ngi tava veshmani bhAmini |
kAmavRRittA bhaviShyAmi patInAM vyabhichAriNI
shlokas.13:
tvaM chaiva devi jAnAsi yathA sa samayaH kRRitaH |
pravishantyA mayA pUrvaM tava veshmani bhAmini
shlokas.14:
kIchakashcha sukeshAnte mUDho madanadarpitaH |
so.avama.nsyati mAM dRRiShTvA na yAsye tatra shobhane
shlokas.15:
santi bahvyastava preShyA rAjaputri vashAnugAH |
anyAM preShaya bhadraM te sa hi mAmavama.nsyate
shlokas.17:
sudeShNovAcha||
naiva tvAM jAtu hi.nsyAtsa itaH sampreShitAM mayA |
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityasyAH pradadau kA.nsyaM sapidhAnaM hiraNmayam |
sA sha~NkamAnA rudatI daivaM sharaNamIyuShI
prAtiShThata surAhArI kIchakasya niveshanam
shlokas.18:
draupadyuvAcha||
yathAhamanyaM pANDubhyo nAbhijAnAmi ka~nchana |
tena satyena mAM prAptAM kIchako mA vashe kRRithAH
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
upAtiShThata sA sUryaM muhUrtamabalA tataH |
sa tasyAstanumadhyAyAH sarvaM sUryo.avabuddhavAn
shlokas.20:
antarhitaM tatastasyA rakSho rakShArthamAdishat |
tachchainAM nAjahAttatra sarvAvasthAsvaninditAm
shlokas.21:
tAM mRRigImiva vitrastAM dRRiShTvA kRRiShNAM samIpagAm |
udatiShThanmudA sUto nAvaM labdhveva pAragaH

shlokas.1:
kIchaka uvAcha||
svAgataM te sukeshAnte suvyuShTA rajanI mama |
svAminI tvamanuprAptA prakuruShva mama priyam
shlokas.2:
suvarNamAlAH kambUshcha kuNDale parihATake |
Aharantu cha vastrANi kaushikAnyajinAni cha
shlokas.3:
asti me shayanaM shubhraM tvadarthamupakalpitam |
ehi tatra mayA sArdhaM pibasva madhumAdhavIm
shlokas.4:
draupadyuvAcha||
apraiShIdrAjaputrI mAM surAhArIM tavAntikam |
pAnamAnaya me kShipraM pipAsA meti chAbravIt
shlokas.6:
kIchaka uvAcha||
anyA bhadre nayiShyanti rAjaputryAH parisrutam |
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityenAM dakShiNe pANau sUtaputraH parAmRRishat |
sA gRRihItA vidhunvAnA bhUmAvAkShipya kIchakam
sabhAM sharaNamAdhAvadyatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.7:
tAM kIchakaH pradhAvantIM keshapakShe parAmRRishat |
athainAM pashyato rAj~naH pAtayitvA padAvadhIt
shlokas.8:
tato yo.asau tadArkeNa rAkShasaH saMniyojitaH |
sa kIchakamapovAha vAtavegena bhArata
shlokas.9:
sa papAta tato bhUmau rakShobalasamAhataH |
vighUrNamAno nishcheShTashChinnamUla iva drumaH
shlokas.10:
tAM chAsInau dadRRishaturbhImasenayudhiShThirau |
amRRiShyamANau kRRiShNAyAH kIchakena padA vadham
shlokas.11:
tasya bhImo vadhaprepsuH kIchakasya durAtmanaH |
dantairdantA.nstadA roShAnniShpipeSha mahAmanAH
shlokas.12:
athA~NguShThenAvamRRidnAda~NguShThaM tasya dharmarAT |
prabodhanabhayAdrAjanbhImasya pratyaShedhayat
shlokas.13:
sA sabhAdvAramAsAdya rudatI matsyamabravIt |
avekShamANA sushroNI patI.nstAndInachetasaH
shlokas.14:
AkAramabhirakShantI pratij~nAM dharmasaMhitAm |
dahyamAneva raudreNa chakShuShA drupadAtmajA
shlokas.15:
draupadyuvAcha||
yeShAM vairI na svapiti padA bhUmimupaspRRishan |
teShAM mAM mAninIM bhAryAM sUtaputraH padAvadhIt
shlokas.16:
ye dadyurna cha yAcheyurbrahmaNyAH satyavAdinaH |
teShAM mAM mAninIM bhAryAM sUtaputraH padAvadhIt
shlokas.17:
yeShAM dundubhinirghoSho jyAghoShaH shrUyate.anisham |
teShAM mAM mAninIM bhAryAM sUtaputraH padAvadhIt
shlokas.18:
ye te tejasvino dAntA balavanto.abhimAninaH |
teShAM mAM mAninIM bhAryAM sUtaputraH padAvadhIt
shlokas.19:
sarvalokamimaM hanyurdharmapAshasitAstu ye |
teShAM mAM mAninIM bhAryAM sUtaputraH padAvadhIt
shlokas.20:
sharaNaM ye prapannAnAM bhavanti sharaNArthinAm |
charanti loke prachChannAH kva nu te.adya mahArathAH
shlokas.21:
kathaM te sUtaputreNa vadhyamAnAM priyAM satIm |
marShayanti yathA klIbA balavanto.amitaujasaH
shlokas.22:
kva nu teShAmamarShashcha vIryaM tejashcha vartate |
na parIpsanti ye bhAryAM vadhyamAnAM durAtmanA
shlokas.23:
mayAtra shakyaM kiM kartuM virATe dharmadUShaNam |
yaH pashyanmAM marShayati vadhyamAnAmanAgasam
shlokas.24:
na rAjanrAjavatki~nchitsamAcharasi kIchake |
dasyUnAmiva dharmaste na hi sa.nsadi shobhate
shlokas.25:
na kIchakaH svadharmastho na cha matsyaH katha~nchana |
sabhAsado.apyadharmaj~nA ya imaM paryupAsate
shlokas.26:
nopAlabhe tvAM nRRipate virATa janasa.nsadi |
nAhametena yuktA vai hantuM matsya tavAntike
sabhAsadastu pashyantu kIchakasya vyatikramam
shlokas.27:
virATa uvAcha||
parokShaM nAbhijAnAmi vigrahaM yuvayoraham |
arthatattvamavij~nAya kiM nu syAtkushalaM mama
shlokas.28:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastu sabhyA vij~nAya kRRiShNAM bhUyo.abhyapUjayan |
sAdhu sAdhviti chApyAhuH kIchakaM cha vyagarhayan
shlokas.29:
sabhyA UchuH||
yasyeyaM chArusarvA~NgI bhAryA syAdAyatekShaNA |
paro lAbhashcha tasya syAnna sa shochetkadAchana
shlokas.30:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sampUjaya.nstatra kRRiShNAM prekShya sabhAsadaH |
yudhiShThirasya kopAttu lalATe sveda Asajat
shlokas.31:
athAbravIdrAjaputrIM kauravyo mahiShIM priyAm |
gachCha sairandhri mAtra sthAH sudeShNAyA niveshanam
shlokas.32:
bhartAramanurudhyantyaH klishyante vIrapatnayaH |
shushrUShayA klishyamAnAH patilokaM jayantyuta
shlokas.33:
manye na kAlaM krodhasya pashyanti patayastava |
tena tvAM nAbhidhAvanti gandharvAH sUryavarchasaH
shlokas.34:
akAlaj~nAsi sairandhri shailUShIva vidhAvasi |
vighnaM karoShi matsyAnAM dIvyatAM rAjasa.nsadi
gachCha sairandhri gandharvAH kariShyanti tava priyam
shlokas.35:
draupadyuvAcha||
atIva teShAM ghRRiNinAmarthe.ahaM dharmachAriNI |
tasya tasyeha te vadhyA yeShAM jyeShTho.akShadevitA
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA prAdravatkRRiShNA sudeShNAyA niveshanam |
keshAnmuktvA tu sushroNI sa.nrambhAllohitekShaNA
shlokas.37:
shushubhe vadanaM tasyA rudantyA virataM tadA |
meghalekhAvinirmuktaM divIva shashimaNDalam
shlokas.38:
sudeShNovAcha||
kastvAvadhIdvarArohe kasmAdrodiShi shobhane |
kasyAdya na sukhaM bhadre kena te vipriyaM kRRitam
shlokas.39:
draupadyuvAcha||
kIchako mAvadhIttatra surAhArIM gatAM tava |
sabhAyAM pashyato rAj~no yathaiva vijane tathA
shlokas.40:
sudeShNovAcha||
ghAtayAmi sukeshAnte kIchakaM yadi manyase |
yo.asau tvAM kAmasaMmatto durlabhAmabhimanyate
shlokas.41:
draupadyuvAcha||
anye vai taM vadhiShyanti yeShAmAgaH karoti saH |
manye chAdyaiva suvyaktaM paralokaM gamiShyati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA hatA sUtaputreNa rAjaputrI samajvalat |
vadhaM kRRiShNA parIpsantI senAvAhasya bhAminI
jagAmAvAsamevAtha tadA sA drupadAtmajA
shlokas.2:
kRRitvA shauchaM yathAnyAyaM kRRiShNA vai tanumadhyamA |
gAtrANi vAsasI chaiva prakShAlya salilena sA
shlokas.3:
chintayAmAsa rudatI tasya duHkhasya nirNayam |
kiM karomi kva gachChAmi kathaM kAryaM bhavenmama
shlokas.4:
ityevaM chintayitvA sA bhImaM vai manasAgamat |
nAnyaH kartA RRite bhImAnmamAdya manasaH priyam
shlokas.5:
tata utthAya rAtrau sA vihAya shayanaM svakam |
prAdravannAthamichChantI kRRiShNA nAthavatI satI
duHkhena mahatA yuktA mAnasena manasvinI
shlokas.6:
sA vai mahAnase prApya bhImasenaM shuchismitA |
sarvashveteva mAheyI vane jAtA trihAyanI
upAtiShThata pA~nchAlI vAshiteva mahAgajam
shlokas.7:
sA lateva mahAshAlaM phullaM gomatitIrajam |
bAhubhyAM parirabhyainaM prAbodhayadaninditA
siMhaM suptaM vane durge mRRigarAjavadhUriva
shlokas.8:
vINeva madhurAbhAShA gAndhAraM sAdhu mUrchChitA |
abhyabhAShata pA~nchAlI bhImasenamaninditA
shlokas.9:
uttiShThottiShTha kiM sheShe bhImasena yathA mRRitaH |
nAmRRitasya hi pApIyAnbhAryAmAlabhya jIvati
shlokas.10:
tasmi~njIvati pApiShThe senAvAhe mama dviShi |
tatkarma kRRitavatyadya kathaM nidrAM niShevase
shlokas.11:
sa samprahAya shayanaM rAjaputryA prabodhitaH |
upAtiShThata meghAbhaH parya~Nke sopasa~Ngrahe
shlokas.12:
athAbravIdrAjaputrIM kauravyo mahiShIM priyAm |
kenAsyarthena samprAptA tvariteva mamAntikam
shlokas.13:
na te prakRRitimAnvarNaH kRRishA pANDushcha lakShyase |
AchakShva parisheSheNa sarvaM vidyAmahaM yathA
shlokas.14:
sukhaM vA yadi vA duHkhaM dveShyaM vA yadi vA priyam |
yathAvatsarvamAchakShva shrutvA j~nAsyAmi yatparam
shlokas.15:
ahameva hi te kRRiShNe vishvAsyaH sarvakarmasu |
ahamApatsu chApi tvAM mokShayAmi punaH punaH
shlokas.16:
shIghramuktvA yathAkAmaM yatte kAryaM vivakShitam |
gachCha vai shayanAyaiva purA nAnyo.avabudhyate

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
ashochyaM nu kutastasyA yasyA bhartA yudhiShThiraH |
jAnansarvANi duHkhAni kiM mAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.2:
yanmAM dAsIpravAdena prAtikAmI tadAnayat |
sabhAyAM pArShado madhye tanmAM dahati bhArata
shlokas.3:
pArthivasya sutA nAma kA nu jIveta mAdRRishI |
anubhUya bhRRishaM duHkhamanyatra draupadIM prabho
shlokas.4:
vanavAsagatAyAshcha saindhavena durAtmanA |
parAmarshaM dvitIyaM cha soDhumutsahate nu kA
shlokas.5:
matsyarAj~naH samakShaM cha tasya dhUrtasya pashyataH |
kIchakena padA spRRiShTA kA nu jIveta mAdRRishI
shlokas.6:
evaM bahuvidhaiH kleshaiH klishyamAnAM cha bhArata |
na mAM jAnAsi kaunteya kiM phalaM jIvitena me
shlokas.7:
yo.ayaM rAj~no virATasya kIchako nAma bhArata |
senAnIH puruShavyAghra syAlaH paramadurmatiH
shlokas.8:
sa mAM sairandhriveSheNa vasantIM rAjaveshmani |
nityamevAha duShTAtmA bhAryA mama bhaveti vai
shlokas.9:
tenopamantryamANAyA vadhArheNa sapatnahan |
kAleneva phalaM pakvaM hRRidayaM me vidIryate
shlokas.10:
bhrAtaraM cha vigarhasva jyeShThaM durdyUtadevinam |
yasyAsmi karmaNA prAptA duHkhametadanantakam
shlokas.11:
ko hi rAjyaM parityajya sarvasvaM chAtmanA saha |
pravrajyAyaiva dIvyeta vinA durdyUtadevinam
shlokas.12:
yadi niShkasahasreNa yachchAnyatsAravaddhanam |
sAyamprAtaradeviShyadapi sa.nvatsarAnbahUn
shlokas.13:
rukmaM hiraNyaM vAsA.nsi yAnaM yugyamajAvikam |
ashvAshvatarasa~NghA.nshcha na jAtu kShayamAvahet
shlokas.14:
so.ayaM dyUtapravAdena shriyA pratyavaropitaH |
tUShNImAste yathA mUDhaH svAni karmANi chintayan
shlokas.15:
dasha nAgasahasrANi padminAM hemamAlinAm |
yaM yAntamanuyAntIha so.ayaM dyUtena jIvati
shlokas.16:
tathA shatasahasrANi nRRiNAmamitatejasAm |
upAsate mahArAjamindraprasthe yudhiShThiram
shlokas.17:
shataM dAsIsahasrANi yasya nityaM mahAnase |
pAtrIhastaM divArAtramatithInbhojayantyuta
shlokas.18:
eSha niShkasahasrANi pradAya dadatAM varaH |
dyUtajena hyanarthena mahatA samupAvRRitaH
shlokas.19:
enaM hi svarasampannA bahavaH sUtamAgadhAH |
sAyamprAtarupAtiShThansumRRiShTamaNikuNDalAH
shlokas.20:
sahasramRRiShayo yasya nityamAsansabhAsadaH |
tapaHshrutopasampannAH sarvakAmairupasthitAH
shlokas.21:
andhAnvRRiddhA.nstathAnAthAnsarvAnrAShTreShu durgatAn |
bibhartyavimanA nityamAnRRisha.nsyAdyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.22:
sa eSha nirayaM prApto matsyasya parichArakaH |
sabhAyAM devitA rAj~naH ka~Nko brUte yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.23:
indraprasthe nivasataH samaye yasya pArthivAH |
AsanbalibhRRitaH sarve so.adyAnyairbhRRitimichChati
shlokas.24:
pArthivAH pRRithivIpAlA yasyAsanvashavartinaH |
sa vashe vivasho rAjA pareShAmadya vartate
shlokas.25:
pratApya pRRithivIM sarvAM rashmivAniva tejasA |
so.ayaM rAj~no virATasya sabhAstAro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.26:
yamupAsanta rAjAnaH sabhAyAmRRiShibhiH saha |
tamupAsInamadyAnyaM pashya pANDava pANDavam
shlokas.27:
atadarhaM mahAprAj~naM jIvitArthe.abhisa.nshritam |
dRRiShTvA kasya na duHkhaM syAddharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.28:
upAste sma sabhAyAM yaM kRRitsnA vIra vasundharA |
tamupAsInamadyAnyaM pashya bhArata bhAratam
shlokas.29:
evaM bahuvidhairduHkhaiH pIDyamAnAmanAthavat |
shokasAgaramadhyasthAM kiM mAM bhIma na pashyasi

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
idaM tu me mahadduHkhaM yatpravakShyAmi bhArata |
na me.abhyasUyA kartavyA duHkhAdetadbravImyaham
shlokas.2:
shArdUlairmahiShaiH siMhairAgAre yudhyase yadA |
kaikeyyAH prekShamANAyAstadA me kashmalo bhavet
shlokas.3:
prekShAsamutthitA chApi kaikeyI tAH striyo vadet |
prekShya mAmanavadyA~NgI kashmalopahatAmiva
shlokas.4:
snehAtsa.nvAsajAnmanye sUdameShA shuchismitA |
yodhyamAnaM mahAvIryairimaM samanushochati
shlokas.5:
kalyANarUpA sairandhrI ballavashchAtisundaraH |
strINAM cha chittaM durj~neyaM yuktarUpau cha me matau
shlokas.6:
sairandhrI priyasa.nvAsAnnityaM karuNavedinI |
asminrAjakule chemau tulyakAlanivAsinau
shlokas.7:
iti bruvANA vAkyAni sA mAM nityamavedayat |
krudhyantIM mAM cha samprekShya samasha~Nkata mAM tvayi
shlokas.8:
tasyAM tathA bruvatyAM tu duHkhaM mAM mahadAvishat |
shoke yaudhiShThire magnA nAhaM jIvitumutsahe
shlokas.9:
yaH sadevAnmanuShyA.nshcha sarpA.nshchaikaratho.ajayat |
so.ayaM rAj~no virATasya kanyAnAM nartako yuvA
shlokas.10:
yo.atarpayadameyAtmA khANDave jAtavedasam |
so.antaHpuragataH pArthaH kUpe.agniriva sa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.11:
yasmAdbhayamamitrANAM sadaiva puruSharShabhAt |
sa lokaparibhUtena veSheNAste dhana~njayaH
shlokas.12:
yasya jyAtalanirghoShAtsamakampanta shatravaH |
striyo gItasvanaM tasya muditAH paryupAsate
shlokas.13:
kirITaM sUryasa~NkAshaM yasya mUrdhani shobhate |
veNIvikRRitakeshAntaH so.ayamadya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.14:
yasminnastrANi divyAni samastAni mahAtmani |
AdhAraH sarvavidyAnAM sa dhArayati kuNDale
shlokas.15:
yaM sma rAjasahasrANi tejasApratimAni vai |
samare nAtivartante velAmiva mahArNavaH
shlokas.16:
so.ayaM rAj~no virATasya kanyAnAM nartako yuvA |
Aste veShapratichChannaH kanyAnAM parichArakaH
shlokas.17:
yasya sma rathaghoSheNa samakampata medinI |
saparvatavanA bhIma sahasthAvaraja~NgamA
shlokas.18:
yasmi~njAte mahAbhAge kuntyAH shoko vyanashyata |
sa shochayati mAmadya bhImasena tavAnujaH
shlokas.19:
bhUShitaM tamala~NkAraiH kuNDalaiH parihATakaiH |
kambupANinamAyAntaM dRRiShTvA sIdati me manaH
shlokas.20:
taM veNIkRRitakeshAntaM bhImadhanvAnamarjunam |
kanyAparivRRitaM dRRiShTvA bhIma sIdati me manaH
shlokas.21:
yadA hyenaM parivRRitaM kanyAbhirdevarUpiNam |
prabhinnamiva mAta~NgaM parikIrNaM kareNubhiH
shlokas.22:
matsyamarthapatiM pArthaM virATaM samupasthitam |
pashyAmi tUryamadhyasthaM disho nashyanti me tadA
shlokas.23:
nUnamAryA na jAnAti kRRichChraM prAptaM dhana~njayam |
ajAtashatruM kauravyaM magnaM durdyUtadevinam
shlokas.24:
tathA dRRiShTvA yavIyA.nsaM sahadevaM yudhAM patim |
goShu goveShamAyAntaM pANDubhUtAsmi bhArata
shlokas.25:
sahadevasya vRRittAni chintayantI punaH punaH |
na vindAmi mahAbAho sahadevasya duShkRRitam
yasminneva.nvidhaM duHkhaM prApnuyAtsatyavikramaH
shlokas.26:
dUyAmi bharatashreShTha dRRiShTvA te bhrAtaraM priyam |
goShu govRRiShasa~NkAshaM matsyenAbhiniveshitam
shlokas.27:
sa.nrabdhaM raktanepathyaM gopAlAnAM purogamam |
virATamabhinandantamatha me bhavati jvaraH
shlokas.28:
sahadevaM hi me vIraM nityamAryA prasha.nsati |
mahAbhijanasampanno vRRittavA~nshIlavAniti
shlokas.29:
hrIniShedho madhuravAgdhArmikashcha priyashcha me |
sa te.araNyeShu boddhavyo yAj~naseni kShapAsvapi
shlokas.30:
taM dRRiShTvA vyApRRitaM goShu vatsacharmakShapAshayam |
sahadevaM yudhAM shreShThaM kiM nu jIvAmi pANDava
shlokas.31:
yastribhirnityasampanno rUpeNAstreNa medhayA |
so.ashvabandho virATasya pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.32:
abhyakIryanta vRRindAni dAmagranthimudIkShatAm |
vinayantaM javenAshvAnmahArAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.33:
apashyamenaM shrImantaM matsyaM bhrAjiShNumuttamam |
virATamupatiShThantaM darshayantaM cha vAjinaH
shlokas.34:
kiM nu mAM manyase pArtha sukhiteti parantapa |
evaM duHkhashatAviShTA yudhiShThiranimittataH
shlokas.35:
ataH prativishiShTAni duHkhAnyanyAni bhArata |
vartante mayi kaunteya vakShyAmi shRRiNu tAnyapi
shlokas.36:
yuShmAsu dhriyamANeShu duHkhAni vividhAnyuta |
shoShayanti sharIraM me kiM nu duHkhamataH param

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
ahaM sairandhriveSheNa charantI rAjaveshmani |
shauchadAsmi sudeShNAyA akShadhUrtasya kAraNAt
shlokas.2:
vikriyAM pashya me tIvrAM rAjaputryAH parantapa |
Ase kAlamupAsInA sarvaM duHkhaM kilArtavat
shlokas.3:
anityA kila martyAnAmarthasiddhirjayAjayau |
iti kRRitvA pratIkShAmi bhartR^INAmudayaM punaH
shlokas.4:
ya eva heturbhavati puruShasya jayAvahaH |
parAjaye cha hetuH sa iti cha pratipAlaye
shlokas.5:
dattvA yAchanti puruShA hatvA vadhyanti chApare |
pAtayitvA cha pAtyante parairiti cha me shrutam
shlokas.6:
na daivasyAtibhAro.asti na daivasyAtivartanam |
iti chApyAgamaM bhUyo daivasya pratipAlaye
shlokas.7:
sthitaM pUrvaM jalaM yatra punastatraiva tiShThati |
iti paryAyamichChantI pratIkShAmyudayaM punaH
shlokas.8:
daivena kila yasyArthaH sunIto.api vipadyate |
daivasya chAgame yatnastena kAryo vijAnatA
shlokas.9:
yattu me vachanasyAsya kathitasya prayojanam |
pRRichCha mAM duHkhitAM tattvamapRRiShTA vA bravImi te
shlokas.10:
mahiShI pANDuputrANAM duhitA drupadasya cha |
imAmavasthAM samprAptA kA madanyA jijIviShet
shlokas.11:
kurUnparibhavansarvAnpA~nchAlAnapi bhArata |
pANDaveyA.nshcha samprApto mama klesho hyari.ndama
shlokas.12:
bhrAtRRibhiH shvashuraiH putrairbahubhiH paravIrahan |
evaM samuditA nArI kA nvanyA duHkhitA bhavet
shlokas.13:
nUnaM hi bAlayA dhAturmayA vai vipriyaM kRRitam |
yasya prasAdAddurnItaM prAptAsmi bharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
varNAvakAshamapi me pashya pANDava yAdRRisham |
yAdRRisho me na tatrAsIdduHkhe paramake tadA
shlokas.15:
tvameva bhIma jAnIShe yanme pArtha sukhaM purA |
sAhaM dAsatvamApannA na shAntimavashA labhe
shlokas.16:
nAdaivikamidaM manye yatra pArtho dhana~njayaH |
bhImadhanvA mahAbAhurAste shAnta ivAnalaH
shlokas.17:
ashakyA vedituM pArtha prANinAM vai gatirnaraiH |
vinipAtamimaM manye yuShmAkamavichintitam
shlokas.18:
yasyA mama mukhaprekShA yUyamindrasamAH sadA |
sA prekShe mukhamanyAsAmavarANAM varA satI
shlokas.19:
pashya pANDava me.avasthAM yathA nArhAmi vai tathA |
yuShmAsu dhriyamANeShu pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.20:
yasyAH sAgaraparyantA pRRithivI vashavartinI |
AsItsAdya sudeShNAyA bhItAhaM vashavartinI
shlokas.21:
yasyAH puraHsarA AsanpRRiShThatashchAnugAminaH |
sAhamadya sudeShNAyAH puraH pashchAchcha gAminI
idaM tu duHkhaM kaunteya mamAsahyaM nibodha tat
shlokas.22:
yA na jAtu svayaM piMShe gAtrodvartanamAtmanaH |
anyatra kuntyA bhadraM te sAdya piMShAmi chandanam
pashya kaunteya pANI me naivaM yau bhavataH purA
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityasya darshayAmAsa kiNabaddhau karAvubhau |
draupadyuvAcha||
bibhemi kuntyA yA nAhaM yuShmAkaM vA kadAchana |
sAdyAgrato virATasya bhItA tiShThAmi ki~NkarI
shlokas.25:
kiM nu vakShyati samrANmAM varNakaH sukRRito na vA |
nAnyapiShTaM hi matsyasya chandanaM kila rochate
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA kIrtayantI duHkhAni bhImasenasya bhAminI |
ruroda shanakaiH kRRiShNA bhImasenamudIkShatI
shlokas.27:
sA bAShpakalayA vAchA niHshvasantI punaH punaH |
hRRidayaM bhImasenasya ghaTTayantIdamabravIt
shlokas.28:
nAlpaM kRRitaM mayA bhIma devAnAM kilbiShaM purA |
abhAgyA yattu jIvAmi martavye sati pANDava
shlokas.29:
tatastasyAH karau shUnau kiNabaddhau vRRikodaraH |
mukhamAnIya vepantyA ruroda paravIrahA
shlokas.30:
tau gRRihItvA cha kaunteyo bAShpamutsRRijya vIryavAn |
tataH paramaduHkhArta idaM vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
bhImasena uvAcha||
dhigastu me bAhubalaM gANDIvaM phalgunasya cha |
yatte raktau purA bhUtvA pANI kRRitakiNAvubhau
shlokas.2:
sabhAyAM sma virATasya karomi kadanaM mahat |
tatra mAM dharmarAjastu kaTAkSheNa nyavArayat
tadahaM tasya vij~nAya sthita evAsmi bhAmini
shlokas.3:
yachcha rAShTrAtprachyavanaM kurUNAmavadhashcha yaH |
suyodhanasya karNasya shakuneH saubalasya cha
shlokas.4:
duHshAsanasya pApasya yanmayA na hRRitaM shiraH |
tanme dahati kalyANi hRRidi shalyamivArpitam
mA dharmaM jahi sushroNi krodhaM jahi mahAmate
shlokas.5:
imaM cha samupAlambhaM tvatto rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
shRRiNuyAdyadi kalyANi kRRitsnaM jahyAtsa jIvitam
shlokas.6:
dhana~njayo vA sushroNi yamau vA tanumadhyame |
lokAntaragateShveShu nAhaM shakShyAmi jIvitum
shlokas.7:
sukanyA nAma shAryAtI bhArgavaM chyavanaM vane |
valmIkabhUtaM shAmyantamanvapadyata bhAminI
shlokas.8:
nADAyanI chendrasenA rUpeNa yadi te shrutA |
patimanvacharadvRRiddhaM purA varShasahasriNam
shlokas.9:
duhitA janakasyApi vaidehI yadi te shrutA |
patimanvacharatsItA mahAraNyanivAsinam
shlokas.10:
rakShasA nigrahaM prApya rAmasya mahiShI priyA |
klishyamAnApi sushroNI rAmamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.11:
lopAmudrA tathA bhIru vayorUpasamanvitA |
agastyamanvayAddhitvA kAmAnsarvAnamAnuShAn
shlokas.12:
yathaitAH kIrtitA nAryo rUpavatyaH pativratAH |
tathA tvamapi kalyANi sarvaiH samuditA guNaiH
shlokas.13:
mAdIrghaM kShama kAlaM tvaM mAsamadhyardhasaMmitam |
pUrNe trayodashe varShe rAj~no rAj~nI bhaviShyasi
shlokas.14:
draupadyuvAcha||
ArtayaitanmayA bhIma kRRitaM bAShpavimokShaNam |
apArayantyA duHkhAni na rAjAnamupAlabhe
shlokas.15:
vimuktena vyatItena bhImasena mahAbala |
pratyupasthitakAlasya kAryasyAnantaro bhava
shlokas.16:
mameha bhIma kaikeyI rUpAbhibhavasha~NkayA |
nityamudvijate rAjA kathaM neyAdimAmiti
shlokas.17:
tasyA viditvA taM bhAvaM svayaM chAnRRitadarshanaH |
kIchako.ayaM suduShTAtmA sadA prArthayate hi mAm
shlokas.18:
tamahaM kupitA bhIma punaH kopaM niyamya cha |
abruvaM kAmasaMmUDhamAtmAnaM rakSha kIchaka
shlokas.19:
gandharvANAmahaM bhAryA pa~nchAnAM mahiShI priyA |
te tvAM nihanyurdurdharShAH shUrAH sAhasakAriNaH
shlokas.20:
evamuktaH sa duShTAtmA kIchakaH pratyuvAcha ha |
nAhaM bibhemi sairandhri gandharvANAM shuchismite
shlokas.21:
shataM sahasramapi vA gandharvANAmahaM raNe |
samAgataM haniShyAmi tvaM bhIru kuru me kShaNam
shlokas.22:
ityukte chAbruvaM sUtaM kAmAturamahaM punaH |
na tvaM pratibalasteShAM gandharvANAM yashasvinAm
shlokas.23:
dharme sthitAsmi satataM kulashIlasamanvitA |
nechChAmi ka~nchidvadhyantaM tena jIvasi kIchaka
shlokas.24:
evamuktaH sa duShTAtmA prahasya svanavattadA |
na tiShThati sma sanmArge na cha dharmaM bubhUShati
shlokas.25:
pApAtmA pApabhAvashcha kAmarAgavashAnugaH |
avinItashcha duShTAtmA pratyAkhyAtaH punaH punaH
darshane darshane hanyAttathA jahyAM cha jIvitam
shlokas.26:
taddharme yatamAnAnAM mahAndharmo nashiShyati |
samayaM rakShamANAnAM bhAryA vo na bhaviShyati
shlokas.27:
bhAryAyAM rakShyamANAyAM prajA bhavati rakShitA |
prajAyAM rakShyamANAyAmAtmA bhavati rakShitaH
shlokas.28:
vadatAM varNadharmA.nshcha brAhmaNAnAM hi me shrutam |
kShatriyasya sadA dharmo nAnyaH shatrunibarhaNAt
shlokas.29:
pashyato dharmarAjasya kIchako mAM padAvadhIt |
tava chaiva samakShaM vai bhImasena mahAbala
shlokas.30:
tvayA hyahaM paritrAtA tasmAdghorAjjaTAsurAt |
jayadrathaM tathaiva tvamajaiShIrbhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.31:
jahImamapi pApaM tvaM yo.ayaM mAmavamanyate |
kIchako rAjavAllabhyAchChokakRRinmama bhArata
shlokas.32:
tamevaM kAmasaMmattaM bhindhi kumbhamivAshmani |
yo nimittamanarthAnAM bahUnAM mama bhArata
shlokas.33:
taM chejjIvantamAdityaH prAtarabhyudayiShyati |
viShamAloDya pAsyAmi mA kIchakavashaM gamam
shreyo hi maraNaM mahyaM bhImasena tavAgrataH
shlokas.34:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA prArudatkRRiShNA bhImasyoraH samAshritA |
bhImashcha tAM pariShvajya mahatsAntvaM prayujya cha
kIchakaM manasAgachChatsRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan

shlokas.1:
bhImasena uvAcha||
tathA bhadre kariShyAmi yathA tvaM bhIru bhAShase |
adya taM sUdayiShyAmi kIchakaM sahabAndhavam
shlokas.2:
asyAH pradoShe sharvaryAH kuruShvAnena sa~Ngamam |
duHkhaM shokaM cha nirdhUya yAj~naseni shuchismite
shlokas.3:
yaiShA nartanashAlA vai matsyarAjena kAritA |
divAtra kanyA nRRityanti rAtrau yAnti yathAgRRiham
shlokas.4:
tatrAsti shayanaM bhIru dRRiDhA~NgaM supratiShThitam |
tatrAsya darshayiShyAmi pUrvapretAnpitAmahAn
shlokas.5:
yathA cha tvAM na pashyeyuH kurvANAM tena sa.nvidam |
kuryAstathA tvaM kalyANi yathA saMnihito bhavet
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA tau kathayitvA tu bAShpamutsRRijya duHkhitau |
rAtrisheShaM tadatyugraM dhArayAmAsaturhRRidA
shlokas.7:
tasyAM rAtryAM vyatItAyAM prAtarutthAya kIchakaH |
gatvA rAjakulAyaiva draupadImidamabravIt
shlokas.8:
sabhAyAM pashyato rAj~naH pAtayitvA padAhanam |
na chaivAlabhathAstrANamabhipannA balIyasA
shlokas.9:
pravAdena hi matsyAnAM rAjA nAmnAyamuchyate |
ahameva hi matsyAnAM rAjA vai vAhinIpatiH
shlokas.10:
sA sukhaM pratipadyasva dAso bhIru bhavAmi te |
ahnAya tava sushroNi shataM niShkAndadAmyaham
shlokas.11:
dAsIshataM cha te dadyAM dAsAnAmapi chAparam |
rathaM chAshvatarIyuktamastu nau bhIru sa~NgamaH
shlokas.12:
draupadyuvAcha||
ekaM me samayaM tvadya pratipadyasva kIchaka |
na tvAM sakhA vA bhrAtA vA jAnIyAtsa~NgataM mayA
shlokas.13:
avabodhAddhi bhItAsmi gandharvANAM yashasvinAm |
evaM me pratijAnIhi tato.ahaM vashagA tava
shlokas.14:
kIchaka uvAcha||
evametatkariShyAmi yathA sushroNi bhAShase |
eko bhadre gamiShyAmi shUnyamAvasathaM tava
shlokas.15:
samAgamArthaM rambhoru tvayA madanamohitaH |
yathA tvAM nAvabhotsyanti gandharvAH sUryavarchasaH
shlokas.16:
draupadyuvAcha||
yadidaM nartanAgAraM matsyarAjena kAritam |
divAtra kanyA nRRityanti rAtrau yAnti yathAgRRiham
shlokas.17:
tamisre tatra gachChethA gandharvAstanna jAnate |
tatra doShaH parihRRito bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tamarthaM pratijalpantyAH kRRiShNAyAH kIchakena ha |
divasArdhaM samabhavanmAsenaiva samaM nRRipa
shlokas.19:
kIchako.atha gRRihaM gatvA bhRRishaM harShapariplutaH |
sairandhrIrUpiNaM mUDho mRRityuM taM nAvabuddhavAn
shlokas.20:
gandhAbharaNamAlyeShu vyAsaktaH sa visheShataH |
ala~nchakAra so.a.atmAnaM satvaraH kAmamohitaH
shlokas.21:
tasya tatkurvataH karma kAlo dIrgha ivAbhavat |
anuchintayatashchApi tAmevAyatalochanAm
shlokas.22:
AsIdabhyadhikA chAsya shrIH shriyaM pramumukShataH |
nirvANakAle dIpasya vartImiva didhakShataH
shlokas.23:
kRRitasampratyayastatra kIchakaH kAmamohitaH |
nAjAnAddivasaM yAntaM chintayAnaH samAgamam
shlokas.24:
tatastu draupadI gatvA tadA bhImaM mahAnase |
upAtiShThata kalyANI kauravyaM patimantikAt
shlokas.25:
tamuvAcha sukeshAntA kIchakasya mayA kRRitaH |
sa~Ngamo nartanAgAre yathAvochaH parantapa
shlokas.26:
shUnyaM sa nartanAgAramAgamiShyati kIchakaH |
eko nishi mahAbAho kIchakaM taM niShUdaya
shlokas.27:
taM sUtaputraM kaunteya kIchakaM madadarpitam |
gatvA tvaM nartanAgAraM nirjIvaM kuru pANDava
shlokas.28:
darpAchcha sUtaputro.asau gandharvAnavamanyate |
taM tvaM praharatAM shreShTha naDaM nAga ivoddhara
shlokas.29:
ashru duHkhAbhibhUtAyA mama mArjasva bhArata |
Atmanashchaiva bhadraM te kuru mAnaM kulasya cha
shlokas.30:
bhImasena uvAcha||
svAgataM te varArohe yanmA vedayase priyam |
na hyasya ka~nchidichChAmi sahAyaM varavarNini
shlokas.31:
yA me prItistvayAkhyAtA kIchakasya samAgame |
hatvA hiDimbaM sA prItirmamAsIdvaravarNini
shlokas.32:
satyaM bhrAtR^I.nshcha dharmaM cha puraskRRitya bravImi te |
kIchakaM nihaniShyAmi vRRitraM devapatiryathA
shlokas.33:
taM gahvare prakAshe vA pothayiShyAmi kIchakam |
atha chedavabhotsyanti ha.nsye matsyAnapi dhruvam
shlokas.34:
tato duryodhanaM hatvA pratipatsye vasundharAm |
kAmaM matsyamupAstAM hi kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.35:
draupadyuvAcha||
yathA na santyajethAstvaM satyaM vai matkRRite vibho |
nigUDhastvaM tathA vIra kIchakaM vinipAtaya
shlokas.36:
bhImasena uvAcha||
evametatkariShyAmi yathA tvaM bhIru bhAShase |
adRRishyamAnastasyAdya tamasvinyAmanindite
shlokas.37:
nAgo bilvamivAkramya pothayiShyAmyahaM shiraH |
alabhyAmichChatastasya kIchakasya durAtmanaH
shlokas.38:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhImo.atha prathamaM gatvA rAtrau Channa upAvishat |
mRRigaM haririvAdRRishyaH pratyAkA~NkShatsa kIchakam
shlokas.39:
kIchakashchApyala~NkRRitya yathAkAmamupAvrajat |
tAM velAM nartanAgAre pA~nchAlIsa~NgamAshayA
shlokas.40:
manyamAnaH sa sa~NketamAgAraM prAvishachcha tam |
pravishya cha sa tadveshma tamasA sa.nvRRitaM mahat
shlokas.41:
pUrvAgataM tatastatra bhImamapratimaujasam |
ekAntamAsthitaM chainamAsasAda sudurmatiH
shlokas.42:
shayAnaM shayane tatra mRRityuM sUtaH parAmRRishat |
jAjvalyamAnaM kopena kRRiShNAdharShaNajena ha
shlokas.43:
upasa~Ngamya chaivainaM kIchakaH kAmamohitaH |
harShonmathitachittAtmA smayamAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.44:
prApitaM te mayA vittaM bahurUpamanantakam |
tatsarvaM tvAM samuddishya sahasA samupAgataH
shlokas.45:
nAkasmAnmAM prasha.nsanti sadA gRRihagatAH striyaH |
suvAsA darshanIyashcha nAnyo.asti tvAdRRishaH pumAn
shlokas.46:
bhImasena uvAcha||
diShTyA tvaM darshanIyo.asi diShTyAtmAnaM prasha.nsasi |
IdRRishastu tvayA sparshaH spRRiShTapUrvo na karhichit
shlokas.47:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA taM mahAbAhurbhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
samutpatya cha kaunteyaH prahasya cha narAdhamam
bhImo jagrAha kesheShu mAlyavatsu sugandhiShu
shlokas.48:
sa kesheShu parAmRRiShTo balena balinAM varaH |
AkShipya keshAnvegena bAhvorjagrAha pANDavam
shlokas.50:
IShadAgalitaM chApi krodhAchchalapadaM sthitam |
kIchako balavAnbhImaM jAnubhyAmAkShipadbhuvi
shlokas.51:
pAtito bhuvi bhImastu kIchakena balIyasA |
utpapAtAtha vegena daNDAhata ivoragaH
shlokas.52:
spardhayA cha balonmattau tAvubhau sUtapANDavau |
nishIthe paryakarShetAM balinau nishi nirjane
shlokas.53:
tatastadbhavanashreShThaM prAkampata muhurmuhuH |
balavachchApi sa~NkruddhAvanyonyaM tAvagarjatAm
shlokas.54:
talAbhyAM tu sa bhImena vakShasyabhihato balI |
kIchako roShasantaptaH padAnna chalitaH padam
shlokas.55:
muhUrtaM tu sa taM vegaM sahitvA bhuvi duHsaham |
balAdahIyata tadA sUto bhImabalArditaH
shlokas.56:
taM hIyamAnaM vij~nAya bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
vakShasyAnIya vegena mamanthainaM vichetasam
shlokas.57:
krodhAviShTo viniHshvasya punashchainaM vRRikodaraH |
jagrAha jayatAM shreShThaH kesheShveva tadA bhRRisham
shlokas.58:
gRRihItvA kIchakaM bhImo virurAva mahAbalaH |
shArdUlaH pishitAkA~NkShI gRRihItveva mahAmRRigam
shlokas.59:
tasya pAdau cha pANI cha shiro grIvAM cha sarvashaH |
kAye praveshayAmAsa pashoriva pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.60:
taM saMmathitasarvA~NgaM mA.nsapiNDopamaM kRRitam |
kRRiShNAyai darshayAmAsa bhImaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.61:
uvAcha cha mahAtejA draupadIM pANDunandanaH |
pashyainamehi pA~nchAli kAmuko.ayaM yathA kRRitaH
shlokas.62:
tathA sa kIchakaM hatvA gatvA roShasya vai shamam |
Amantrya draupadIM kRRiShNAM kShipramAyAnmahAnasam
shlokas.63:
kIchakaM ghAtayitvA tu draupadI yoShitAM varA |
prahRRiShTA gatasantApA sabhApAlAnuvAcha ha
shlokas.64:
kIchako.ayaM hataH shete gandharvaiH patibhirmama |
parastrIkAmasaMmattaH samAgachChata pashyata
shlokas.65:
tachChrutvA bhAShitaM tasyA nartanAgArarakShiNaH |
sahasaiva samAjagmurAdAyolkAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.66:
tato gatvAtha tadveshma kIchakaM vinipAtitam |
gatAsuM dadRRishurbhUmau rudhireNa samukShitam
shlokas.67:
kvAsya grIvA kva charaNau kva pANI kva shirastathA |
iti sma taM parIkShante gandharveNa hataM tadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminkAle samAgamya sarve tatrAsya bAndhavAH |
ruruduH kIchakaM dRRiShTvA parivArya samantataH
shlokas.2:
sarve saMhRRiShTaromANaH santrastAH prekShya kIchakam |
tathA sarvA~NgasambhugnaM kUrmaM sthala ivoddhRRitam
shlokas.3:
pothitaM bhImasenena tamindreNeva dAnavam |
sa.nskArayitumichChanto bahirnetuM prachakramuH
shlokas.4:
dadRRishuste tataH kRRiShNAM sUtaputrAH samAgatAH |
adUrAdanavadyA~NgIM stambhamAli~Ngya tiShThatIm
shlokas.5:
samaveteShu sUteShu tAnuvAchopakIchakaH |
hanyatAM shIghramasatI yatkRRite kIchako hataH
shlokas.6:
atha vA neha hantavyA dahyatAM kAminA saha |
mRRitasyApi priyaM kAryaM sUtaputrasya sarvathA
shlokas.7:
tato virATamUchuste kIchako.asyAH kRRite hataH |
sahAdyAnena dahyeta tadanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.8:
parAkramaM tu sUtAnAM matvA rAjAnvamodata |
sairandhryAH sUtaputreNa saha dAhaM vishAM pate
shlokas.9:
tAM samAsAdya vitrastAM kRRiShNAM kamalalochanAm |
momuhyamAnAM te tatra jagRRihuH kIchakA bhRRisham
shlokas.10:
tatastu tAM samAropya nibadhya cha sumadhyamAm |
jagmurudyamya te sarve shmashAnamabhitastadA
shlokas.11:
hriyamANA tu sA rAjansUtaputrairaninditA |
prAkroshannAthamichChantI kRRiShNA nAthavatI satI
shlokas.12:
draupadyuvAcha||
jayo jayanto vijayo jayatseno jayadbalaH |
te me vAchaM vijAnantu sUtaputrA nayanti mAm
shlokas.13:
yeShAM jyAtalanirghoSho visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
vyashrUyata mahAyuddhe bhImaghoShastarasvinAm
shlokas.14:
rathaghoShashcha balavAngandharvANAM yashasvinAm |
te me vAchaM vijAnantu sUtaputrA nayanti mAm
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasyAstAH kRRipaNA vAchaH kRRiShNAyAH paridevitAH |
shrutvaivAbhyapatadbhImaH shayanAdavichArayan
shlokas.16:
bhImasena uvAcha||
ahaM shRRiNomi te vAchaM tvayA sairandhri bhAShitAm |
tasmAtte sUtaputrebhyo na bhayaM bhIru vidyate
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA sa mahAbAhurvijajRRimbhe jighA.nsayA |
tataH sa vyAyataM kRRitvA veShaM viparivartya cha
advAreNAbhyavaskandya nirjagAma bahistadA
shlokas.18:
sa bhImasenaH prAkArAdArujya tarasA drumam |
shmashAnAbhimukhaH prAyAdyatra te kIchakA gatAH
shlokas.19:
sa taM vRRikShaM dashavyAmaM saskandhaviTapaM balI |
pragRRihyAbhyadravatsUtAndaNDapANirivAntakaH
shlokas.20:
Uruvegena tasyAtha nyagrodhAshvatthaki.nshukAH |
bhUmau nipatitA vRRikShAH sa~Nghashastatra sherate
shlokas.21:
taM siMhamiva sa~NkruddhaM dRRiShTvA gandharvamAgatam |
vitresuH sarvataH sUtA viShAdabhayakampitAH
shlokas.22:
tamantakamivAyAntaM gandharvaM prekShya te tadA |
didhakShantastadA jyeShThaM bhrAtaraM hyupakIchakAH
parasparamathochuste viShAdabhayakampitAH
shlokas.23:
gandharvo balavAneti kruddha udyamya pAdapam |
sairandhrI muchyatAM shIghraM mahanno bhayamAgatam
shlokas.24:
te tu dRRiShTvA tamAviddhaM bhImasenena pAdapam |
vimuchya draupadIM tatra prAdravannagaraM prati
shlokas.25:
dravatastA.nstu samprekShya sa vajrI dAnavAniva |
shataM pa~nchAdhikaM bhImaH prAhiNodyamasAdanam
shlokas.26:
tata AshvAsayatkRRiShNAM pravimuchya vishAM pate |
uvAcha cha mahAbAhuH pA~nchAlIM tatra draupadIm
ashrupUrNamukhIM dInAM durdharShaH sa vRRikodaraH
shlokas.27:
evaM te bhIru vadhyante ye tvAM klishyantyanAgasam |
praihi tvaM nagaraM kRRiShNe na bhayaM vidyate tava
anyenAhaM gamiShyAmi virATasya mahAnasam
shlokas.28:
pa~nchAdhikaM shataM tachcha nihataM tatra bhArata |
mahAvanamiva ChinnaM shishye vigalitadrumam
shlokas.29:
evaM te nihatA rAja~nshataM pa~ncha cha kIchakAH |
sa cha senApatiH pUrvamityetatsUtaShaTshatam
shlokas.30:
taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyaM narA nAryashcha sa~NgatAH |
vismayaM paramaM gatvA nochuH ki~nchana bhArata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te dRRiShTvA nihatAnsUtAnrAj~ne gatvA nyavedayan |
gandharvairnihatA rAjansUtaputrAH paraHshatAH
shlokas.2:
yathA vajreNa vai dIrNaM parvatasya mahachChiraH |
vinikIrNaM pradRRishyeta tathA sUtA mahItale
shlokas.3:
sairandhrI cha vimuktAsau punarAyAti te gRRiham |
sarvaM sa.nshayitaM rAjannagaraM te bhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
tathArUpA hi sairandhrI gandharvAshcha mahAbalAH |
pu.nsAmiShTashcha viShayo maithunAya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
yathA sairandhriveSheNa na te rAjannidaM puram |
vinAshameti vai kShipraM tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.6:
teShAM tadvachanaM shrutvA virATo vAhinIpatiH |
abravItkriyatAmeShAM sUtAnAM paramakriyA
shlokas.7:
ekasminneva te sarve susamiddhe hutAshane |
dahyantAM kIchakAH shIghraM ratnairgandhaishcha sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
sudeShNAM chAbravIdrAjA mahiShIM jAtasAdhvasaH |
sairandhrImAgatAM brUyA mamaiva vachanAdidam
shlokas.9:
gachCha sairandhri bhadraM te yathAkAmaM charAbale |
bibheti rAjA sushroNi gandharvebhyaH parAbhavAt
shlokas.10:
na hi tAmutsahe vaktuM svayaM gandharvarakShitAm |
striyastvadoShAstAM vaktumatastvAM prabravImyaham
shlokas.11:
atha muktA bhayAtkRRiShNA sUtaputrAnnirasya cha |
mokShitA bhImasenena jagAma nagaraM prati
shlokas.12:
trAsiteva mRRigI bAlA shArdUlena manasvinI |
gAtrANi vAsasI chaiva prakShAlya salilena sA
shlokas.13:
tAM dRRiShTvA puruShA rAjanprAdravanta disho dasha |
gandharvANAM bhayatrastAH kechiddRRiShTIrnyamIlayan
shlokas.14:
tato mahAnasadvAri bhImasenamavasthitam |
dadarsha rAjanpA~nchAlI yathA mattaM mahAdvipam
shlokas.15:
taM vismayantI shanakaiH sa~nj~nAbhiridamabravIt |
gandharvarAjAya namo yenAsmi parimochitA
shlokas.16:
bhImasena uvAcha||
ye yasyA vicharantIha puruShA vashavartinaH |
tasyAste vachanaM shrutvA anRRiNA vicharantyuta
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sA nartanAgAre dhana~njayamapashyata |
rAj~naH kanyA virATasya nartayAnaM mahAbhujam
shlokas.18:
tatastA nartanAgArAdviniShkramya sahArjunAH |
kanyA dadRRishurAyAntIM kRRiShNAM kliShTAmanAgasam
shlokas.19:
kanyA UchuH||
diShTyA sairandhri muktAsi diShTyAsi punarAgatA |
diShTyA vinihatAH sUtA ye tvAM klishyantyanAgasam
shlokas.20:
bRRihannaDovAcha||
kathaM sairandhri muktAsi kathaM pApAshcha te hatAH |
ichChAmi vai tava shrotuM sarvameva yathAtatham
shlokas.21:
sairandhryuvAcha||
bRRihannaDe kiM nu tava sairandhryA kAryamadya vai |
yA tvaM vasasi kalyANi sadA kanyApure sukham
shlokas.22:
na hi duHkhaM samApnoShi sairandhrI yadupAshnute |
tena mAM duHkhitAmevaM pRRichChase prahasanniva
shlokas.23:
bRRihannaDovAcha||
bRRihannaDApi kalyANi duHkhamApnotyanuttamam |
tiryagyonigatA bAle na chainAmavabudhyase
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sahaiva kanyAbhirdraupadI rAjaveshma tat |
pravivesha sudeShNAyAH samIpamapalAyinI
shlokas.25:
tAmabravIdrAjaputrI virATavachanAdidam |
sairandhri gamyatAM shIghraM yatra kAmayase gatim
shlokas.26:
rAjA bibheti bhadraM te gandharvebhyaH parAbhavAt |
tvaM chApi taruNI subhru rUpeNApratimA bhuvi
shlokas.27:
sairandhryuvAcha||
trayodashAhamAtraM me rAjA kShamatu bhAmini |
kRRitakRRityA bhaviShyanti gandharvAste na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.28:
tato mAM te.apaneShyanti kariShyanti cha te priyam |
dhruvaM cha shreyasA rAjA yokShyate saha bAndhavaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kIchakasya tu ghAtena sAnujasya vishAM pate |
atyAhitaM chintayitvA vyasmayanta pRRithagjanAH
shlokas.2:
tasminpure janapade sa~njalpo.abhUchcha sarvashaH |
shauryAddhi vallabho rAj~no mahAsattvashcha kIchakaH
shlokas.3:
AsItprahartA cha nRRiNAM dArAmarshI cha durmatiH |
sa hataH khalu pApAtmA gandharvairduShTapUruShaH
shlokas.4:
ityajalpanmahArAja parAnIkavishAtanam |
deshe deshe manuShyAshcha kIchakaM duShpradharShaNam
shlokas.5:
atha vai dhArtarAShTreNa prayuktA ye bahishcharAH |
mRRigayitvA bahUngrAmAnrAShTrANi nagarANi cha
shlokas.6:
sa.nvidhAya yathAdiShTaM yathAdeshapradarshanam |
kRRitachintA nyavartanta te cha nAgapuraM prati
shlokas.7:
tatra dRRiShTvA tu rAjAnaM kauravyaM dhRRitarAShTrajam |
droNakarNakRRipaiH sArdhaM bhIShmeNa cha mahAtmanA
shlokas.8:
sa~NgataM bhrAtRRibhishchApi trigartaishcha mahArathaiH |
duryodhanaM sabhAmadhye AsInamidamabruvan
shlokas.9:
kRRito.asmAbhiH paro yatnasteShAmanveShaNe sadA |
pANDavAnAM manuShyendra tasminmahati kAnane
shlokas.10:
nirjane mRRigasa~NkIrNe nAnAdrumalatAvRRite |
latApratAnabahule nAnAgulmasamAvRRite
shlokas.11:
na cha vidmo gatA yena pArthAH syurdRRiDhavikramAH |
mArgamANAH padanyAsaM teShu teShu tathA tathA
shlokas.12:
girikUTeShu tu~NgeShu nAnAjanapadeShu cha |
janAkIrNeShu desheShu kharvaTeShu pureShu cha
shlokas.13:
narendra bahusho.anviShTA naiva vidmashcha pANDavAn |
atyantabhAvaM naShTAste bhadraM tubhyaM nararShabha
shlokas.14:
vartmAnyanviShyamANAstu rathAnAM rathasattama |
ka~nchitkAlaM manuShyendra sUtAnAmanugA vayam
shlokas.15:
mRRigayitvA yathAnyAyaM viditArthAH sma tattvataH |
prAptA dvAravatIM sUtA RRite pArthaiH parantapa
shlokas.16:
na tatra pANDavA rAjannApi kRRiShNA pativratA |
sarvathA vipranaShTAste namaste bharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
na hi vidmo gatiM teShAM vAsaM vApi mahAtmanAm |
pANDavAnAM pravRRittiM vA vidmaH karmApi vA kRRitam
sa naH shAdhi manuShyendra ata UrdhvaM vishAM pate
shlokas.18:
anveShaNe pANDavAnAM bhUyaH kiM karavAmahe |
imAM cha naH priyAmIkSha vAchaM bhadravatIM shubhAm
shlokas.19:
yena trigartA nikRRitA balena mahatA nRRipa |
sUtena rAj~no matsyasya kIchakena mahAtmanA
shlokas.20:
sa hataH patitaH shete gandharvairnishi bhArata |
adRRishyamAnairduShTAtmA saha bhrAtRRibhirachyuta
shlokas.21:
priyametadupashrutya shatrUNAM tu parAbhavam |
kRRitakRRityashcha kauravya vidhatsva yadanantaram

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato duryodhano rAjA shrutvA teShAM vachastadA |
chiramantarmanA bhUtvA pratyuvAcha sabhAsadaH
shlokas.2:
suduHkhA khalu kAryANAM gatirvij~nAtumantataH |
tasmAtsarve udIkShadhvaM kva nu syuH pANDavA gatAH
shlokas.3:
alpAvashiShTaM kAlasya gatabhUyiShThamantataH |
teShAmaj~nAtacharyAyAmasminvarShe trayodashe
shlokas.4:
asya varShasya sheShaM chedvyatIyuriha pANDavAH |
nivRRittasamayAste hi satyavrataparAyaNAH
shlokas.5:
kSharanta iva nAgendrAH sarva AshIviShopamAH |
duHkhA bhaveyuH sa.nrabdhAH kauravAnprati te dhruvam
shlokas.6:
arvAkkAlasya vij~nAtAH kRRichChrarUpadharAH punaH |
pravisheyurjitakrodhAstAvadeva punarvanam
shlokas.7:
tasmAtkShipraM bubhutsadhvaM yathA no.atyantamavyayam |
rAjyaM nirdvandvamavyagraM niHsapatnaM chiraM bhavet
shlokas.8:
athAbravIttataH karNaH kShipraM gachChantu bhArata |
anye dhUrtatarA dakShA nibhRRitAH sAdhukAriNaH
shlokas.9:
charantu deshAnsa.nvItAH sphItA~njanapadAkulAn |
tatra goShThIShvathAnyAsu siddhapravrajiteShu cha
shlokas.10:
parichAreShu tIrtheShu vividheShvAkareShu cha |
vij~nAtavyA manuShyaistaistarkayA suvinItayA
shlokas.11:
vividhaistatparaiH samyaktajj~nairnipuNasa.nvRRitaiH |
anveShTavyAshcha nipuNaM pANDavAshChannavAsinaH
shlokas.12:
nadIku~njeShu tIrtheShu grAmeShu nagareShu cha |
AshrameShu cha ramyeShu parvateShu guhAsu cha
shlokas.13:
athAgrajAnantarajaH pApabhAvAnurAgiNam |
jyeShThaM duHshAsanastatra bhrAtA bhrAtaramabravIt
shlokas.14:
etachcha karNo yatprAha sarvamIkShAmahe tathA |
yathoddiShTaM charAH sarve mRRigayantu tatastataH
ete chAnye cha bhUyA.nso deshAddeshaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.15:
na tu teShAM gatirvAsaH pravRRittishchopalabhyate |
atyAhitaM vA gUDhAste pAraM vormimato gatAH
shlokas.16:
vyAlairvApi mahAraNye bhakShitAH shUramAninaH |
atha vA viShamaM prApya vinaShTAH shAshvatIH samAH
shlokas.17:
tasmAnmAnasamavyagraM kRRitvA tvaM kurunandana |
kuru kAryaM yathotsAhaM manyase yannarAdhipa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAbravInmahAvIryo droNastattvArthadarshivAn |
na tAdRRishA vinashyanti nApi yAnti parAbhavam
shlokas.2:
shUrAshcha kRRitavidyAshcha buddhimanto jitendriyAH |
dharmaj~nAshcha kRRitaj~nAshcha dharmarAjamanuvratAH
shlokas.3:
nItidharmArthatattvaj~naM pitRRivachcha samAhitam |
dharme sthitaM satyadhRRitiM jyeShThaM jyeShThApachAyinam
shlokas.4:
anuvratA mahAtmAnaM bhrAtaraM bhrAtaro nRRipa |
ajAtashatruM hrImantaM taM cha bhrAtR^Inanuvratam
shlokas.5:
teShAM tathA vidheyAnAM nibhRRitAnAM mahAtmanAm |
kimarthaM nItimAnpArthaH shreyo naiShAM kariShyati
shlokas.6:
tasmAdyatnAtpratIkShante kAlasyodayamAgatam |
na hi te nAshamRRichCheyuriti pashyAmyahaM dhiyA
shlokas.7:
sAmprataM chaiva yatkAryaM tachcha kShipramakAlikam |
kriyatAM sAdhu sa~nchintya vAsashchaiShAM prachintyatAm
shlokas.8:
yathAvatpANDuputrANAM sarvArtheShu dhRRitAtmanAm |
