durj~neyAH khalu shUrAste apApAstapasA vRRitAH
shlokas.9:
shuddhAtmA guNavAnpArthaH satyavAnnItimA~nshuchiH |
tejorAshirasa~Nkhyeyo gRRihNIyAdapi chakShuShI
shlokas.10:
vij~nAya kriyatAM tasmAdbhUyashcha mRRigayAmahe |
brAhmaNaishchArakaiH siddhairye chAnye tadvido janAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmo bharatAnAM pitAmahaH |
shrutavAndeshakAlaj~nastattvaj~naH sarvadharmavit
shlokas.2:
AchAryavAkyoparame tadvAkyamabhisa.ndadhat |
hitArthaM sa uvAchemAM bhAratIM bhAratAnprati
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThire samAsaktAM dharmaj~ne dharmasa.nshritAm |
asatsu durlabhAM nityaM satAM chAbhimatAM sadA
bhIShmaH samavadattatra giraM sAdhubhirarchitAm
shlokas.4:
yathaiSha brAhmaNaH prAha droNaH sarvArthatattvavit |
sarvalakShaNasampannA nAshaM nArhanti pANDavAH
shlokas.5:
shrutavRRittopasampannAH sAdhuvratasamanvitAH |
vRRiddhAnushAsane magnAH satyavrataparAyaNAH
shlokas.6:
samayaM samayaj~nAste pAlayantaH shuchivratAH |
nAvasIditumarhanti udvahantaH satAM dhuram
shlokas.7:
dharmatashchaiva guptAste svavIryeNa cha pANDavAH |
na nAshamadhigachCheyuriti me dhIyate matiH
shlokas.8:
tatra buddhiM praNeShyAmi pANDavAnprati bhArata |
na tu nItiH sunItasya shakyate.anveShituM paraiH
shlokas.9:
yattu shakyamihAsmAbhistAnvai sa~nchintya pANDavAn |
buddhyA pravaktuM na drohAtpravakShyAmi nibodha tat
shlokas.10:
sA tviyaM sAdhu vaktavyA na tvanItiH katha~nchana |
vRRiddhAnushAsane tAta tiShThataH satyashIlinaH
shlokas.11:
avashyaM tviha dhIreNa satAM madhye vivakShatA |
yathAmati vivaktavyaM sarvasho dharmalipsayA
shlokas.12:
tatra nAhaM tathA manye yathAyamitaro janaH |
pure janapade vApi yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.13:
nAsUyako na chApIrShurnAtivAdI na matsarI |
bhaviShyati janastatra svaM svaM dharmamanuvrataH
shlokas.14:
brahmaghoShAshcha bhUyA.nsaH pUrNAhutyastathaiva cha |
kratavashcha bhaviShyanti bhUyA.nso bhUridakShiNAH
shlokas.15:
sadA cha tatra parjanyaH samyagvarShI na sa.nshayaH |
sampannasasyA cha mahI nirItIkA bhaviShyati
shlokas.16:
rasavanti cha dhAnyAni guNavanti phalAni cha |
gandhavanti cha mAlyAni shubhashabdA cha bhAratI
shlokas.17:
vAyushcha sukhasa.nsparsho niShpratIpaM cha darshanam |
bhayaM nAbhyAvishettatra yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.18:
gAvashcha bahulAstatra na kRRishA na cha durduhAH |
payA.nsi dadhisarpIMShi rasavanti hitAni cha
shlokas.19:
guNavanti cha pAnAni bhojyAni rasavanti cha |
tatra deshe bhaviShyanti yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.20:
rasAH sparshAshcha gandhAshcha shabdAshchApi guNAnvitAH |
dRRishyAni cha prasannAni yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.21:
svaiH svairguNaiH susa.nyuktAstasminvarShe trayodashe |
deshe tasminbhaviShyanti tAta pANDavasa.nyute
shlokas.22:
samprItimA~njanastatra santuShTaH shuchiravyayaH |
devatAtithipUjAsu sarvabhUtAnurAgavAn
shlokas.23:
iShTadAno mahotsAhaH shashvaddharmaparAyaNaH |
ashubhadviTshubhaprepsurnityayaj~naH shubhavrataH
bhaviShyati janastatra yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.24:
tyaktavAkyAnRRitastAta shubhakalyANama~NgalaH |
shubhArthepsuH shubhamatiryatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
bhaviShyati janastatra nityaM cheShTapriyavrataH
shlokas.25:
dharmAtmA sa tadAdRRishyaH so.api tAta dvijAtibhiH |
kiM punaH prAkRRitaiH pArthaH shakyo vij~nAtumantataH
shlokas.26:
yasminsatyaM dhRRitirdAnaM parA shAntirdhruvA kShamA |
hrIH shrIH kIrtiH paraM teja AnRRisha.nsyamathArjavam
shlokas.27:
tasmAttatra nivAsaM tu ChannaM satreNa dhImataH |
gatiM vA paramAM tasya notsahe vaktumanyathA
shlokas.28:
evametattu sa~nchintya yatkRRitaM manyase hitam |
tatkShipraM kuru kauravya yadyevaM shraddadhAsi me

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shAradvato vAkyamityuvAcha kRRipastadA |
yuktaM prAptaM cha vRRiddhena pANDavAnprati bhAShitam
shlokas.2:
dharmArthasahitaM shlakShNaM tattvatashcha sahetumat |
tatrAnurUpaM bhIShmeNa mamApyatra giraM shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
teShAM chaiva gatistIrthairvAsashchaiShAM prachintyatAm |
nItirvidhIyatAM chApi sAmprataM yA hitA bhavet
shlokas.4:
nAvaj~neyo ripustAta prAkRRito.api bubhUShatA |
kiM punaH pANDavAstAta sarvAstrakushalA raNe
shlokas.5:
tasmAtsatraM praviShTeShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
gUDhabhAveShu ChanneShu kAle chodayamAgate
shlokas.6:
svarAShTrapararAShTreShu j~nAtavyaM balamAtmanaH |
udaye pANDavAnAM cha prApte kAle na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
nivRRittasamayAH pArthA mahAtmAno mahAbalAH |
mahotsAhA bhaviShyanti pANDavA hyatitejasaH
shlokas.8:
tasmAdbalaM cha koshaM cha nItishchApi vidhIyatAm |
yathA kAlodaye prApte samyaktaiH sa.ndadhAmahe
shlokas.9:
tAta manyAmi tatsarvaM budhyasva balamAtmanaH |
niyataM sarvamitreShu balavatsvabaleShu cha
shlokas.10:
uchchAvachaM balaM j~nAtvA madhyasthaM chApi bhArata |
prahRRiShTamaprahRRiShTaM cha sa.ndadhAma tathA paraiH
shlokas.11:
sAmnA bhedena dAnena daNDena balikarmaNA |
nyAyenAnamya cha parAnbalAchchAnamya durbalAn
shlokas.12:
sAntvayitvA cha mitrANi balaM chAbhAShyatAM sukham |
sakoshabalasa.nvRRiddhaH samyaksiddhimavApsyasi
shlokas.13:
yotsyase chApi balibhiraribhiH pratyupasthitaiH |
anyaistvaM pANDavairvApi hInasvabalavAhanaiH
shlokas.14:
evaM sarvaM vinishchitya vyavasAyaM svadharmataH |
yathAkAlaM manuShyendra chiraM sukhamavApsyasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha rAjA trigartAnAM susharmA rathayUthapaH |
prAptakAlamidaM vAkyamuvAcha tvarito bhRRisham
shlokas.2:
asakRRinnikRRitaH pUrvaM matsyaiH sAlveyakaiH saha |
sUtena chaiva matsyasya kIchakena punaH punaH
shlokas.3:
bAdhito bandhubhiH sArdhaM balAdbalavatA vibho |
sa karNamabhyudIkShyAtha duryodhanamabhAShata
shlokas.4:
asakRRinmatsyarAj~nA me rAShTraM bAdhitamojasA |
praNetA kIchakashchAsya balavAnabhavatpurA
shlokas.5:
krUro.amarShI sa duShTAtmA bhuvi prakhyAtavikramaH |
nihatastatra gandharvaiH pApakarmA nRRisha.nsavAn
shlokas.6:
tasmi.nshcha nihate rAjanhInadarpo nirAshrayaH |
bhaviShyati nirutsAho virATa iti me matiH
shlokas.7:
tatra yAtrA mama matA yadi te rochate.anagha |
kauravANAM cha sarveShAM karNasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.8:
etatprAptamahaM manye kAryamAtyayikaM hitam |
rAShTraM tasyAbhiyAtvAshu bahudhAnyasamAkulam
shlokas.9:
AdadAmo.asya ratnAni vividhAni vasUni cha |
grAmAnrAShTrANi vA tasya hariShyAmo vibhAgashaH
shlokas.10:
atha vA gosahasrANi bahUni cha shubhAni cha |
vividhAni hariShyAmaH pratipIDya puraM balAt
shlokas.11:
kauravaiH saha sa~Ngamya trigartaishcha vishAM pate |
gAstasyApaharAmAshu saha sarvaiH susaMhatAH
shlokas.12:
sandhiM vA tena kRRitvA tu nibadhnImo.asya pauruSham |
hatvA chAsya chamUM kRRitsnAM vashamanvAnayAmahe
shlokas.13:
taM vashe nyAyataH kRRitvA sukhaM vatsyAmahe vayam |
bhavato balavRRiddhishcha bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.14:
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasya karNo rAjAnamabravIt |
sUktaM susharmaNA vAkyaM prAptakAlaM hitaM cha naH
shlokas.15:
tasmAtkShipraM viniryAmo yojayitvA varUthinIm |
vibhajya chApyanIkAni yathA vA manyase.anagha
shlokas.16:
praj~nAvAnkuruvRRiddho.ayaM sarveShAM naH pitAmahaH |
AchAryashcha tathA droNaH kRRipaH shAradvatastathA
shlokas.17:
manyante te yathA sarve tathA yAtrA vidhIyatAm |
saMmantrya chAshu gachChAmaH sAdhanArthaM mahIpateH
shlokas.18:
kiM cha naH pANDavaiH kAryaM hInArthabalapauruShaiH |
atyarthaM vA pranaShTAste prAptA vApi yamakShayam
shlokas.19:
yAmo rAjannanudvignA virATaviShayaM vayam |
AdAsyAmo hi gAstasya vividhAni vasUni cha
shlokas.20:
tato duryodhano rAjA vAkyamAdAya tasya tat |
vaikartanasya karNasya kShipramAj~nApayatsvayam
shlokas.21:
shAsane nityasa.nyuktaM duHshAsanamanantaram |
saha vRRiddhaistu saMmantrya kShipraM yojaya vAhinIm
shlokas.22:
yathoddeshaM cha gachChAmaH sahitAH sarvakauravaiH |
susharmA tu yathoddiShTaM deshaM yAtu mahArathaH
shlokas.23:
trigartaiH sahito rAjA samagrabalavAhanaH |
prAgeva hi susa.nvIto matsyasya viShayaM prati
shlokas.24:
jaghanyato vayaM tatra yAsyAmo divasAntaram |
viShayaM matsyarAjasya susamRRiddhaM susaMhatAH
shlokas.25:
te yAtvA sahasA tatra virATanagaraM prati |
kShipraM gopAnsamAsAdya gRRihNantu vipulaM dhanam
shlokas.26:
gavAM shatasahasrANi shrImanti guNavanti cha |
vayamapi nigRRihNImo dvidhA kRRitvA varUthinIm
shlokas.27:
sa sma gatvA yathoddiShTAM dishaM vahnermahIpatiH |
Adatta gAH susharmAtha gharmapakShasya saptamIm
shlokas.28:
aparaM divasaM sarve rAjansambhUya kauravAH |
aShTamyAM tAnyagRRihNanta gokulAni sahasrashaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatasteShAM mahArAja tatraivAmitatejasAm |
Chadmali~NgapraviShTAnAM pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.2:
vyatItaH samayaH samyagvasatAM vai purottame |
kurvatAM tasya karmANi virATasya mahIpateH
shlokas.3:
tatastrayodashasyAnte tasya varShasya bhArata |
susharmaNA gRRihItaM tu godhanaM tarasA bahu
shlokas.4:
tato javena mahatA gopAH puramathAvrajat |
apashyanmatsyarAjaM cha rathAtpraskandya kuNDalI
shlokas.5:
shUraiH parivRRitaM yodhaiH kuNDalA~NgadadhAribhiH |
sadbhishcha mantribhiH sArdhaM pANDavaishcha nararShabhaiH
shlokas.6:
taM sabhAyAM mahArAjamAsInaM rAShTravardhanam |
so.abravIdupasa~Ngamya virATaM praNatastadA
shlokas.7:
asmAnyudhi vinirjitya paribhUya sabAndhavAn |
gavAM shatasahasrANi trigartAH kAlayanti te
tAnparIpsa manuShyendra mA neshuH pashavastava
shlokas.8:
tachChrutvA nRRipatiH senAM matsyAnAM samayojayat |
rathanAgAshvakalilAM pattidhvajasamAkulAm
shlokas.9:
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha tanutrANyatra bhejire |
bhAnumanti vichitrANi sUpasevyAni bhAgashaH
shlokas.10:
savajrAyasagarbhaM tu kavachaM taptakA~nchanam |
virATasya priyo bhrAtA shatAnIko.abhyahArayat
shlokas.11:
sarvapArasavaM varma kalyANapaTalaM dRRiDham |
shatAnIkAdavarajo madirAshvo.abhyahArayat
shlokas.12:
shatasUryaM shatAvartaM shatabindu shatAkShimat |
abhedyakalpaM matsyAnAM rAjA kavachamAharat
shlokas.13:
utsedhe yasya padmAni shataM saugandhikAni cha |
suvarNapRRiShThaM sUryAbhaM sUryadatto.abhyahArayat
shlokas.14:
dRRiDhamAyasagarbhaM tu shvetaM varma shatAkShimat |
virATasya suto jyeShTho vIraH sha~Nkho.abhyahArayat
shlokas.15:
shatashashcha tanutrANi yathAsvAni mahArathAH |
yotsyamAnAbhyanahyanta devarUpAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.16:
sUpaskareShu shubhreShu mahatsu cha mahArathAH |
pRRithakkA~nchanasaMnAhAnratheShvashvAnayojayan
shlokas.17:
sUryachandrapratIkAsho rathe divye hiraNmayaH |
mahAnubhAvo matsyasya dhvaja uchChishriye tadA
shlokas.18:
athAnyAnvividhAkArAndhvajAnhemavibhUShitAn |
yathAsvaM kShatriyAH shUrA ratheShu samayojayan
shlokas.19:
atha matsyo.abravIdrAjA shatAnIkaM jaghanyajam |
ka~NkaballavagopAlA dAmagranthishcha vIryavAn
yudhyeyuriti me buddhirvartate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
eteShAmapi dIyantAM rathA dhvajapatAkinaH |
kavachAni vichitrANi dRRiDhAni cha mRRidUni cha
pratimu~nchantu gAtreShu dIyantAmAyudhAni cha
shlokas.21:
vIrA~NgarUpAH puruShA nAgarAjakaropamAH |
neme jAtu na yudhyeranniti me dhIyate matiH
shlokas.22:
etachChrutvA tu nRRipatervAkyaM tvaritamAnasaH |
shatAnIkastu pArthebhyo rathAnrAjansamAdishat
sahadevAya rAj~ne cha bhImAya nakulAya cha
shlokas.23:
tAnprahRRiShTAstataH sUtA rAjabhaktipuraskRRitAH |
nirdiShTAnnaradevena rathA~nshIghramayojayan
shlokas.24:
kavachAni vichitrANi dRRiDhAni cha mRRidUni cha |
virATaH prAdishadyAni teShAmakliShTakarmaNAm
tAnyAmuchya sharIreShu da.nshitAste parantapAH
shlokas.25:
tarasvinashChannarUpAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH |
virATamanvayuH pashchAtsahitAH kurupu~NgavAH
chatvAro bhrAtaraH shUrAH pANDavAH satyavikramAH
shlokas.26:
bhImAshcha mattamAta~NgAH prabhinnakaraTAmukhAH |
kSharanta iva jImUtAH sudantAH ShaShTihAyanAH
shlokas.27:
svArUDhA yuddhakushalaiH shikShitairhastisAdibhiH |
rAjAnamanvayuH pashchAchchalanta iva parvatAH
shlokas.28:
vishAradAnAM vashyAnAM hRRiShTAnAM chAnuyAyinAm |
aShTau rathasahasrANi dasha nAgashatAni cha
ShaShTishchAshvasahasrANi matsyAnAmabhiniryayuH
shlokas.29:
tadanIkaM virATasya shushubhe bharatarShabha |
samprayAtaM mahArAja ninIShantaM gavAM padam
shlokas.30:
tadbalAgryaM virATasya samprasthitamashobhata |
dRRiDhAyudhajanAkIrNaM gajAshvarathasa~Nkulam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
niryAya nagarAchChUrA vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH |
trigartAnaspRRishanmatsyAH sUrye pariNate sati
shlokas.2:
te trigartAshcha matsyAshcha sa.nrabdhA yuddhadurmadAH |
anyonyamabhigarjanto goShu gRRiddhA mahAbalAH
shlokas.3:
bhImAshcha mattamAta~NgAstomarA~NkushachoditAH |
grAmaNIyaiH samArUDhAH kushalairhastisAdibhiH
shlokas.4:
teShAM samAgamo ghorastumulo lomaharShaNaH |
devAsurasamo rAjannAsItsUrye vilambati
shlokas.5:
udatiShThadrajo bhaumaM na praj~nAyata ki~nchana |
pakShiNashchApatanbhUmau sainyena rajasAvRRitAH
shlokas.6:
iShubhirvyatisa.nyadbhirAdityo.antaradhIyata |
khadyotairiva sa.nyuktamantarikShaM vyarAjata
shlokas.7:
rukmapRRiShThAni chApAni vyatiShaktAni dhanvinAm |
patatAM lokavIrANAM savyadakShiNamasyatAm
shlokas.8:
rathA rathaiH samAjagmuH pAdAtaishcha padAtayaH |
sAdibhiH sAdinashchaiva gajaishchApi mahAgajAH
shlokas.9:
asibhiH paTTishaiH prAsaiH shaktibhistomarairapi |
sa.nrabdhAH samare rAjannijaghnuritaretaram
shlokas.10:
nighnantaH samare.anyonyaM shUrAH parighabAhavaH |
na shekurabhisa.nrabdhAH shUrAnkartuM parA~NmukhAn
shlokas.11:
kL^iptottaroShThaM sunasaM kL^iptakeshamala~NkRRitam |
adRRishyata shirashChinnaM rajodhvastaM sakuNDalam
shlokas.12:
adRRishya.nstatra gAtrANi sharaishChinnAni bhAgashaH |
shAlaskandhanikAshAni kShatriyANAM mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.13:
nAgabhoganikAshaishcha bAhubhishchandanokShitaiH |
AkIrNA vasudhA tatra shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH
shlokas.14:
upashAmyadrajo bhaumaM rudhireNa prasarpatA |
kashmalaM prAvishadghoraM nirmaryAdamavartata
shlokas.15:
shatAnIkaH shataM hatvA vishAlAkShashchatuHshatam |
praviShTau mahatIM senAM trigartAnAM mahArathau
ArchChetAM bahusa.nrabdhau keshAkeshi nakhAnakhi
shlokas.16:
lakShayitvA trigartAnAM tau praviShTau rathavrajam |
jagmatuH sUryadattashcha madirAshvashcha pRRiShThataH
shlokas.17:
virATastatra sa~NgrAme hatvA pa~nchashatAnrathAn |
hayAnAM cha shatAnyatra hatvA pa~ncha mahArathAn
shlokas.18:
charansa vividhAnmArgAnratheShu rathayUthapaH |
trigartAnAM susharmANamArchChadrukmarathaM raNe
shlokas.19:
tau vyAvaharatAM tatra mahAtmAnau mahAbalau |
anyonyamabhigarjantau goShThe govRRiShabhAviva
shlokas.20:
tato rathAbhyAM rathinau vyatiyAya samantataH |
sharAnvyasRRijatAM shIghraM toyadhArA ghanAviva
shlokas.21:
anyonyaM chAtisa.nrabdhau vicheraturamarShaNau |
kRRitAstrau nishitairbANairasishaktigadAbhRRitau
shlokas.22:
tato rAjA susharmANaM vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH |
pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhishchAsya vivyAdha chaturo hayAn
shlokas.23:
tathaiva matsyarAjAnaM susharmA yuddhadurmadaH |
pa~nchAshatA shitairbANairvivyAdha paramAstravit
shlokas.24:
tataH sainyaM samAvRRitya matsyarAjasusharmaNoH |
nAbhyajAna.nstadAnyonyaM pradoShe rajasAvRRite

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tamasAbhiplute loke rajasA chaiva bhArata |
vyatiShThanvai muhUrtaM tu vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.2:
tato.andhakAraM praNudannudatiShThata chandramAH |
kurvANo vimalAM rAtriM nandayankShatriyAnyudhi
shlokas.3:
tataH prakAshamAsAdya punaryuddhamavartata |
ghorarUpaM tataste sma nAvekShanta parasparam
shlokas.4:
tataH susharmA traigartaH saha bhrAtrA yavIyasA |
abhyadravanmatsyarAjaM rathavrAtena sarvashaH
shlokas.5:
tato rathAbhyAM praskandya bhrAtarau kShatriyarShabhau |
gadApANI susa.nrabdhau samabhyadravatAM hayAn
shlokas.6:
tathaiva teShAM tu balAni tAni; kruddhAnyathAnyonyamabhidravanti |
gadAsikhaDgaishcha parashvadhaishcha; prAsaishcha tIkShNAgrasupItadhAraiH
shlokas.7:
balaM tu matsyasya balena rAjA; sarvaM trigartAdhipatiH susharmA |
pramathya jitvA cha prasahya matsyaM; virATamojasvinamabhyadhAvat
shlokas.8:
tau nihatya pRRithagdhuryAvubhau cha pArShNisArathI |
virathaM matsyarAjAnaM jIvagrAhamagRRihNatAm
shlokas.9:
tamunmathya susharmA tu rudatIM vadhukAmiva |
syandanaM svaM samAropya prayayau shIghravAhanaH
shlokas.10:
tasmingRRihIte virathe virATe balavattare |
prAdravanta bhayAnmatsyAstrigartairarditA bhRRisham
shlokas.11:
teShu santrAsyamAneShu kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
abhyabhAShanmahAbAhuM bhImasenamari.ndamam
shlokas.12:
matsyarAjaH parAmRRiShTastrigartena susharmaNA |
taM mokShaya mahAbAho na gachCheddviShatAM vasham
shlokas.13:
uShitAH smaH sukhaM sarve sarvakAmaiH supUjitAH |
bhImasena tvayA kAryA tasya vAsasya niShkRRitiH
shlokas.14:
bhImasena uvAcha||
ahamenaM paritrAsye shAsanAttava pArthiva |
pashya me sumahatkarma yudhyataH saha shatrubhiH
shlokas.15:
svabAhubalamAshritya tiShTha tvaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
ekAntamAshrito rAjanpashya me.adya parAkramam
shlokas.16:
suskandho.ayaM mahAvRRikSho gadArUpa iva sthitaH |
enameva samArujya drAvayiShyAmi shAtravAn
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM mattamiva mAta~NgaM vIkShamANaM vanaspatim |
abravIdbhrAtaraM vIraM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.18:
mA bhIma sAhasaM kArShIstiShThatveSha vanaspatiH |
mA tvA vRRikSheNa karmANi kurvANamatimAnuSham
janAH samavabudhyeranbhImo.ayamiti bhArata
shlokas.19:
anyadevAyudhaM ki~nchitpratipadyasva mAnuSham |
chApaM vA yadi vA shaktiM nistri.nshaM vA parashvadham
shlokas.20:
yadeva mAnuShaM bhIma bhavedanyairalakShitam |
tadevAyudhamAdAya mokShayAshu mahIpatim
shlokas.21:
yamau cha chakrarakShau te bhavitArau mahAbalau |
vyUhataH samare tAta matsyarAjaM parIpsataH
shlokas.22:
tataH samastAste sarve turagAnabhyachodayan |
divyamastraM vikurvANAstrigartAnpratyamarShaNAH
shlokas.23:
tAnnivRRittarathAndRRiShTvA pANDavAnsA mahAchamUH |
vairATI paramakruddhA yuyudhe paramAdbhutam
shlokas.24:
sahasraM nyavadhIttatra kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bhImaH saptashatAnyodhAnparalokamadarshayat
nakulashchApi saptaiva shatAni prAhiNochCharaiH
shlokas.25:
shatAni trINi shUrANAM sahadevaH pratApavAn |
yudhiShThirasamAdiShTo nijaghne puruSharShabhaH
bhittvA tAM mahatIM senAM trigartAnAM nararShabha
shlokas.26:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA tvaramANo mahArathaH |
abhidrutya susharmANaM sharairabhyatudadbhRRisham
shlokas.27:
susharmApi susa~NkruddhastvaramANo yudhiShThiram |
avidhyannavabhirbANaishchaturbhishchaturo hayAn
shlokas.28:
tato rAjannAshukArI kuntIputro vRRikodaraH |
samAsAdya susharmANamashvAnasya vyapothayat
shlokas.29:
pRRiShThagopau cha tasyAtha hatvA paramasAyakaiH |
athAsya sArathiM kruddho rathopasthAdapAharat
shlokas.30:
chakrarakShashcha shUrashcha shoNAshvo nAma vishrutaH |
sa bhayAddvairathaM dRRiShTvA traigartaM prAjahattadA
shlokas.31:
tato virATaH praskandya rathAdatha susharmaNaH |
gadAmasya parAmRRishya tamevAjaghnivAnbalI
sa chachAra gadApANirvRRiddho.api taruNo yathA
shlokas.32:
bhImastu bhImasa~NkAsho rathAtpraskandya kuNDalI |
trigartarAjamAdatta siMhaH kShudramRRigaM yathA
shlokas.33:
tasmingRRihIte virathe trigartAnAM mahArathe |
abhajyata balaM sarvaM traigartaM tadbhayAturam
shlokas.34:
nivartya gAstataH sarvAH pANDuputrA mahAbalAH |
avajitya susharmANaM dhanaM chAdAya sarvashaH
shlokas.35:
svabAhubalasampannA hrIniShedhA yatavratAH |
sa~NgrAmashiraso madhye tAM rAtriM sukhino.avasan
shlokas.36:
tato virATaH kaunteyAnatimAnuShavikramAn |
archayAmAsa vittena mAnena cha mahArathAn
shlokas.37:
virATa uvAcha||
yathaiva mama ratnAni yuShmAkaM tAni vai tathA |
kAryaM kuruta taiH sarve yathAkAmaM yathAsukham
shlokas.38:
dadAnyala~NkRRitAH kanyA vasUni vividhAni cha |
manasashchApyabhipretaM yadvaH shatrunibarhaNAH
shlokas.39:
yuShmAkaM vikramAdadya mukto.ahaM svastimAniha |
tasmAdbhavanto matsyAnAmIshvarAH sarva eva hi
shlokas.40:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathAbhivAdinaM matsyaM kauraveyAH pRRithakpRRithak |
UchuH prA~njalayaH sarve yudhiShThirapurogamAH
shlokas.41:
pratinandAma te vAkyaM sarvaM chaiva vishAM pate |
etenaiva pratItAH smo yattvaM mukto.adya shatrubhiH
shlokas.42:
athAbravItprItamanA matsyarAjo yudhiShThiram |
punareva mahAbAhurvirATo rAjasattamaH
ehi tvAmabhiShekShyAmi matsyarAjo.astu no bhavAn
shlokas.43:
manasashchApyabhipretaM yatte shatrunibarhaNa |
tatte.ahaM sampradAsyAmi sarvamarhati no bhavAn
shlokas.44:
ratnAni gAH suvarNaM cha maNimuktamathApi vA |
vaiyAghrapadya viprendra sarvathaiva namo.astu te
shlokas.45:
tvatkRRite hyadya pashyAmi rAjyamAtmAnameva cha |
yatashcha jAtaH sa.nrambhaH sa cha shatrurvashaM gataH
shlokas.46:
tato yudhiShThiro matsyaM punarevAbhyabhAShata |
pratinandAmi te vAkyaM manoj~naM matsya bhAShase
shlokas.47:
AnRRisha.nsyaparo nityaM susukhaH satataM bhava |
gachChantu dUtAstvaritaM nagaraM tava pArthiva
suhRRidAM priyamAkhyAtuM ghoShayantu cha te jayam
shlokas.48:
tatastadvachanAnmatsyo dUtAnrAjA samAdishat |
AchakShadhvaM puraM gatvA sa~NgrAme vijayaM mama
shlokas.49:
kumArAH samala~NkRRitya paryAgachChantu me purAt |
vAditrANi cha sarvANi gaNikAshcha svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.50:
te gatvA kevalAM rAtrimatha sUryodayaM prati |
virATasya purAbhyAshe dUtA jayamaghoShayan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yAte trigartaM matsye tu pashU.nstAnsvAnparIpsati |
duryodhanaH sahAmAtyo virATamupayAdatha
shlokas.2:
bhIShmo droNashcha karNashcha kRRipashcha paramAstravit |
drauNishcha saubalashchaiva tathA duHshAsanaH prabhuH
shlokas.3:
vivi.nshatirvikarNashcha chitrasenashcha vIryavAn |
durmukho duHsahashchaiva ye chaivAnye mahArathAH
shlokas.4:
ete matsyAnupAgamya virATasya mahIpateH |
ghoShAnvidrAvya tarasA godhanaM jahrurojasA
shlokas.5:
ShaShTiM gavAM sahasrANi kuravaH kAlayanti te |
mahatA rathava.nshena parivArya samantataH
shlokas.6:
gopAlAnAM tu ghoSheShu hanyatAM tairmahArathaiH |
ArAvaH sumahAnAsItsamprahAre bhaya~Nkare
shlokas.7:
gavAdhyakShastu santrasto rathamAsthAya satvaraH |
jagAma nagarAyaiva parikrosha.nstadArtavat
shlokas.8:
sa pravishya puraM rAj~no nRRipaveshmAbhyayAttataH |
avatIrya rathAttUrNamAkhyAtuM pravivesha ha
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTvA bhUmi~njayaM nAma putraM matsyasya mAninam |
tasmai tatsarvamAchaShTa rAShTrasya pashukarShaNam
shlokas.10:
ShaShTiM gavAM sahasrANi kuravaH kAlayanti te |
tadvijetuM samuttiShTha godhanaM rAShTravardhanam
shlokas.11:
rAjaputra hitaprepsuH kShipraM niryAhi vai svayam |
tvAM hi matsyo mahIpAlaH shUnyapAlamihAkarot
shlokas.12:
tvayA pariShado madhye shlAghate sa narAdhipaH |
putro mamAnurUpashcha shUrashcheti kulodvahaH
shlokas.13:
iShvastre nipuNo yodhaH sadA vIrashcha me sutaH |
tasya tatsatyamevAstu manuShyendrasya bhAShitam
shlokas.14:
Avartaya kurU~njitvA pashUnpashumatAM vara |
nirdahaiShAmanIkAni bhImena sharatejasA
shlokas.15:
dhanushchyutai rukmapu~NkhaiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
dviShatAM bhindhyanIkAni gajAnAmiva yUthapaH
shlokas.16:
pAshopadhAnAM jyAtantrIM chApadaNDAM mahAsvanAm |
sharavarNAM dhanurvINAM shatrumadhye pravAdaya
shlokas.17:
shvetA rajatasa~NkAshA rathe yujyantu te hayAH |
dhvajaM cha siMhaM sauvarNamuchChrayantu tavAbhibhoH
shlokas.18:
rukmapu~NkhAH prasannAgrA muktA hastavatA tvayA |
ChAdayantu sharAH sUryaM rAj~nAmAyurnirodhinaH
shlokas.19:
raNe jitvA kurUnsarvAnvajrapANirivAsurAn |
yasho mahadavApya tvaM pravishedaM puraM punaH
shlokas.20:
tvaM hi rAShTrasya paramA gatirmatsyapateH sutaH |
gatimanto bhavantvadya sarve viShayavAsinaH
shlokas.21:
strImadhya uktastenAsau tadvAkyamabhaya~Nkaram |
antaHpure shlAghamAna idaM vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
uttara uvAcha||
adyAhamanugachCheyaM dRRiDhadhanvA gavAM padam |
yadi me sArathiH kashchidbhavedashveShu kovidaH
shlokas.2:
tameva nAdhigachChAmi yo me yantA bhavennaraH |
pashyadhvaM sArathiM kShipraM mama yuktaM prayAsyataH
shlokas.3:
aShTAvi.nshatirAtraM vA mAsaM vA nUnamantataH |
yattadAsInmahadyuddhaM tatra me sArathirhataH
shlokas.4:
sa labheyaM yadi tvanyaM hayayAnavidaM naram |
tvarAvAnadya yAtvAhaM samuchChritamahAdhvajam
shlokas.5:
vigAhya tatparAnIkaM gajavAjirathAkulam |
shastrapratApanirvIryAnkurU~njitvAnaye pashUn
shlokas.6:
duryodhanaM shAntanavaM karNaM vaikartanaM kRRipam |
droNaM cha saha putreNa maheShvAsAnsamAgatAn
shlokas.7:
vitrAsayitvA sa~NgrAme dAnavAniva vajrabhRRit |
anenaiva muhUrtena punaH pratyAnaye pashUn
shlokas.8:
shUnyamAsAdya kuravaH prayAntyAdAya godhanam |
kiM nu shakyaM mayA kartuM yadahaM tatra nAbhavam
shlokas.9:
pashyeyuradya me vIryaM kuravaste samAgatAH |
kiM nu pArtho.arjunaH sAkShAdayamasmAnprabAdhate
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM strIShu bhAShataH sma punaH punaH |
nAmarShayata pA~nchAlI bIbhatsoH parikIrtanam
shlokas.11:
athainamupasa~Ngamya strImadhyAtsA tapasvinI |
vrIDamAneva shanakairidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.12:
yo.asau bRRihadvAraNAbho yuvA supriyadarshanaH |
bRRihannaDeti vikhyAtaH pArthasyAsItsa sArathiH
shlokas.13:
dhanuShyanavarashchAsIttasya shiShyo mahAtmanaH |
dRRiShTapUrvo mayA vIra charantyA pANDavAnprati
shlokas.14:
yadA tatpAvako dAvamadahatkhANDavaM mahat |
arjunasya tadAnena sa~NgRRihItA hayottamAH
shlokas.15:
tena sArathinA pArthaH sarvabhUtAni sarvashaH |
ajayatkhANDavaprasthe na hi yantAsti tAdRRishaH
shlokas.16:
yeyaM kumArI sushroNI bhaginI te yavIyasI |
asyAH sa vachanaM vIra kariShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.17:
yadi vai sArathiH sa syAtkurUnsarvAnasa.nshayam |
jitvA gAshcha samAdAya dhruvamAgamanaM bhavet
shlokas.18:
evamuktaH sa sairandhryA bhaginIM pratyabhAShata |
gachCha tvamanavadyA~Ngi tAmAnaya bRRihannaDAm
shlokas.19:
sA bhrAtrA preShitA shIghramagachChannartanAgRRiham |
yatrAste sa mahAbAhushChannaH satreNa pANDavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa tAM dRRiShTvA vishAlAkShIM rAjaputrIM sakhIM sakhA |
prahasannabravIdrAjankutrAgamanamityuta
shlokas.2:
tamabravIdrAjaputrI samupetya nararShabham |
praNayaM bhAvayantI sma sakhImadhya idaM vachaH
shlokas.3:
gAvo rAShTrasya kurubhiH kAlyante no bRRihannaDe |
tAnvijetuM mama bhrAtA prayAsyati dhanurdharaH
shlokas.4:
nachiraM cha hatastasya sa~NgrAme rathasArathiH |
tena nAsti samaH sUto yo.asya sArathyamAcharet
shlokas.5:
tasmai prayatamAnAya sArathyarthaM bRRihannaDe |
AchachakShe hayaj~nAne sairandhrI kaushalaM tava
shlokas.6:
sA sArathyaM mama bhrAtuH kuru sAdhu bRRihannaDe |
purA dUrataraM gAvo hriyante kurubhirhi naH
shlokas.7:
athaitadvachanaM me.adya niyuktA na kariShyasi |
praNayAduchyamAnA tvaM parityakShyAmi jIvitam
shlokas.8:
evamuktastu sushroNyA tayA sakhyA parantapaH |
jagAma rAjaputrasya sakAshamamitaujasaH
shlokas.9:
taM sA vrajantaM tvaritaM prabhinnamiva ku~njaram |
anvagachChadvishAlAkShI shishurgajavadhUriva
shlokas.10:
dUrAdeva tu taM prekShya rAjaputro.abhyabhAShata |
tvayA sArathinA pArthaH khANDave.agnimatarpayat
shlokas.11:
pRRithivImajayatkRRitsnAM kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
sairandhrI tvAM samAchaShTa sA hi jAnAti pANDavAn
shlokas.12:
sa.nyachCha mAmakAnashvA.nstathaiva tvaM bRRihannaDe |
kurubhiryotsyamAnasya godhanAni parIpsataH
shlokas.13:
arjunasya kilAsIstvaM sArathirdayitaH purA |
tvayAjayatsahAyena pRRithivIM pANDavarShabhaH
shlokas.14:
evamuktA pratyuvAcha rAjaputraM bRRihannaDA |
kA shaktirmama sArathyaM kartuM sa~NgrAmamUrdhani
shlokas.15:
gItaM vA yadi vA nRRittaM vAditraM vA pRRithagvidham |
tatkariShyAmi bhadraM te sArathyaM tu kuto mayi
shlokas.16:
uttara uvAcha||
bRRihannaDe gAyano vA nartano vA punarbhava |
kShipraM me rathamAsthAya nigRRihNIShva hayottamAn
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa tatra narmasa.nyuktamakarotpANDavo bahu |
uttarAyAH pramukhataH sarvaM jAnannari.ndama
shlokas.18:
UrdhvamutkShipya kavachaM sharIre pratyamu~nchata |
kumAryastatra taM dRRiShTvA prAhasanpRRithulochanAH
shlokas.19:
sa tu dRRiShTvA vimuhyantaM svayamevottarastataH |
kavachena mahArheNa samanahyadbRRihannaDAm
shlokas.20:
sa bibhratkavachaM chAgryaM svayamapya.nshumatprabham |
dhvajaM cha siMhamuchChritya sArathye samakalpayat
shlokas.21:
dhanUMShi cha mahArhANi bANA.nshcha ruchirAnbahUn |
AdAya prayayau vIraH sa bRRihannaDasArathiH
shlokas.22:
athottarA cha kanyAshcha sakhyastAmabruva.nstadA |
bRRihannaDe AnayethA vAsA.nsi ruchirANi naH
shlokas.23:
pA~nchAlikArthaM sUkShmANi chitrANi vividhAni cha |
vijitya sa~NgrAmagatAnbhIShmadroNamukhAnkurUn
shlokas.24:
atha tA bruvatIH kanyAH sahitAH pANDunandanaH |
pratyuvAcha hasanpArtho meghadundubhiniHsvanaH
shlokas.25:
yadyuttaro.ayaM sa~NgrAme vijeShyati mahArathAn |
athAhariShye vAsA.nsi divyAni ruchirANi cha
shlokas.26:
evamuktvA tu bIbhatsustataH prAchodayaddhayAn |
kurUnabhimukhA~nshUro nAnAdhvajapatAkinaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa rAjadhAnyA niryAya vairATiH pRRithivI~njayaH |
prayAhItyabravItsUtaM yatra te kuravo gatAH
shlokas.2:
samavetAnkurUnyAvajjigIShUnavajitya vai |
gAshchaiShAM kShipramAdAya punarAyAmi svaM puram
shlokas.3:
tatastA.nshchodayAmAsa sadashvAnpANDunandanaH |
te hayA narasiMhena choditA vAtaraMhasaH
Alikhanta ivAkAshamUhuH kA~nchanamAlinaH
shlokas.4:
nAtidUramatho yAtvA matsyaputradhana~njayau |
avekShetAmamitraghnau kurUNAM balinAM balam
shmashAnamabhito gatvA AsasAda kurUnatha
shlokas.5:
tadanIkaM mahatteShAM vibabhau sAgarasvanam |
sarpamANamivAkAshe vanaM bahulapAdapam
shlokas.6:
dadRRishe pArthivo reNurjanitastena sarpatA |
dRRiShTipraNAsho bhUtAnAM divaspRRi~Nnarasattama
shlokas.7:
tadanIkaM mahaddRRiShTvA gajAshvarathasa~Nkulam |
karNaduryodhanakRRipairguptaM shAntanavena cha
shlokas.8:
droNena cha saputreNa maheShvAsena dhImatA |
hRRiShTaromA bhayodvignaH pArthaM vairATirabravIt
shlokas.9:
notsahe kurubhiryoddhuM romaharShaM hi pashya me |
bahupravIramatyugraM devairapi durAsadam
pratiyoddhuM na shakShyAmi kurusainyamanantakam
shlokas.10:
nAsha.nse bhAratIM senAM praveShTuM bhImakArmukAm |
rathanAgAshvakalilAM pattidhvajasamAkulAm
dRRiShTvaiva hi parAnAjAvAtmA pravyathatIva me
shlokas.11:
yatra droNashcha bhIShmashcha kRRipaH karNo vivi.nshatiH |
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha somadatto.atha bAhlikaH
shlokas.12:
duryodhanastathA vIro rAjA cha rathinAM varaH |
dyutimanto maheShvAsAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvaiva hi kurUnetAnvyUDhAnIkAnprahAriNaH |
hRRiShitAni cha romANi kashmalaM chAgataM mama
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
aviyAto viyAtasya maurkhyAddhUrtasya pashyataH |
paridevayate mandaH sakAshe savyasAchinaH
shlokas.15:
trigartAnme pitA yAtaH shUnye sampraNidhAya mAm |
sarvAM senAmupAdAya na me santIha sainikAH
shlokas.16:
so.ahameko bahUnbAlaH kRRitAstrAnakRRitashramaH |
pratiyoddhuM na shakShyAmi nivartasva bRRihannaDe
shlokas.17:
arjuna uvAcha||
bhayena dInarUpo.asi dviShatAM harShavardhanaH |
na cha tAvatkRRitaM ki~nchitparaiH karma raNAjire
shlokas.18:
svayameva cha mAmAttha vaha mAM kauravAnprati |
so.ahaM tvAM tatra neShyAmi yatraite bahulA dhvajAH
shlokas.19:
madhyamAmiShagRRidhrANAM kurUNAmAtatAyinAm |
neShyAmi tvAM mahAbAho pRRithivyAmapi yudhyatAm
shlokas.20:
tathA strIShu pratishrutya pauruShaM puruSheShu cha |
katthamAno.abhiniryAya kimarthaM na yuyutsase
shlokas.21:
na chedvijitya gAstAstvaM gRRihAnvai pratiyAsyasi |
prahasiShyanti vIra tvAM narA nAryashcha sa~NgatAH
shlokas.22:
ahamapyatra sairandhryA stutaH sArathyakarmaNi |
na hi shakShyAmyanirjitya gAH prayAtuM puraM prati
shlokas.23:
stotreNa chaiva sairandhryAstava vAkyena tena cha |
kathaM na yudhyeyamahaM kurUnsarvAnsthiro bhava
shlokas.24:
uttara uvAcha||
kAmaM harantu matsyAnAM bhUyA.nsaM kuravo dhanam |
prahasantu cha mAM nAryo narA vApi bRRihannaDe
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA prAdravadbhIto rathAtpraskandya kuNDalI |
tyaktvA mAnaM sa mandAtmA visRRijya sasharaM dhanuH
shlokas.26:
bRRihannaDovAcha||
naiSha pUrvaiH smRRito dharmaH kShatriyasya palAyanam |
shreyaste maraNaM yuddhe na bhItasya palAyanam
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu kaunteyaH so.avaplutya rathottamAt |
tamanvadhAvaddhAvantaM rAjaputraM dhana~njayaH
dIrghAM veNIM vidhunvAnaH sAdhu rakte cha vAsasI
shlokas.28:
vidhUya veNIM dhAvantamajAnanto.arjunaM tadA |
sainikAH prAhasankechittathArUpamavekShya tam
shlokas.29:
taM shIghramabhidhAvantaM samprekShya kuravo.abruvan |
ka eSha veShaprachChanno bhasmaneva hutAshanaH
shlokas.30:
ki~nchidasya yathA pu.nsaH ki~nchidasya yathA striyaH |
sArUpyamarjunasyeva klIbarUpaM bibharti cha
shlokas.31:
tadevaitachChirogrIvaM tau bAhU parighopamau |
tadvadevAsya vikrAntaM nAyamanyo dhana~njayAt
shlokas.32:
amareShviva devendro mAnuSheShu dhana~njayaH |
ekaH ko.asmAnupAyAyAdanyo loke dhana~njayAt
shlokas.33:
ekaH putro virATasya shUnye saMnihitaH pure |
sa eSha kila niryAto bAlabhAvAnna pauruShAt
shlokas.34:
satreNa nUnaM ChannaM hi charantaM pArthamarjunam |
uttaraH sArathiM kRRitvA niryAto nagarAdbahiH
shlokas.35:
sa no manye dhvajAndRRiShTvA bhIta eSha palAyati |
taM nUnameSha dhAvantaM jighRRikShati dhana~njayaH
shlokas.36:
iti sma kuravaH sarve vimRRishantaH pRRithakpRRithak |
na cha vyavasituM ki~nchiduttaraM shaknuvanti te
ChannaM tathA taM satreNa pANDavaM prekShya bhArata
shlokas.37:
uttaraM tu pradhAvantamanudrutya dhana~njayaH |
gatvA padashataM tUrNaM keshapakShe parAmRRishat
shlokas.38:
so.arjunena parAmRRiShTaH paryadevayadArtavat |
bahulaM kRRipaNaM chaiva virATasya sutastadA
shlokas.39:
shAtakumbhasya shuddhasya shataM niShkAndadAmi te |
maNInaShTau cha vaiDUryAnhemabaddhAnmahAprabhAn
shlokas.40:
hemadaNDapratichChannaM rathaM yuktaM cha suvrajaiH |
mattA.nshcha dasha mAta~NgAnmu~ncha mAM tvaM bRRihannaDe
shlokas.41:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAdIni vAkyAni vilapantamachetasam |
prahasya puruShavyAghro rathasyAntikamAnayat
shlokas.42:
athainamabravItpArtho bhayArtaM naShTachetasam |
yadi notsahase yoddhuM shatrubhiH shatrukarshana
ehi me tvaM hayAnyachCha yudhyamAnasya shatrubhiH
shlokas.43:
prayAhyetadrathAnIkaM madbAhubalarakShitaH |
apradhRRiShyatamaM ghoraM guptaM vIrairmahArathaiH
shlokas.44:
mA bhaistvaM rAjaputrAgrya kShatriyo.asi parantapa |
ahaM vai kurubhiryotsyAmyavajeShyAmi te pashUn
shlokas.45:
pravishyaitadrathAnIkamapradhRRiShyaM durAsadam |
yantA bhUstvaM narashreShTha yotsye.ahaM kurubhiH saha
shlokas.46:
evaM bruvANo bIbhatsurvairATimaparAjitaH |
samAshvAsya muhUrtaM tamuttaraM bharatarShabha
shlokas.47:
tata enaM vicheShTantamakAmaM bhayapIDitam |
rathamAropayAmAsa pArthaH praharatAM varaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM dRRiShTvA klIbaveSheNa rathasthaM narapu~Ngavam |
shamImabhimukhaM yAntaM rathamAropya chottaram
shlokas.2:
bhIShmadroNamukhAstatra kurUNAM rathasattamAH |
vitrastamanasaH sarve dhana~njayakRRitAdbhayAt
shlokas.3:
tAnavekShya hatotsAhAnutpAtAnapi chAdbhutAn |
guruH shastrabhRRitAM shreShTho bhAradvAjo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.4:
chalAshcha vAtAH sa.nvAnti rUkShAH paruShaniHsvanAH |
bhasmavarNaprakAshena tamasA sa.nvRRitaM nabhaH
shlokas.5:
rUkShavarNAshcha jaladA dRRishyante.adbhutadarshanAH |
niHsaranti cha koshebhyaH shastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.6:
shivAshcha vinadantyetA dIptAyAM dishi dAruNAH |
hayAshchAshrUNi mu~nchanti dhvajAH kampantyakampitAH
shlokas.7:
yAdRRishAnyatra rUpANi sa.ndRRishyante bahUnyapi |
yattA bhavantastiShThantu syAdyuddhaM samupasthitam
shlokas.8:
rakShadhvamapi chAtmAnaM vyUhadhvaM vAhinImapi |
vaishasaM cha pratIkShadhvaM rakShadhvaM chApi godhanam
shlokas.9:
eSha vIro maheShvAsaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
AgataH klIbaveSheNa pArtho nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
sa eSha pArtho vikrAntaH savyasAchI parantapaH |
nAyuddhena nivarteta sarvairapi marudgaNaiH
shlokas.11:
kleshitashcha vane shUro vAsavena cha shikShitaH |
amarShavashamApanno yotsyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
nehAsya pratiyoddhAramahaM pashyAmi kauravAH |
mahAdevo.api pArthena shrUyate yudhi toShitaH
shlokas.13:
karNa uvAcha||
sadA bhavAnphalgunasya guNairasmAnvikatthase |
na chArjunaH kalA pUrNA mama duryodhanasya vA
shlokas.14:
duryodhana uvAcha||
yadyeSha pArtho rAdheya kRRitaM kAryaM bhavenmama |
j~nAtAH punashchariShyanti dvAdashAnyAnhi vatsarAn
shlokas.15:
athaiSha kashchidevAnyaH klIbaveSheNa mAnavaH |
sharairenaM sunishitaiH pAtayiShyAmi bhUtale
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminbruvati tadvAkyaM dhArtarAShTre parantape |
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipo drauNiH pauruShaM tadapUjayan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAM shamImupasa~Ngamya pArtho vairATimabravIt |
sukumAraM samAj~nAtaM sa~NgrAme nAtikovidam
shlokas.2:
samAdiShTo mayA kShipraM dhanUMShyavaharottara |
nemAni hi tvadIyAni soDhuM shakShyanti me balam
shlokas.3:
bhAraM vApi guruM hartuM ku~njaraM vA pramarditum |
mama vA bAhuvikShepaM shatrUniha vijeShyataH
shlokas.4:
tasmAdbhUmi~njayAroha shamImetAM palAshinIm |
asyAM hi pANDuputrANAM dhanUMShi nihitAnyuta
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThirasya bhImasya bIbhatsoryamayostathA |
dhvajAH sharAshcha shUrANAM divyAni kavachAni cha
shlokas.6:
atra chaitanmahAvIryaM dhanuH pArthasya gANDivam |
ekaM shatasahasreNa saMmitaM rAShTravardhanam
shlokas.7:
vyAyAmasahamatyarthaM tRRiNarAjasamaM mahat |
sarvAyudhamahAmAtraM shatrusambAdhakArakam
shlokas.8:
suvarNavikRRitaM divyaM shlakShNamAyatamavraNam |
alaM bhAraM guruM voDhuM dAruNaM chArudarshanam
tAdRRishAnyeva sarvANi balavanti dRRiDhAni cha
shlokas.9:
uttara uvAcha||
asminvRRikShe kilodbaddhaM sharIramiti naH shrutam |
tadahaM rAjaputraH sanspRRisheyaM pANinA katham
shlokas.10:
naiva.nvidhaM mayA yuktamAlabdhuM kShatrayoninA |
mahatA rAjaputreNa mantrayaj~navidA satA
shlokas.11:
spRRiShTavantaM sharIraM mAM shavavAhamivAshuchim |
kathaM vA vyavahAryaM vai kurvIthAstvaM bRRihannaDe
shlokas.12:
bRRihannaDovAcha||
vyavahAryashcha rAjendra shuchishchaiva bhaviShyasi |
dhanUMShyetAni mA bhaistvaM sharIraM nAtra vidyate
shlokas.13:
dAyAdaM matsyarAjasya kule jAtaM manasvinam |
kathaM tvA ninditaM karma kArayeyaM nRRipAtmaja
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa pArthena rathAtpraskandya kuNDalI |
Aruroha shamIvRRikShaM vairATiravashastadA
shlokas.15:
tamanvashAsachChatrughno rathe tiShThandhana~njayaH |
pariveShTanameteShAM kShipraM chaiva vyapAnuda
shlokas.16:
tathA saMnahanAnyeShAM parimuchya samantataH |
apashyadgANDivaM tatra chaturbhiraparaiH saha
shlokas.17:
teShAM vimuchyamAnAnAM dhanuShAmarkavarchasAm |
vinishcheruH prabhA divyA grahANAmudayeShviva
shlokas.18:
sa teShAM rUpamAlokya bhoginAmiva jRRimbhatAm |
hRRiShTaromA bhayodvignaH kShaNena samapadyata
shlokas.19:
sa.nspRRishya tAni chApAni bhAnumanti bRRihanti cha |
vairATirarjunaM rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.20:
uttara uvAcha||
bindavo jAtarUpasya shataM yasminnipAtitAH |
sahasrakoTi sauvarNAH kasyaitaddhanuruttamam
shlokas.21:
vAraNA yasya sauvarNAH pRRiShThe bhAsanti da.nshitAH |
supArshvaM sugrahaM chaiva kasyaitaddhanuruttamam
shlokas.22:
tapanIyasya shuddhasya ShaShTiryasyendragopakAH |
pRRiShThe vibhaktAH shobhante kasyaitaddhanuruttamam
shlokas.23:
sUryA yatra cha sauvarNAstrayo bhAsanti da.nshitAH |
tejasA prajvalanto hi kasyaitaddhanuruttamam
shlokas.24:
shAlabhA yatra sauvarNAstapanIyavichitritAH |
suvarNamaNichitraM cha kasyaitaddhanuruttamam
shlokas.25:
ime cha kasya nArAchAH sahasrA lomavAhinaH |
samantAtkaladhautAgrA upAsa~Nge hiraNmaye
shlokas.26:
vipAThAH pRRithavaH kasya gArdhrapatrAH shilAshitAH |
hAridravarNAH sunasAH pItAH sarvAyasAH sharAH
shlokas.27:
kasyAyamasitAvApaH pa~nchashArdUlalakShaNaH |
varAhakarNavyAmishraH sharAndhArayate dasha
shlokas.28:
kasyeme pRRithavo dIrghAH sarvapArashavAH sharAH |
shatAni sapta tiShThanti nArAchA rudhirAshanAH
shlokas.29:
kasyeme shukapatrAbhaiH pUrvairardhaiH suvAsasaH |
uttarairAyasaiH pItairhemapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.30:
kasyAyaM sAyako dIrghaH shilIpRRiShThaH shilImukhaH |
vaiyAghrakoshe nihito hemachitratsarurmahAn
shlokas.31:
suphalashchitrakoshashcha ki~NkiNIsAyako mahAn |
kasya hematsarurdivyaH khaDgaH paramanirvraNaH
shlokas.32:
kasyAyaM vimalaH khaDgo gavye koshe samarpitaH |
hematsaruranAdhRRiShyo naiShadhyo bhArasAdhanaH
shlokas.33:
kasya pA~nchanakhe koshe sAyako hemavigrahaH |
pramANarUpasampannaH pIta AkAshasaMnibhaH
shlokas.34:
kasya hemamaye koshe sutapte pAvakaprabhe |
nistri.nsho.ayaM guruH pItaH saikyaH paramanirvraNaH
shlokas.35:
nirdishasva yathAtattvaM mayA pRRiShTA bRRihannaDe |
vismayo me paro jAto dRRiShTvA sarvamidaM mahat
shlokas.36:
bRRihannaDovAcha||
yanmAM pUrvamihApRRichChaH shatrusenAnibarhaNam |
gANDIvametatpArthasya lokeShu viditaM dhanuH
shlokas.38:
yattachChatasahasreNa saMmitaM rAShTravardhanam |
yena devAnmanuShyA.nshcha pArtho viShahate mRRidhe
shlokas.39:
devadAnavagandharvaiH pUjitaM shAshvatIH samAH |
etadvarShasahasraM tu brahmA pUrvamadhArayat
shlokas.40:
tato.anantaramevAtha prajApatiradhArayat |
trINi pa~nchashataM chaiva shakro.ashIti cha pa~ncha cha
shlokas.41:
somaH pa~nchashataM rAjA tathaiva varuNaH shatam |
pArthaH pa~ncha cha ShaShTiM cha varShANi shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.42:
mahAvIryaM mahaddivyametattaddhanuruttamam |
pUjitaM suramartyeShu bibharti paramaM vapuH
shlokas.43:
supArshvaM bhImasenasya jAtarUpagrahaM dhanuH |
yena pArtho.ajayatkRRitsnAM dishaM prAchIM parantapaH
shlokas.44:
indragopakachitraM cha yadetachchAruvigraham |
rAj~no yudhiShThirasyaitadvairATe dhanuruttamam
shlokas.45:
sUryA yasmi.nstu sauvarNAH prabhAsante prabhAsinaH |
tejasA prajvalanto vai nakulasyaitadAyudham
shlokas.46:
shalabhA yatra sauvarNAstapanIyavichitritAH |
etanmAdrIsutasyApi sahadevasya kArmukam
shlokas.47:
ye tvime kShurasa~NkAshAH sahasrA lomavAhinaH |
ete.arjunasya vairATe sharAH sarpaviShopamAH
shlokas.48:
ete jvalantaH sa~NgrAme tejasA shIghragAminaH |
bhavanti vIrasyAkShayyA vyUhataH samare ripUn
shlokas.49:
ye cheme pRRithavo dIrghAshchandrabimbArdhadarshanAH |
ete bhImasya nishitA ripukShayakarAH sharAH
shlokas.50:
hAridravarNA ye tvete hemapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH |
nakulasya kalApo.ayaM pa~nchashArdUlalakShaNaH
shlokas.51:
yenAsau vyajayatkRRitsnAM pratIchIM dishamAhave |
kalApo hyeSha tasyAsInmAdrIputrasya dhImataH
shlokas.52:
ye tvime bhAskarAkArAH sarvapArashavAH sharAH |
ete chitrAH kriyopetAH sahadevasya dhImataH
shlokas.53:
ye tvime nishitAH pItAH pRRithavo dIrghavAsasaH |
hemapu~NkhAstriparvANo rAj~na ete mahAsharAH
shlokas.54:
yastvayaM sAyako dIrghaH shilIpRRiShThaH shilImukhaH |
arjunasyaiSha sa~NgrAme gurubhArasaho dRRiDhaH
shlokas.55:
vaiyAghrakoshastu mahAnbhImasenasya sAyakaH |
gurubhArasaho divyaH shAtravANAM bhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.56:
suphalashchitrakoshashcha hematsaruranuttamaH |
nistri.nshaH kauravasyaiSha dharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.57:
yastu pA~nchanakhe koshe nihitashchitrasevane |
nakulasyaiSha nistri.nsho gurubhArasaho dRRiDhaH
shlokas.58:
yastvayaM vimalaH khaDgo gavye koshe samarpitaH |
sahadevasya viddhyenaM sarvabhArasahaM dRRiDham

shlokas.1:
uttara uvAcha||
suvarNavikRRitAnImAnyAyudhAni mahAtmanAm |
ruchirANi prakAshante pArthAnAmAshukAriNAm
shlokas.2:
kva nu svidarjunaH pArthaH kauravyo vA yudhiShThiraH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha bhImasenashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.3:
sarva eva mahAtmAnaH sarvAmitravinAshanAH |
rAjyamakShaiH parAkIrya na shrUyante kadAchana
shlokas.4:
draupadI kva cha pA~nchAlI strIratnamiti vishrutA |
jitAnakShaistadA kRRiShNA tAnevAnvagamadvanam
shlokas.5:
arjuna uvAcha||
ahamasmyarjunaH pArthaH sabhAstAro yudhiShThiraH |
ballavo bhImasenastu pituste rasapAchakaH
shlokas.6:
ashvabandho.atha nakulaH sahadevastu gokule |
sairandhrIM draupadIM viddhi yatkRRite kIchakA hatAH
shlokas.7:
uttara uvAcha||
dasha pArthasya nAmAni yAni pUrvaM shrutAni me |
prabrUyAstAni yadi me shraddadhyAM sarvameva te
shlokas.8:
arjuna uvAcha||
hanta te.ahaM samAchakShe dasha nAmAni yAni me |
arjunaH phalguno jiShNuH kirITI shvetavAhanaH
bIbhatsurvijayaH kRRiShNaH savyasAchI dhana~njayaH
shlokas.9:
uttara uvAcha||
kenAsi vijayo nAma kenAsi shvetavAhanaH |
kirITI nAma kenAsi savyasAchI kathaM bhavAn
shlokas.10:
arjunaH phalguno jiShNuH kRRiShNo bIbhatsureva cha |
dhana~njayashcha kenAsi prabrUhi mama tattvataH
shrutA me tasya vIrasya kevalA nAmahetavaH
shlokas.11:
arjuna uvAcha||
sarvA~njanapadA~njitvA vittamAchChidya kevalam |
madhye dhanasya tiShThAmi tenAhurmAM dhana~njayam
shlokas.12:
abhiprayAmi sa~NgrAme yadahaM yuddhadurmadAn |
nAjitvA vinivartAmi tena mAM vijayaM viduH
shlokas.13:
shvetAH kA~nchanasaMnAhA rathe yujyanti me hayAH |
sa~NgrAme yudhyamAnasya tenAhaM shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.14:
uttarAbhyAM cha pUrvAbhyAM phalgunIbhyAmahaM divA |
jAto himavataH pRRiShThe tena mAM phalgunaM viduH
shlokas.15:
purA shakreNa me dattaM yudhyato dAnavarShabhaiH |
kirITaM mUrdhni sUryAbhaM tena mAhuH kirITinam
shlokas.16:
na kuryAM karma bIbhatsaM yudhyamAnaH katha~nchana |
tena devamanuShyeShu bIbhatsuriti mAM viduH
shlokas.17:
ubhau me dakShiNau pANI gANDIvasya vikarShaNe |
tena devamanuShyeShu savyasAchIti mAM viduH
shlokas.18:
pRRithivyAM chaturantAyAM varNo me durlabhaH samaH |
karomi karma shuklaM cha tena mAmarjunaM viduH
shlokas.19:
ahaM durApo durdharSho damanaH pAkashAsaniH |
tena devamanuShyeShu jiShNunAmAsmi vishrutaH
shlokas.20:
kRRiShNa ityeva dashamaM nAma chakre pitA mama |
kRRiShNAvadAtasya sataH priyatvAdbAlakasya vai
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH pArthaM sa vairATirabhyavAdayadantikAt |
ahaM bhUmi~njayo nAma nAmnAhamapi chottaraH
shlokas.22:
diShTyA tvAM pArtha pashyAmi svAgataM te dhana~njaya |
lohitAkSha mahAbAho nAgarAjakaropama
yadaj~nAnAdavochaM tvAM kShantumarhasi tanmama
shlokas.23:
yatastvayA kRRitaM pUrvaM vichitraM karma duShkaram |
ato bhayaM vyatItaM me prItishcha paramA tvayi

shlokas.1:
uttara uvAcha||
AsthAya vipulaM vIra rathaM sArathinA mayA |
katamaM yAsyase.anIkamukto yAsyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.2:
arjuna uvAcha||
prIto.asmi puruShavyAghra na bhayaM vidyate tava |
sarvAnnudAmi te shatrUnraNe raNavishArada
shlokas.3:
svastho bhava mahAbuddhe pashya mAM shatrubhiH saha |
yudhyamAnaM vimarde.asminkurvANaM bhairavaM mahat
shlokas.4:
etAnsarvAnupAsa~NgAnkShipraM badhnIhi me rathe |
etaM chAhara nistri.nshaM jAtarUpapariShkRRitam
ahaM vai kurubhiryotsyAmyavajeShyAmi te pashUn
shlokas.5:
sa~NkalpapakShavikShepaM bAhuprAkAratoraNam |
tridaNDatUNasambAdhamanekadhvajasa~Nkulam
shlokas.6:
jyAkShepaNaM krodhakRRitaM nemIninadadundubhi |
nagaraM te mayA guptaM rathopasthaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.7:
adhiShThito mayA sa~Nkhye ratho gANDIvadhanvanA |
ajeyaH shatrusainyAnAM vairATe vyetu te bhayam
shlokas.8:
uttara uvAcha||
bibhemi nAhameteShAM jAnAmi tvAM sthiraM yudhi |
keshavenApi sa~NgrAme sAkShAdindreNa vA samam
shlokas.9:
idaM tu chintayanneva parimuhyAmi kevalam |
nishchayaM chApi durmedhA na gachChAmi katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
evaM vIrA~NgarUpasya lakShaNairuchitasya cha |
kena karmavipAkena klIbatvamidamAgatam
shlokas.11:
manye tvAM klIbaveSheNa charantaM shUlapANinam |
gandharvarAjapratimaM devaM vApi shatakratum
shlokas.12:
arjuna uvAcha||
bhrAturniyogAjjyeShThasya sa.nvatsaramidaM vratam |
charAmi brahmacharyaM vai satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.13:
nAsmi klIbo mahAbAho paravAndharmasa.nyutaH |
samAptavratamuttIrNaM viddhi mAM tvaM nRRipAtmaja
shlokas.14:
uttara uvAcha||
paramo.anugraho me.adya yatpratarko na me vRRithA |
na hIdRRishAH klIbarUpA bhavantIha narottamAH
shlokas.15:
sahAyavAnasmi raNe yudhyeyamamarairapi |
sAdhvasaM tatpranaShTaM me kiM karomi bravIhi me
shlokas.16:
ahaM te sa~NgrahIShyAmi hayA~nshatrurathArujaH |
shikShito hyasmi sArathye tIrthataH puruSharShabha
shlokas.17:
dAruko vAsudevasya yathA shakrasya mAtaliH |
tathA mAM viddhi sArathye shikShitaM narapu~Ngava
shlokas.18:
yasya yAte na pashyanti bhUmau prAptaM padaM padam |
dakShiNaM yo dhuraM yuktaH sugrIvasadRRisho hayaH
shlokas.19:
yo.ayaM dhuraM dhuryavaro vAmaM vahati shobhanaH |
taM manye meghapuShpasya javena sadRRishaM hayam
shlokas.20:
yo.ayaM kA~nchanasaMnAhaH pArShNiM vahati shobhanaH |
vAmaM sainyasya manye taM javena balavattaram
shlokas.21:
yo.ayaM vahati te pArShNiM dakShiNAma~nchitodyataH |
balAhakAdapi mataH sa jave vIryavattaraH
shlokas.22:
tvAmevAyaM ratho voDhuM sa~NgrAme.arhati dhanvinam |
tvaM chemaM rathamAsthAya yoddhumarho mato mama
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato nirmuchya bAhubhyAM valayAni sa vIryavAn |
chitre dundubhisaMnAde pratyamu~nchattale shubhe
shlokas.24:
kRRiShNAnbha~NgImataH keshA~nshvetenodgrathya vAsasA |
adhijyaM tarasA kRRitvA gANDIvaM vyAkShipaddhanuH
shlokas.25:
tasya vikShipyamANasya dhanuSho.abhUnmahAsvanaH |
yathA shailasya mahataH shailenaivAbhijaghnuShaH
shlokas.26:
sanirghAtAbhavadbhUmirdikShu vAyurvavau bhRRisham |
bhrAntadvijaM khaM tadAsItprakampitamahAdrumam
shlokas.27:
taM shabdaM kuravo.ajAnanvisphoTamashaneriva |
yadarjuno dhanuHshreShThaM bAhubhyAmAkShipadrathe

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
uttaraM sArathiM kRRitvA shamIM kRRitvA pradakShiNam |
AyudhaM sarvamAdAya tataH prAyAddhana~njayaH
shlokas.2:
dhvajaM siMhaM rathAttasmAdapanIya mahArathaH |
praNidhAya shamImUle prAyAduttarasArathiH
shlokas.3:
daivIM mAyAM rathe yuktvA vihitAM vishvakarmaNA |
kA~nchanaM siMhalA~NgUlaM dhvajaM vAnaralakShaNam
shlokas.4:
manasA chintayAmAsa prasAdaM pAvakasya cha |
sa cha tachchintitaM j~nAtvA dhvaje bhUtAnyachodayat
shlokas.5:
sapatAkaM vichitrA~NgaM sopAsa~NgaM mahArathaH |
rathamAsthAya bIbhatsuH kaunteyaH shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.6:
baddhAsiH satanutrANaH pragRRihItasharAsanaH |
tataH prAyAdudIchIM sa kapipravaraketanaH
shlokas.7:
svanavantaM mahAsha~NkhaM balavAnarimardanaH |
prAdhamadbalamAsthAya dviShatAM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.8:
tataste javanA dhuryA jAnubhyAmagamanmahIm |
uttarashchApi santrasto rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.9:
sa.nsthApya chAshvAnkaunteyaH samudyamya cha rashmibhiH |
uttaraM cha pariShvajya samAshvAsayadarjunaH
shlokas.10:
mA bhaistvaM rAjaputrAgrya kShatriyo.asi parantapa |
kathaM puruShashArdUla shatrumadhye viShIdasi
shlokas.11:
shrutAste sha~NkhashabdAshcha bherIshabdAshcha puShkalAH |
ku~njarANAM cha nadatAM vyUDhAnIkeShu tiShThatAm
shlokas.12:
sa tvaM kathamihAnena sha~Nkhashabdena bhIShitaH |
viShaNNarUpo vitrastaH puruShaH prAkRRito yathA
shlokas.13:
uttara uvAcha||
shrutA me sha~NkhashabdAshcha bherIshabdAshcha puShkalAH |
ku~njarANAM cha ninadA vyUDhAnIkeShu tiShThatAm
shlokas.14:
naiva.nvidhaH sha~NkhashabdaH purA jAtu mayA shrutaH |
dhvajasya chApi rUpaM me dRRiShTapUrvaM na hIdRRisham
dhanuShashchaiva nirghoShaH shrutapUrvo na me kvachit
shlokas.15:
asya sha~Nkhasya shabdena dhanuSho nisvanena cha |
rathasya cha ninAdena mano muhyati me bhRRisham
shlokas.16:
vyAkulAshcha dishaH sarvA hRRidayaM vyathatIva me |
dhvajena pihitAH sarvA disho na pratibhAnti me
gANDIvasya cha shabdena karNau me badhirIkRRitau
shlokas.17:
arjuna uvAcha||
ekAnte rathamAsthAya padbhyAM tvamavapIDaya |
dRRiDhaM cha rashmInsa.nyachCha sha~NkhaM dhmAsyAmyahaM punaH
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya sha~Nkhasya shabdena rathanemisvanena cha |
gANDIvasya cha ghoSheNa pRRithivI samakampata
shlokas.19:
droNa uvAcha||
yathA rathasya nirghoSho yathA sha~Nkha udIryate |
kampate cha yathA bhUmirnaiSho.anyaH savyasAchinaH
shlokas.20:
shastrANi na prakAshante na prahRRiShyanti vAjinaH |
agnayashcha na bhAsante samiddhAstanna shobhanam
shlokas.21:
pratyAdityaM cha naH sarve mRRigA ghorapravAdinaH |
dhvajeShu cha nilIyante vAyasAstanna shobhanam
shakunAshchApasavyA no vedayanti mahadbhayam
shlokas.22:
gomAyureSha senAyA ruvanmadhye.anudhAvati |
anAhatashcha niShkrAnto mahadvedayate bhayam
bhavatAM romakUpANi prahRRiShTAnyupalakShaye
shlokas.23:
parAbhUtA cha vaH senA na kashchidyoddhumichChati |
vivarNamukhabhUyiShThAH sarve yodhA vichetasaH
gAH samprasthApya tiShThAmo vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha duryodhano rAjA samare bhIShmamabravIt |
droNaM cha rathashArdUlaM kRRipaM cha sumahAratham
shlokas.2:
ukto.ayamartha AchAryo mayA karNena chAsakRRit |
punareva cha vakShyAmi na hi tRRipyAmi taM bruvan
shlokas.3:
parAjitairhi vastavyaM taishcha dvAdasha vatsarAn |
vane janapade.aj~nAtaireSha eva paNo hi naH
shlokas.4:
teShAM na tAvannirvRRittaM vartate tu trayodasham |
aj~nAtavAsaM bIbhatsurathAsmAbhiH samAgataH
shlokas.5:
anivRRitte tu nirvAse yadi bIbhatsurAgataH |
punardvAdasha varShANi vane vatsyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.6:
lobhAdvA te na jAnIyurasmAnvA moha Avishat |
hInAtiriktameteShAM bhIShmo veditumarhati
shlokas.7:
arthAnAM tu punardvaidhe nityaM bhavati sa.nshayaH |
anyathA chintito hyarthaH punarbhavati chAnyathA
shlokas.8:
uttaraM mArgamANAnAM matsyasenAM yuyutsatAm |
yadi bIbhatsurAyAtasteShAM kaH syAtparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.9:
trigartAnAM vayaM hetormatsyAnyoddhumihAgatAH |
matsyAnAM viprakArA.nste bahUnasmAnakIrtayan
shlokas.10:
teShAM bhayAbhipannAnAM tadasmAbhiH pratishrutam |
prathamaM tairgrahItavyaM matsyAnAM godhanaM mahat
shlokas.11:
saptamImaparAhNe vai tathA nastaiH samAhitam |
aShTamyAM punarasmAbhirAdityasyodayaM prati
shlokas.12:
te vA gAvo na pashyanti yadi va syuH parAjitAH |
asmAnvApyatisandhAya kuryurmatsyena sa~Ngatam
shlokas.13:
atha vA tAnupAyAto matsyo jAnapadaiH saha |
sarvayA senayA sArdhamasmAnyoddhumupAgataH
shlokas.14:
teShAmeva mahAvIryaH kashchideva puraHsaraH |
asmA~njetumihAyAto matsyo vApi svayaM bhavet
shlokas.15:
yadyeSha rAjA matsyAnAM yadi bIbhatsurAgataH |
sarvairyoddhavyamasmAbhiriti naH samayaH kRRitaH
shlokas.16:
atha kasmAtsthitA hyete ratheShu rathasattamAH |
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipashchaiva vikarNo drauNireva cha
shlokas.17:
sambhrAntamanasaH sarve kAle hyasminmahArathAH |
nAnyatra yuddhAchChreyo.asti tathAtmA praNidhIyatAm
shlokas.18:
AchChinne godhane.asmAkamapi devena vajriNA |
yamena vApi sa~NgrAme ko hAstinapuraM vrajet
shlokas.19:
sharairabhipraNunnAnAM bhagnAnAM gahane vane |
ko hi jIvetpadAtInAM bhavedashveShu sa.nshayaH
AchAryaM pRRiShThataH kRRitvA tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.20:
jAnAti hi mataM teShAmatastrAsayatIva naH |
arjunenAsya samprItimadhikAmupalakShaye
shlokas.21:
tathA hi dRRiShTvA bIbhatsumupAyAntaM prasha.nsati |
yathA senA na bhajyeta tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.22:
adeshikA mahAraNye grIShme shatruvashaM gatA |
yathA na vibhrametsenA tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.23:
ashvAnAM heShitaM shrutvA kA prasha.nsA bhavetpare |
sthAne vApi vrajanto vA sadA heShanti vAjinaH
shlokas.24:
sadA cha vAyavo vAnti nityaM varShati vAsavaH |
stanayitnoshcha nirghoShaH shrUyate bahushastathA
shlokas.25:
kimatra kAryaM pArthasya kathaM vA sa prashasyate |
anyatra kAmAddveShAdvA roShAdvAsmAsu kevalAt
shlokas.26:
AchAryA vai kAruNikAH prAj~nAshchApAyadarshinaH |
naite mahAbhaye prApte sampraShTavyAH katha~nchana
shlokas.27:
prAsAdeShu vichitreShu goShThIShvAvasatheShu cha |
kathA vichitrAH kurvANAH paNDitAstatra shobhanAH
shlokas.28:
bahUnyAshcharyarUpANi kurvanto janasa.nsadi |
iShvastre chArusandhAne paNDitAstatra shobhanAH
shlokas.29:
pareShAM vivaraj~nAne manuShyAchariteShu cha |
annasa.nskAradoSheShu paNDitAstatra shobhanAH
shlokas.30:
paNDitAnpRRiShThataH kRRitvA pareShAM guNavAdinaH |
vidhIyatAM tathA nItiryathA vadhyeta vai paraH
shlokas.31:
gAvashchaiva pratiShThantAM senAM vyUhantu mAchiram |
ArakShAshcha vidhIyantAM yatra yotsyAmahe parAn

shlokas.1:
karNa uvAcha||
sarvAnAyuShmato bhItAnsantrastAniva lakShaye |
ayuddhamanasashchaiva sarvA.nshchaivAnavasthitAn
shlokas.2:
yadyeSha rAjA matsyAnAM yadi bIbhatsurAgataH |
ahamAvArayiShyAmi veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.3:
mama chApapramuktAnAM sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
nAvRRittirgachChatAmasti sarpANAmiva sarpatAm
shlokas.4:
rukmapu~NkhAH sutIkShNAgrA muktA hastavatA mayA |
ChAdayantu sharAH pArthaM shalabhA iva pAdapam
shlokas.5:
sharANAM pu~NkhasaktAnAM maurvyAbhihatayA dRRiDham |
shrUyatAM talayoH shabdo bheryorAhatayoriva
shlokas.6:
samAhito hi bIbhatsurvarShANyaShTau cha pa~ncha cha |
jAtasnehashcha yuddhasya mayi samprahariShyati
shlokas.7:
pAtrIbhUtashcha kaunteyo brAhmaNo guNavAniva |
sharaughAnpratigRRihNAtu mayA muktAnsahasrashaH
shlokas.8:
eSha chaiva maheShvAsastriShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
ahaM chApi kurushreShThA arjunAnnAvaraH kvachit
shlokas.9:
itashchetashcha nirmuktaiH kA~nchanairgArdhravAjitaiH |
dRRishyatAmadya vai vyoma khadyotairiva sa.nvRRitam
shlokas.10:
adyAhamRRiNamakShayyaM purA vAchA pratishrutam |
dhArtarAShTrasya dAsyAmi nihatya samare.arjunam
shlokas.11:
antarA ChidyamAnAnAM pu~NkhAnAM vyatishIryatAm |
shalabhAnAmivAkAshe prachAraH sampradRRishyatAm
shlokas.12:
indrAshanisamasparshaM mahendrasamatejasam |
ardayiShyAmyahaM pArthamulkAbhiriva ku~njaram
shlokas.13:
tamagnimiva durdharShamasishaktisharendhanam |
pANDavAgnimahaM dIptaM pradahantamivAhitAn
shlokas.14:
ashvavegapurovAto rathaughastanayitnumAn |
sharadhAro mahAmeghaH shamayiShyAmi pANDavam
shlokas.15:
matkArmukavinirmuktAH pArthamAshIviShopamAH |
sharAH samabhisarpantu valmIkamiva pannagAH
shlokas.16:
jAmadagnyAnmayA hyastraM yatprAptamRRiShisattamAt |
tadupAshritya vIryaM cha yudhyeyamapi vAsavam
shlokas.17:
dhvajAgre vAnarastiShThanbhallena nihato mayA |
adyaiva patatAM bhUmau vinadanbhairavAnravAn
shlokas.18:
shatrormayAbhipannAnAM bhUtAnAM dhvajavAsinAm |
dishaH pratiShThamAnAnAmastu shabdo divaM gataH
shlokas.19:
adya duryodhanasyAhaM shalyaM hRRidi chirasthitam |
samUlamuddhariShyAmi bIbhatsuM pAtayanrathAt
shlokas.20:
hatAshvaM virathaM pArthaM pauruShe paryavasthitam |
niHshvasantaM yathA nAgamadya pashyantu kauravAH
shlokas.21:
kAmaM gachChantu kuravo dhanamAdAya kevalam |
ratheShu vApi tiShThanto yuddhaM pashyantu mAmakam

shlokas.1:
kRRipa uvAcha||
sadaiva tava rAdheya yuddhe krUratarA matiH |
nArthAnAM prakRRitiM vettha nAnubandhamavekShase
shlokas.2:
nayA hi bahavaH santi shAstrANyAshritya chintitAH |
teShAM yuddhaM tu pApiShThaM vedayanti purAvidaH
shlokas.3:
deshakAlena sa.nyuktaM yuddhaM vijayadaM bhavet |
hInakAlaM tadeveha phalavanna bhavatyuta
deshe kAle cha vikrAntaM kalyANAya vidhIyate
shlokas.4:
AnukUlyena kAryANAmantaraM sa.nvidhIyatAm |
bhAraM hi rathakArasya na vyavasyanti paNDitAH
shlokas.5:
parichintya tu pArthena saMnipAto na naH kShamaH |
ekaH kurUnabhyarakShadekashchAgnimatarpayat
shlokas.6:
ekashcha pa~ncha varShANi brahmacharyamadhArayat |
ekaH subhadrAmAropya dvairathe kRRiShNamAhvayat
asminneva vane kRRiShNo hRRitAM kRRiShNAmavAjayat
shlokas.7:
ekashcha pa~ncha varShANi shakrAdastrANyashikShata |
ekaH sA.nyaminIM jitvA kurUNAmakarodyashaH
shlokas.8:
eko gandharvarAjAnaM chitrasenamari.ndamaH |
vijigye tarasA sa~Nkhye senAM chAsya sudurjayAm
shlokas.9:
tathA nivAtakavachAH kAlakha~njAshcha dAnavAH |
daivatairapyavadhyAste ekena yudhi pAtitAH
shlokas.10:
ekena hi tvayA karNa kiM nAmeha kRRitaM purA |
ekaikena yathA teShAM bhUmipAlA vashIkRRitAH
shlokas.11:
indro.api hi na pArthena sa.nyuge yoddhumarhati |
yastenAsha.nsate yoddhuM kartavyaM tasya bheShajam
shlokas.12:
AshIviShasya kruddhasya pANimudyamya dakShiNam |
avimRRishya pradeshinyA daMShTrAmAdAtumichChasi
shlokas.13:
atha vA ku~njaraM mattameka eva charanvane |
ana~NkushaM samAruhya nagaraM gantumichChasi
shlokas.14:
samiddhaM pAvakaM vApi ghRRitamedovasAhutam |
ghRRitAktashchIravAsAstvaM madhyenottartumichChasi
shlokas.15:
AtmAnaM yaH samudbadhya kaNThe baddhvA mahAshilAm |
samudraM pratareddorbhyAM tatra kiM nAma pauruSham
shlokas.16:
akRRitAstraH kRRitAstraM vai balavantaM sudurbalaH |
tAdRRishaM karNa yaH pArthaM yoddhumichChetsa durmatiH
shlokas.17:
asmAbhireSha nikRRito varShANIha trayodasha |
siMhaH pAshavinirmukto na naH sheShaM kariShyati
shlokas.18:
ekAnte pArthamAsInaM kUpe.agnimiva sa.nvRRitam |
aj~nAnAdabhyavaskandya prAptAH smo bhayamuttamam
shlokas.19:
saha yudhyAmahe pArthamAgataM yuddhadurmadam |
sainyAstiShThantu saMnaddhA vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.20:
droNo duryodhano bhIShmo bhavAndrauNistathA vayam |
sarve yudhyAmahe pArthaM karNa mA sAhasaM kRRithAH
shlokas.21:
vayaM vyavasitaM pArthaM vajrapANimivodyatam |
ShaDrathAH pratiyudhyema tiShThema yadi saMhatAH
shlokas.22:
vyUDhAnIkAni sainyAni yattAH paramadhanvinaH |
yudhyAmahe.arjunaM sa~Nkhye dAnavA vAsavaM yathA

shlokas.1:
ashvatthAmovAcha||
na cha tAvajjitA gAvo na cha sImAntaraM gatAH |
na hAstinapuraM prAptAstvaM cha karNa vikatthase
shlokas.2:
sa~NgrAmAnsubahU~njitvA labdhvA cha vipulaM dhanam |
vijitya cha parAM bhUmiM nAhuH ki~nchana pauruSham
shlokas.3:
pachatyagniravAkyastu tUShNIM bhAti divAkaraH |
tUShNIM dhArayate lokAnvasudhA sacharAcharAn
shlokas.4:
chAturvarNyasya karmANi vihitAni manIShibhiH |
dhanaM yairadhigantavyaM yachcha kurvanna duShyati
shlokas.5:
adhItya brAhmaNo vedAnyAjayeta yajeta cha |
kShatriyo dhanurAshritya yajetaiva na yAjayet
vaishyo.adhigamya dravyANi brahmakarmANi kArayet
shlokas.6:
vartamAnA yathAshAstraM prApya chApi mahImimAm |
satkurvanti mahAbhAgA gurUnsuviguNAnapi
shlokas.7:
prApya dyUtena ko rAjyaM kShatriyastoShTumarhati |
tathA nRRisha.nsarUpeNa yathAnyaH prAkRRito janaH
shlokas.8:
tathAvApteShu vitteShu ko vikatthedvichakShaNaH |
nikRRityA va~nchanAyogaishcharanvaita.nsiko yathA
shlokas.9:
katamaddvairathaM yuddhaM yatrAjaiShIrdhana~njayam |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha dhanaM yeShAM tvayA hRRitam
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThiro jitaH kasminbhImashcha balinAM varaH |
indraprasthaM tvayA kasminsa~NgrAme nirjitaM purA
shlokas.11:
tathaiva katamaM yuddhaM yasminkRRiShNA jitA tvayA |
ekavastrA sabhAM nItA duShTakarmanrajasvalA
shlokas.12:
mUlameShAM mahatkRRittaM sArArthI chandanaM yathA |
karma kArayithAH shUra tatra kiM viduro.abravIt
shlokas.13:
yathAshakti manuShyANAM shamamAlakShayAmahe |
anyeShAM chaiva sattvAnAmapi kITapipIlike
shlokas.14:
draupadyAstaM parikleshaM na kShantuM pANDavo.arhati |
duHkhAya dhArtarAShTrANAM prAdurbhUto dhana~njayaH
shlokas.15:
tvaM punaH paNDito bhUtvA vAchaM vaktumihechChasi |
vairAntakaraNo jiShNurna naH sheShaM kariShyati
shlokas.16:
naiSha devAnna gandharvAnnAsurAnna cha rAkShasAn |
bhayAdiha na yudhyeta kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.17:
yaM yameSho.abhisa~NkruddhaH sa~NgrAme.abhipatiShyati |
vRRikShaM garuDavegena vinihatya tameShyati
shlokas.18:
tvatto vishiShTaM vIryeNa dhanuShyamararATsamam |
vAsudevasamaM yuddhe taM pArthaM ko na pUjayet
shlokas.19:
daivaM daivena yudhyeta mAnuSheNa cha mAnuSham |
astreNAstraM samAhanyAtko.arjunena samaH pumAn
shlokas.20:
putrAdanantaraH shiShya iti dharmavido viduH |
etenApi nimittena priyo droNasya pANDavaH
shlokas.21:
yathA tvamakarordyUtamindraprasthaM yathAharaH |
yathAnaiShIH sabhAM kRRiShNAM tathA yudhyasva pANDavam
shlokas.22:
ayaM te mAtulaH prAj~naH kShatradharmasya kovidaH |
durdyUtadevI gAndhAraH shakuniryudhyatAmiha
shlokas.23:
nAkShAnkShipati gANDIvaM na kRRitaM dvAparaM na cha |
jvalato nishitAnbANA.nstIkShNAnkShipati gANDivam
shlokas.24:
na hi gANDIvanirmuktA gArdhrapatrAH sutejanAH |
antareShvavatiShThanti girINAmapi dAraNAH
shlokas.25:
antakaH shamano mRRityustathAgnirvaDavAmukhaH |
kuryurete kvachichCheShaM na tu kruddho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.26:
yudhyatAM kAmamAchAryo nAhaM yotsye dhana~njayam |
matsyo hyasmAbhirAyodhyo yadyAgachChedgavAM padam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sAdhu pashyati vai droNaH kRRipaH sAdhvanupashyati |
karNastu kShatradharmeNa yathAvadyoddhumichChati
shlokas.2:
AchAryo nAbhiShaktavyaH puruSheNa vijAnatA |
deshakAlau tu samprekShya yoddhavyamiti me matiH
shlokas.3:
yasya sUryasamAH pa~ncha sapatnAH syuH prahAriNaH |
kathamabhyudaye teShAM na pramuhyeta paNDitaH
shlokas.4:
svArthe sarve vimuhyanti ye.api dharmavido janAH |
tasmAdrAjanbravImyeSha vAkyaM te yadi rochate
shlokas.5:
karNo yadabhyavochannastejaHsa~njananAya tat |
AchAryaputraH kShamatAM mahatkAryamupasthitam
shlokas.6:
nAyaM kAlo virodhasya kaunteye samupasthite |
kShantavyaM bhavatA sarvamAchAryeNa kRRipeNa cha
shlokas.7:
bhavatAM hi kRRitAstratvaM yathAditye prabhA tathA |
yathA chandramaso lakShma sarvathA nApakRRiShyate
evaM bhavatsu brAhmaNyaM brahmAstraM cha pratiShThitam
shlokas.8:
chatvAra ekato vedAH kShAtramekatra dRRishyate |
naitatsamastamubhayaM kasmi.nshchidanushushrumaH
shlokas.9:
anyatra bhAratAchAryAtsaputrAditi me matiH |
brahmAstraM chaiva vedAshcha naitadanyatra dRRishyate
shlokas.10:
AchAryaputraH kShamatAM nAyaM kAlaH svabhedane |
sarve saMhatya yudhyAmaH pAkashAsanimAgatam
shlokas.11:
balasya vyasanAnIha yAnyuktAni manIShibhiH |
mukhyo bhedo hi teShAM vai pApiShTho viduShAM mataH
shlokas.12:
ashvatthAmovAcha||
AchArya eva kShamatAM shAntiratra vidhIyatAm |
abhiShajyamAne hi gurau tadvRRittaM roShakAritam
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato duryodhano droNaM kShamayAmAsa bhArata |
saha karNena bhIShmeNa kRRipeNa cha mahAtmanA
shlokas.14:
droNa uvAcha||
yadeva prathamaM vAkyaM bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt |
tenaivAhaM prasanno vai paramatra vidhIyatAm
shlokas.15:
yathA duryodhane.ayatte nAgaH spRRishati sainikAn |
sAhasAdyadi vA mohAttathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.16:
vanavAse hyanirvRRitte darshayenna dhana~njayaH |
dhanaM vAlabhamAno.atra nAdya naH kShantumarhati
shlokas.17:
yathA nAyaM samAyujyAddhArtarAShTrAnkatha~nchana |
yathA cha na parAjayyAttathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.18:
uktaM duryodhanenApi purastAdvAkyamIdRRisham |
tadanusmRRitya gA~Ngeya yathAvadvaktumarhasi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kalA.nshAstAta yujyante muhUrtAshcha dinAni cha |
ardhamAsAshcha mAsAshcha nakShatrANi grahAstathA
shlokas.2:
RRitavashchApi yujyante tathA sa.nvatsarA api |
evaM kAlavibhAgena kAlachakraM pravartate
shlokas.3:
teShAM kAlAtirekeNa jyotiShAM cha vyatikramAt |
pa~nchame pa~nchame varShe dvau mAsAvupajAyataH
shlokas.4:
teShAmabhyadhikA mAsAH pa~ncha dvAdasha cha kShapAH |
trayodashAnAM varShANAmiti me vartate matiH
shlokas.5:
sarvaM yathAvachcharitaM yadyadebhiH parishrutam |
evametaddhruvaM j~nAtvA tato bIbhatsurAgataH
shlokas.6:
sarve chaiva mahAtmAnaH sarve dharmArthakovidAH |
yeShAM yudhiShThiro rAjA kasmAddharme.aparAdhnuyuH
shlokas.7:
alubdhAshchaiva kaunteyAH kRRitavantashcha duShkaram |
na chApi kevalaM rAjyamichCheyuste.anupAyataH
shlokas.8:
tadaiva te hi vikrAntumIShuH kauravanandanAH |
dharmapAshanibaddhAstu na cheluH kShatriyavratAt
shlokas.9:
yachchAnRRita iti khyAyedyachcha gachChetparAbhavam |
vRRiNuyurmaraNaM pArthA nAnRRitatvaM katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
prApte tu kAle prAptavyaM notsRRijeyurnararShabhAH |
api vajrabhRRitA guptaM tathAvIryA hi pANDavAH
shlokas.11:
pratiyudhyAma samare sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
tasmAdyadatra kalyANaM loke sadbhiranuShThitam
tatsa.nvidhIyatAM kShipraM mA no hyartho.atigAtparAn
shlokas.12:
na hi pashyAmi sa~NgrAme kadAchidapi kaurava |
ekAntasiddhiM rAjendra samprAptashcha dhana~njayaH
shlokas.13:
sampravRRitte tu sa~NgrAme bhAvAbhAvau jayAjayau |
avashyamekaM spRRishato dRRiShTametadasa.nshayam
shlokas.14:
tasmAdyuddhAvacharikaM karma vA dharmasaMhitam |
kriyatAmAshu rAjendra samprApto hi dhana~njayaH
shlokas.15:
duryodhana uvAcha||
nAhaM rAjyaM pradAsyAmi pANDavAnAM pitAmaha |
yuddhAvachArikaM yattu tachChIghraM sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra yA mAmakI buddhiH shrUyatAM yadi rochate |
kShipraM balachaturbhAgaM gRRihya gachCha puraM prati
tato.aparashchaturbhAgo gAH samAdAya gachChatu
shlokas.17:
vayaM tvardhena sainyena pratiyotsyAma pANDavam |
matsyaM vA punarAyAtamatha vApi shatakratum
shlokas.18:
AchAryo madhyatastiShThatvashvatthAmA tu savyataH |
kRRipaH shAradvato dhImAnpArshvaM rakShatu dakShiNam
shlokas.19:
agrataH sUtaputrastu karNastiShThatu da.nshitaH |
ahaM sarvasya sainyasya pashchAtsthAsyAmi pAlayan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA vyUDheShvanIkeShu kauraveyairmahArathaiH |
upAyAdarjunastUrNaM rathaghoSheNa nAdayan
shlokas.2:
dadRRishuste dhvajAgraM vai shushruvushcha rathasvanam |
dodhUyamAnasya bhRRishaM gANDIvasya cha nisvanam
shlokas.3:
tatastatsarvamAlokya droNo vachanamabravIt |
mahArathamanuprAptaM dRRiShTvA gANDIvadhanvinam
shlokas.4:
etaddhvajAgraM pArthasya dUrataH samprakAshate |
eSha ghoShaH sajalado roravIti cha vAnaraH
shlokas.5:
eSha tiShThanrathashreShTho rathe rathavarapraNut |
utkarShati dhanuHshreShThaM gANDIvamashanisvanam
shlokas.6:
imau hi bANau sahitau pAdayorme vyavasthitau |
aparau chApyatikrAntau karNau sa.nspRRishya me sharau
shlokas.7:
niruShya hi vane vAsaM kRRitvA karmAtimAnuSham |
abhivAdayate pArthaH shrotre cha paripRRichChati
shlokas.8:
arjuna uvAcha||
iShupAte cha senAyA hayAnsa.nyachCha sArathe |
yAvatsamIkShe sainye.asminkvAsau kurukulAdhamaH
shlokas.9:
sarvAnanyAnanAdRRitya dRRiShTvA tamatimAninam |
tasya mUrdhni patiShyAmi tata ete parAjitAH
shlokas.10:
eSha vyavasthito droNo drauNishcha tadanantaram |
bhIShmaH kRRipashcha karNashcha maheShvAsA vyavasthitAH
shlokas.11:
rAjAnaM nAtra pashyAmi gAH samAdAya gachChati |
dakShiNaM mArgamAsthAya sha~Nke jIvaparAyaNaH
shlokas.12:
utsRRijyaitadrathAnIkaM gachCha yatra suyodhanaH |
tatraiva yotsye vairATe nAsti yuddhaM nirAmiSham
taM jitvA vinivartiShye gAH samAdAya vai punaH
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa vairATirhayAnsa.nyamya yatnataH |
niyamya cha tato rashmInyatra te kurupu~NgavAH
achodayattato vAhAnyato duryodhanastataH
shlokas.14:
utsRRijya rathava.nshaM tu prayAte shvetavAhane |
abhiprAyaM viditvAsya droNo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.15:
naiSho.antareNa rAjAnaM bIbhatsuH sthAtumichChati |
tasya pArShNiM grahIShyAmo javenAbhiprayAsyataH
shlokas.16:
na hyenamabhisa~Nkruddhameko yudhyeta sa.nyuge |
anyo devAtsahasrAkShAtkRRiShNAdvA devakIsutAt
shlokas.17:
kiM no gAvaH kariShyanti dhanaM vA vipulaM tathA |
duryodhanaH pArthajale purA nauriva majjati
shlokas.18:
tathaiva gatvA bIbhatsurnAma vishrAvya chAtmanaH |
shalabhairiva tAM senAM sharaiH shIghramavAkirat
shlokas.19:
kIryamANAH sharaughaistu yodhAste pArthachoditaiH |
nApashyannAvRRitAM bhUmimantarikShaM cha patribhiH
shlokas.20:
teShAM nAtmanino yuddhe nApayAne.abhavanmatiH |
shIghratvameva pArthasya pUjayanti sma chetasA
shlokas.21:
tataH sha~NkhaM pradadhmau sa dviShatAM lomaharShaNam |
visphArya cha dhanuHshreShThaM dhvaje bhUtAnyachodayat
shlokas.22:
tasya sha~Nkhasya shabdena rathanemisvanena cha |
amAnuShANAM teShAM cha bhUtAnAM dhvajavAsinAm
shlokas.23:
UrdhvaM puchChAnvidhunvAnA rebhamANAH samantataH |
gAvaH pratinyavartanta dishamAsthAya dakShiNAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa shatrusenAM tarasA praNudya; gAstA vijityAtha dhanurdharAgryaH |
duryodhanAyAbhimukhaM prayAto; bhUyo.arjunaH priyamAjau chikIrShan
shlokas.2:
goShu prayAtAsu javena matsyA;nkirITinaM kRRitakAryaM cha matvA |
duryodhanAyAbhimukhaM prayAntaM; kurupravIrAH sahasAbhipetuH
shlokas.3:
teShAmanIkAni bahUni gADhaM; vyUDhAni dRRiShTvA bahuladhvajAni |
matsyasya putraM dviShatAM nihantA; vairATimAmantrya tato.abhyuvAcha
shlokas.4:
etena tUrNaM pratipAdayemA;~nshvetAnhayAnkA~nchanarashmiyoktrAn |
javena sarveNa kuru prayatna;mAsAdayaitadrathasiMhavRRindam
shlokas.5:
gajo gajeneva mayA durAtmA; yo yoddhumAkA~NkShati sUtaputraH |
tameva mAM prApaya rAjaputra; duryodhanApAshrayajAtadarpam
shlokas.6:
sa tairhayairvAtajavairbRRihadbhiH; putro virATasya suvarNakakShyaiH |
vidhva.nsaya.nstadrathinAmanIkaM; tato.avahatpANDavamAjimadhye
shlokas.7:
taM chitraseno vishikhairvipAThaiH; sa~NgrAmajichChatrusaho jayashcha |
pratyudyayurbhAratamApatantaM; mahArathAH karNamabhIpsamAnAH
shlokas.8:
tataH sa teShAM puruShapravIraH; sharAsanArchiH sharavegatApaH |
vrAtAnrathAnAmadahatsa manyu;rvanaM yathAgniH kurupu~NgavAnAm
shlokas.9:
tasmi.nstu yuddhe tumule pravRRitte; pArthaM vikarNo.atirathaM rathena |
vipAThavarSheNa kurupravIro; bhImena bhImAnujamAsasAda
shlokas.10:
tato vikarNasya dhanurvikRRiShya; jAmbUnadAgryopachitaM dRRiDhajyam |
apAtayaddhvajamasya pramathya; ChinnadhvajaH so.apyapayAjjavena
shlokas.11:
taM shAtravANAM gaNabAdhitAraM; karmANi kurvANamamAnuShANi |
shatruntapaH kopamamRRiShyamANaH; samarpayatkUrmanakhena pArtham
shlokas.12:
sa tena rAj~nAtirathena viddho; vigAhamAno dhvajinIM kurUNAm |
shatruntapaM pa~nchabhirAshu viddhvA; tato.asya sUtaM dashabhirjaghAna
shlokas.13:
tataH sa viddho bharatarShabheNa; bANena gAtrAvaraNAtigena |
gatAsurAjau nipapAta bhUmau; nago nagAgrAdiva vAtarugNaH
shlokas.14:
ratharShabhAste tu ratharShabheNa; vIrA raNe vIratareNa bhagnAH |
chakampire vAtavashena kAle; prakampitAnIva mahAvanAni
shlokas.15:
hatAstu pArthena narapravIrA; bhUmau yuvAnaH suShupuH suveShAH |
vasupradA vAsavatulyavIryAH; parAjitA vAsavajena sa~Nkhye
suvarNakArShNAyasavarmanaddhA; nAgA yathA haimavatAH pravRRiddhAH
shlokas.16:
tathA sa shatrUnsamare vinighna;ngANDIvadhanvA puruShapravIraH |
chachAra sa~Nkhye pradisho dishashcha; dahannivAgnirvanamAtapAnte
shlokas.17:
prakIrNaparNAni yathA vasante; vishAtayitvAtyanilo nudankhe |
tathA sapatnAnvikirankirITI; chachAra sa~Nkhye.atiratho rathena
shlokas.18:
shoNAshvavAhasya hayAnnihatya; vaikartanabhrAturadInasattvaH |
ekena sa~NgrAmajitaH shareNa; shiro jahArAtha kirITamAlI
shlokas.19:
tasminhate bhrAtari sUtaputro; vaikartano vIryamathAdadAnaH |
pragRRihya dantAviva nAgarAjo; maharShabhaM vyAghra ivAbhyadhAvat
shlokas.20:
sa pANDavaM dvAdashabhiH pRRiShatkai;rvaikartanaH shIghramupAjaghAna |
vivyAdha gAtreShu hayA.nshcha sarvA;nvirATaputraM cha sharairnijaghne
shlokas.21:
sa hastinevAbhihato gajendraH; pragRRihya bhallAnnishitAnniSha~NgAt |
AkarNapUrNaM cha dhanurvikRRiShya; vivyAdha bANairatha sUtaputram
shlokas.22:
athAsya bAhUrushirolalATaM; grIvAM rathA~NgAni parAvamardI |
sthitasya bANairyudhi nirbibheda; gANDIvamuktairashaniprakAshaiH
shlokas.23:
sa pArthamuktairvishikhaiH praNunno; gajo gajeneva jitastarasvI |
vihAya sa~NgrAmashiraH prayAto; vaikartanaH pANDavabANataptaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
apayAte tu rAdheye duryodhanapurogamAH |
anIkena yathAsvena sharairArchChanta pANDavam
shlokas.2:
bahudhA tasya sainyasya vyUDhasyApatataH sharaiH |
abhiyAnIyamAj~nAya vairATiridamabravIt
shlokas.3:
AsthAya ruchiraM jiShNo rathaM sArathinA mayA |
katamadyAsyase.anIkamukto yAsyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.4:
arjuna uvAcha||
lohitAkShamariShTaM yaM vaiyAghramanupashyasi |
nIlAM patAkAmAshritya rathe tiShThantamuttara
shlokas.5:
kRRipasyaitadrathAnIkaM prApayasvaitadeva mAm |
etasya darshayiShyAmi shIghrAstraM dRRiDhadhanvinaH
shlokas.6:
kamaNDalurdhvaje yasya shAtakumbhamayaH shubhaH |
AchArya eSha vai droNaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.7:
suprasannamanA vIra kuruShvainaM pradakShiNam |
atraiva chAvirodhena eSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.8:
yadi me prathamaM droNaH sharIre prahariShyati |
tato.asya prahariShyAmi nAsya kopo bhaviShyati
shlokas.9:
asyAvidUre tu dhanurdhvajAgre yasya dRRishyate |
AchAryasyaiSha putro vai ashvatthAmA mahArathaH
shlokas.10:
sadA mamaiSha mAnyashcha sarvashastrabhRRitAmapi |
etasya tvaM rathaM prApya nivartethAH punaH punaH
shlokas.11:
ya eSha tu rathAnIke suvarNakavachAvRRitaH |
senAgryeNa tRRitIyena vyavahAryeNa tiShThati
shlokas.12:
yasya nAgo dhvajAgre vai hemaketanasa.nshritaH |
dhRRitarAShTrAtmajaH shrImAneSha rAjA suyodhanaH
shlokas.13:
etasyAbhimukhaM vIra rathaM pararathArujaH |
prApayasvaiSha tejobhipramAthI yuddhadurmadaH
shlokas.14:
eSha droNasya shiShyANAM shIghrAstraH prathamo mataH |
etasya darshayiShyAmi shIghrAstraM vipulaM sharaiH
shlokas.15:
nAgakakShyA tu ruchirA dhvajAgre yasya tiShThati |
eSha vaikartanaH karNo viditaH pUrvameva te
shlokas.16:
etasya rathamAsthAya rAdheyasya durAtmanaH |
yatto bhavethAH sa~NgrAme spardhatyeSha mayA sadA
shlokas.17:
yastu nIlAnusAreNa pa~nchatAreNa ketunA |
hastAvApI bRRihaddhanvA rathe tiShThati vIryavAn
shlokas.18:
yasya tArArkachitro.asau rathe dhvajavaraH sthitaH |
yasyaitatpANDuraM ChatraM vimalaM mUrdhni tiShThati
shlokas.19:
mahato rathava.nshasya nAnAdhvajapatAkinaH |
balAhakAgre sUryo vA ya eSha pramukhe sthitaH
shlokas.20:
haimaM chandrArkasa~NkAshaM kavachaM yasya dRRishyate |
jAtarUpashirastrANastrAsayanniva me manaH
shlokas.21:
eSha shAntanavo bhIShmaH sarveShAM naH pitAmahaH |
rAjashriyAvabaddhastu duryodhanavashAnugaH
shlokas.22:
pashchAdeSha prayAtavyo na me vighnakaro bhavet |
etena yudhyamAnasya yattaH sa.nyachCha me hayAn
shlokas.23:
tato.abhyavahadavyagro vairATiH savyasAchinam |
yatrAtiShThatkRRipo rAjanyotsyamAno dhana~njayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAnyanIkAnyadRRishyanta kurUNAmugradhanvinAm |
sa.nsarpanto yathA meghA gharmAnte mandamArutAH
shlokas.2:
abhyAshe vAjinastasthuH samArUDhAH prahAribhiH |
bhImarUpAshcha mAta~NgAstomarA~NkushachoditAH
shlokas.3:
tataH shakraH suragaNaiH samAruhya sudarshanam |
sahopAyAttadA rAjanvishvAshvimarutAM gaNaiH
shlokas.4:
taddevayakShagandharvamahoragasamAkulam |
shushubhe.abhravinirmuktaM grahairiva nabhastalam
shlokas.5:
astrANAM cha balaM teShAM mAnuSheShu prayujyatAm |
tachcha ghoraM mahadyuddhaM bhIShmArjunasamAgame
shlokas.6:
shataM shatasahasrANAM yatra sthUNA hiraNmayAH |
maNiratnamayAshchAnyAH prAsAdamupadhArayan
shlokas.7:
tatra kAmagamaM divyaM sarvaratnavibhUShitam |
vimAnaM devarAjasya shushubhe khecharaM tadA
shlokas.8:
tatra devAstrayastri.nshattiShThanti sahavAsavAH |
gandharvA rAkShasAH sarpAH pitarashcha maharShibhiH
shlokas.9:
tathA rAjA vasumanA balAkShaH supratardanaH |
aShTakashcha shibishchaiva yayAtirnahuSho gayaH
shlokas.10:
manuH kShupo raghurbhAnuH kRRishAshvaH sagaraH shalaH |
vimAne devarAjasya samadRRishyanta suprabhAH
shlokas.11:
agnerIshasya somasya varuNasya prajApateH |
tathA dhAturvidhAtushcha kuberasya yamasya cha
shlokas.12:
alambusograsenasya gandharvasya cha tumburoH |
yathAbhAgaM yathoddeshaM vimAnAni chakAshire
shlokas.13:
sarvadevanikAyAshcha siddhAshcha paramarShayaH |
arjunasya kurUNAM cha draShTuM yuddhamupAgatAH
shlokas.14:
divyAnAM tatra mAlyAnAM gandhaH puNyo.atha sarvashaH |
prasasAra vasantAgre vanAnAmiva puShpitAm
shlokas.15:
raktAraktAni devAnAM samadRRishyanta tiShThatAm |
AtapatrANi vAsA.nsi srajashcha vyajanAni cha
shlokas.16:
upashAmyadrajo bhaumaM sarvaM vyAptaM marIchibhiH |
divyAngandhAnupAdAya vAyuryodhAnasevata
shlokas.17:
prabhAsitamivAkAshaM chitrarUpamala~NkRRitam |
sampatadbhiH sthitaishchaiva nAnAratnAvabhAsitaiH
vimAnairvividhaishchitrairupAnItaiH surottamaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etasminnantare tatra mahAvIryaparAkramaH |
AjagAma mahAsattvaH kRRipaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH
arjunaM prati sa.nyoddhuM yuddhArthI sa mahArathaH
shlokas.2:
tau rathau sUryasa~NkAshau yotsyamAnau mahAbalau |
shAradAviva jImUtau vyarochetAM vyavasthitau
shlokas.3:
pArtho.api vishrutaM loke gANDIvaM paramAyudham |
vikRRiShya chikShepa bahUnnArAchAnmarmabhedinaH
shlokas.4:
tAnaprAptA~nshitairbANairnArAchAnraktabhojanAn |
kRRipashchichCheda pArthasya shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
tataH pArthashcha sa~NkruddhashchitrAnmArgAnpradarshayan |
dishaH sa~nChAdayanbANaiH pradishashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.6:
ekachChAyamivAkAshaM prakurvansarvataH prabhuH |
prachChAdayadameyAtmA pArthaH sharashataiH kRRipam
shlokas.7:
sa sharairarpitaH kruddhaH shitairagnishikhopamaiH |
tUrNaM sharasahasreNa pArthamapratimaujasam
arpayitvA mahAtmAnaM nanAda samare kRRipaH
shlokas.8:
tataH kanakapu~NkhAgrairvIraH saMnataparvabhiH |
tvarangANDIvanirmuktairarjunastasya vAjinaH
chaturbhishchaturastIkShNairavidhyatparameShubhiH
shlokas.9:
te hayA nishitairviddhA jvaladbhiriva pannagaiH |
utpetuH sahasA sarve kRRipaH sthAnAdathAchyavat
shlokas.10:
chyutaM tu gautamaM sthAnAtsamIkShya kurunandanaH |
nAvidhyatparavIraghno rakShamANo.asya gauravam
shlokas.11:
sa tu labdhvA punaH sthAnaM gautamaH savyasAchinam |
vivyAdha dashabhirbANaistvaritaH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.12:
tataH pArtho dhanustasya bhallena nishitena cha |
chichChedaikena bhUyashcha hastAchchApamathAharat
shlokas.13:
athAsya kavachaM bANairnishitairmarmabhedibhiH |
vyadhamanna cha pArtho.asya sharIramavapIDayat
shlokas.14:
tasya nirmuchyamAnasya kavachAtkAya Ababhau |
samaye muchyamAnasya sarpasyeva tanuryathA
shlokas.15:
Chinne dhanuShi pArthena so.anyadAdAya kArmukam |
chakAra gautamaH sajyaM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.16:
sa tadapyasya kaunteyashchichCheda nataparvaNA |
evamanyAni chApAni bahUni kRRitahastavat
shAradvatasya chichCheda pANDavaH paravIrahA
shlokas.17:
sa ChinnadhanurAdAya atha shaktiM pratApavAn |
prAhiNotpANDuputrAya pradIptAmashanImiva
shlokas.18:
tAmarjunastadAyAntIM shaktiM hemavibhUShitAm |
viyadgatAM maholkAbhAM chichCheda dashabhiH sharaiH
sApataddashadhA ChinnA bhUmau pArthena dhImatA
shlokas.19:
yugamadhye tu bhallaistu tataH sa sadhanuH kRRipaH |
tamAshu nishitaiH pArthaM bibheda dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.20:
tataH pArtho mahAtejA vishikhAnagnitejasaH |
chikShepa samare kruddhastrayodasha shilAshitAn
shlokas.21:
athAsya yugamekena chaturbhishchaturo hayAn |
ShaShThena cha shiraH kAyAchChareNa rathasAratheH
shlokas.22:
tribhistriveNuM samare dvAbhyAmakShau mahAbalaH |
dvAdashena tu bhallena chakartAsya dhvajaM tathA
shlokas.23:
tato vajranikAshena phalgunaH prahasanniva |
trayodashenendrasamaH kRRipaM vakShasyatADayat
shlokas.24:
sa ChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
gadApANiravaplutya tUrNaM chikShepa tAM gadAm
shlokas.25:
sA tu muktA gadA gurvI kRRipeNa supariShkRRitA |
arjunena sharairnunnA pratimArgamathAgamat
shlokas.26:
tato yodhAH parIpsantaH shAradvatamamarShaNam |
sarvataH samare pArthaM sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.27:
tato virATasya sutaH savyamAvRRitya vAjinaH |
yamakaM maNDalaM kRRitvA tAnyodhAnpratyavArayat
shlokas.28:
tataH kRRipamupAdAya virathaM te nararShabhAH |
apAjahrurmahAvegAH kuntIputrAddhana~njayAt

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
yatraiShA kA~nchanI vedI pradIptAgnishikhopamA |
uchChritA kA~nchane daNDe patAkAbhirala~NkRRitA
tatra mAM vaha bhadraM te droNAnIkAya mAriSha
shlokas.2:
ashvAH shoNAH prakAshante bRRihantashchAruvAhinaH |
snigdhavidrumasa~NkAshAstAmrAsyAH priyadarshanAH
yuktA rathavare yasya sarvashikShAvishAradAH
shlokas.3:
dIrghabAhurmahAtejA balarUpasamanvitaH |
sarvalokeShu vikhyAto bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn
shlokas.4:
buddhyA tulyo hyushanasA bRRihaspatisamo naye |
vedAstathaiva chatvAro brahmacharyaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.5:
sasaMhArANi divyAni sarvANyastrANi mAriSha |
dhanurvedashcha kArtsnyena yasminnityaM pratiShThitaH
shlokas.6:
kShamA damashcha satyaM cha AnRRisha.nsyamathArjavam |
ete chAnye cha bahavo guNA yasmindvijottame
shlokas.7:
tenAhaM yoddhumichChAmi mahAbhAgena sa.nyuge |
tasmAttvaM prApayAchAryaM kShipramuttara vAhaya
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
arjunenaivamuktastu vairATirhemabhUShitAn |
chodayAmAsa tAnashvAnbhAradvAjarathaM prati
shlokas.9:
tamApatantaM vegena pANDavaM rathinAM varam |
