droNaH pratyudyayau pArthaM matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.10:
tataH prAdhmApayachCha~NkhaM bherIshataninAditam |
prachukShubhe balaM sarvamuddhUta iva sAgaraH
shlokas.11:
atha shoNAnsadashvA.nstAnha.nsavarNairmanojavaiH |
mishritAnsamare dRRiShTvA vyasmayanta raNe janAH
shlokas.12:
tau rathau vIryasampannau dRRiShTvA sa~NgrAmamUrdhani |
AchAryashiShyAvajitau kRRitavidyau manasvinau
shlokas.13:
samAshliShTau tadAnyonyaM droNapArthau mahAbalau |
dRRiShTvA prAkampata muhurbharatAnAM mahadbalam
shlokas.14:
harShayuktastathA pArthaH prahasanniva vIryavAn |
rathaM rathena droNasya samAsAdya mahArathaH
shlokas.15:
abhivAdya mahAbAhuH sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA kaunteyaH paravIrahA
shlokas.16:
uShitAH sma vane vAsaM pratikarma chikIrShavaH |
kopaM nArhasi naH kartuM sadA samaradurjaya
shlokas.17:
ahaM tu prahRRite pUrvaM prahariShyAmi te.anagha |
iti me vartate buddhistadbhavAnkartumarhati
shlokas.18:
tato.asmai prAhiNoddroNaH sharAnadhikavi.nshatim |
aprAptA.nshchaiva tAnpArthashchichCheda kRRitahastavat
shlokas.19:
tataH sharasahasreNa rathaM pArthasya vIryavAn |
avAkirattato droNaH shIghramastraM vidarshayan
shlokas.20:
evaM pravavRRite yuddhaM bhAradvAjakirITinoH |
samaM vimu~nchatoH sa~Nkhye vishikhAndIptatejasaH
shlokas.21:
tAvubhau khyAtakarmANAvubhau vAyusamau jave |
ubhau divyAstraviduShAvubhAvuttamatejasau
kShipantau sharajAlAni mohayAmAsaturnRRipAn
shlokas.22:
vyasmayanta tato yodhAH sarve tatra samAgatAH |
sharAnvisRRijatostUrNaM sAdhu sAdhviti pUjayan
shlokas.23:
droNaM hi samare ko.anyo yoddhumarhati phalgunAt |
raudraH kShatriyadharmo.ayaM guruNA yadayudhyata
ityabruva~njanAstatra sa~NgrAmashirasi sthitAH
shlokas.24:
vIrau tAvapi sa.nrabdhau saMnikRRiShTau mahArathau |
ChAdayetAM sharavrAtairanyonyamaparAjitau
shlokas.25:
visphArya sumahachchApaM hemapRRiShThaM durAsadam |
sa.nrabdho.atha bharadvAjaH phalgunaM pratyayudhyata
shlokas.26:
sa sAyakamayairjAlairarjunasya rathaM prati |
bhAnumadbhiH shilAdhautairbhAnoH prachChAdayatprabhAm
shlokas.27:
pArthaM cha sa mahAbAhurmahAvegairmahArathaH |
vivyAdha nishitairbANairmegho vRRiShTyeva parvatam
shlokas.28:
tathaiva divyaM gANDIvaM dhanurAdAya pANDavaH |
shatrughnaM vegavaddhRRiShTo bhArasAdhanamuttamam
visasarja sharA.nshchitrAnsuvarNavikRRitAnbahUn
shlokas.29:
nAshaya~nsharavarShANi bhAradvAjasya vIryavAn |
tUrNaM chApavinirmuktaistadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.30:
sa rathena charanpArthaH prekShaNIyo dhana~njayaH |
yugapaddikShu sarvAsu sarvashastrANyadarshayat
shlokas.31:
ekachChAyamivAkAshaM bANaishchakre samantataH |
nAdRRishyata tadA droNo nIhAreNeva sa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.32:
tasyAbhavattadA rUpaM sa.nvRRitasya sharottamaiH |
jAjvalyamAnasya yathA parvatasyeva sarvataH
shlokas.33:
dRRiShTvA tu pArthasya raNe sharaiH svarathamAvRRitam |
sa visphArya dhanushchitraM meghastanitanisvanam
shlokas.34:
agnichakropamaM ghoraM vikarShanparamAyudham |
vyashAtayachCharA.nstA.nstu droNaH samitishobhanaH
mahAnabhUttataH shabdo va.nshAnAmiva dahyatAm
shlokas.35:
jAmbUnadamayaiH pu~NkhaishchitrachApavarAtigaiH |
prAchChAdayadameyAtmA dishaH sUryasya cha prabhAm
shlokas.36:
tataH kanakapu~NkhAnAM sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
viyachcharANAM viyati dRRishyante bahushaH prajAH
shlokas.37:
droNasya pu~NkhasaktAshcha prabhavantaH sharAsanAt |
eko dIrgha ivAdRRishyadAkAshe saMhataH sharaH
shlokas.38:
evaM tau svarNavikRRitAnvimu~nchantau mahAsharAn |
AkAshaM sa.nvRRitaM vIrAvulkAbhiriva chakratuH
shlokas.39:
sharAstayoshcha vibabhuH ka~NkabarhiNavAsasaH |
pa~NktyaH sharadi khasthAnAM ha.nsAnAM charatAmiva
shlokas.40:
yuddhaM samabhavattatra susa.nrabdhaM mahAtmanoH |
droNapANDavayorghoraM vRRitravAsavayoriva
shlokas.41:
tau gajAviva chAsAdya viShANAgraiH parasparam |
sharaiH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.42:
tau vyavAharatAM shUrau sa.nrabdhau raNashobhinau |
udIrayantau samare divyAnyastrANi bhAgashaH
shlokas.43:
atha tvAchAryamukhyena sharAnsRRiShTA~nshilAshitAn |
nyavArayachChitairbANairarjuno jayatAM varaH
shlokas.45:
jighA.nsantaM naravyAghramarjunaM tigmatejasam |
AchAryamukhyaH samare droNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH
arjunena sahAkrIDachCharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.46:
divyAnyastrANi mu~nchantaM bhAradvAjaM mahAraNe |
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya phalgunaH samayodhayat
shlokas.48:
aindraM vAyavyamAgneyamastramastreNa pANDavaH |
droNena muktaM muktaM tu grasate sma punaH punaH
shlokas.49:
evaM shUrau maheShvAsau visRRijantau shitA~nsharAn |
ekachChAyaM chakratustAvAkAshaM sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.50:
tato.arjunena muktAnAM patatAM cha sharIriShu |
parvateShviva vajrANAM sharANAM shrUyate svanaH
shlokas.51:
tato nAgA rathAshchaiva sAdinashcha vishAM pate |
shoNitAktA vyadRRishyanta puShpitA iva ki.nshukAH
shlokas.52:
bAhubhishcha sakeyUrairvichitraishcha mahArathaiH |
suvarNachitraiH kavachairdhvajaishcha vinipAtitaiH
shlokas.54:
vidhunvAnau tu tau vIrau dhanuShI bhArasAdhane |
AchChAdayetAmanyonyaM titakShantau raNeShubhiH
shlokas.55:
athAntarikShe nAdo.abhUddroNaM tatra prasha.nsatAm |
duShkaraM kRRitavAndroNo yadarjunamayodhayat
shlokas.56:
pramAthinaM mahAvIryaM dRRiDhamuShTiM durAsadam |
jetAraM devadaityAnAM sarpANAM cha mahAratham
shlokas.57:
avishramaM cha shikShAM cha lAghavaM dUrapAtitAm |
pArthasya samare dRRiShTvA droNasyAbhUchcha vismayaH
shlokas.58:
atha gANDIvamudyamya divyaM dhanuramarShaNaH |
vichakarSha raNe pArtho bAhubhyAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.59:
tasya bANamayaM varShaM shalabhAnAmivAyatam |
na cha bANAntare vAyurasya shaknoti sarpitum
shlokas.60:
anishaM sa.ndadhAnasya sharAnutsRRijatastadA |
dadRRishe nAntaraM ki~nchitpArthasyAdadato.api cha
shlokas.61:
tathA shIghrAstrayuddhe tu vartamAne sudAruNe |
shIghrAchChIghrataraM pArthaH sharAnanyAnudIrayat
shlokas.62:
tataH shatasahasrANi sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
yugapatprApata.nstatra droNasya rathamantikAt
shlokas.63:
avakIryamANe droNe tu sharairgANDIvadhanvanA |
hAhAkAro mahAnAsItsainyAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.64:
pANDavasya tu shIghrAstraM maghavAnsamapUjayat |
gandharvApsarasashchaiva ye cha tatra samAgatAH
shlokas.65:
tato vRRindena mahatA rathAnAM rathayUthapaH |
AchAryaputraH sahasA pANDavaM pratyavArayat
shlokas.66:
ashvatthAmA tu tatkarma hRRidayena mahAtmanaH |
pUjayAmAsa pArthasya kopaM chAsyAkarodbhRRisham
shlokas.67:
sa manyuvashamApannaH pArthamabhyadravadraNe |
kira~nsharasahasrANi parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn
shlokas.68:
AvRRitya tu mahAbAhuryato drauNistato hayAn |
antaraM pradadau pArtho droNasya vyapasarpitum
shlokas.69:
sa tu labdhvAntaraM tUrNamapAyAjjavanairhayaiH |
ChinnavarmadhvajaH shUro nikRRittaH parameShubhiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM pArthaH pratijagrAha vAyuvegamivoddhatam |
sharajAlena mahatA varShamANamivAmbudam
shlokas.2:
tayordevAsurasamaH saMnipAto mahAnabhUt |
kiratoH sharajAlAni vRRitravAsavayoriva
shlokas.3:
na sma sUryastadA bhAti na cha vAti samIraNaH |
sharagADhe kRRite vyomni ChAyAbhUte samantataH
shlokas.4:
mahA.nshchaTachaTAshabdo yodhayorhanyamAnayoH |
dahyatAmiva veNUnAmAsItparapura~njaya
shlokas.5:
hayAnasyArjunaH sarvAnkRRitavAnalpajIvitAn |
sa rAjanna prajAnAti dishaM kA~nchana mohitaH
shlokas.6:
tato drauNirmahAvIryaH pArthasya vichariShyataH |
vivaraM sUkShmamAlokya jyAM chichCheda kShureNa ha
tadasyApUjayandevAH karma dRRiShTvAtimAnuSham
shlokas.7:
tato drauNirdhanUMShyaShTau vyapakramya nararShabham |
punarabhyAhanatpArthaM hRRidaye ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.8:
tataH pArtho mahAbAhuH prahasya svanavattadA |
yojayAmAsa navayA maurvyA gANDIvamojasA
shlokas.9:
tato.ardhachandramAvRRitya tena pArthaH samAgamat |
vAraNeneva mattena matto vAraNayUthapaH
shlokas.10:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM pRRithivyAmekavIrayoH |
raNamadhye dvayoreva sumahallomaharShaNam
shlokas.11:
tau vIrau kuravaH sarve dadRRishurvismayAnvitAH |
yudhyamAnau mahAtmAnau yUthapAviva sa~Ngatau
shlokas.12:
tau samAjaghnaturvIrAvanyonyaM puruSharShabhau |
sharairAshIviShAkArairjvaladbhiriva pannagaiH
shlokas.13:
akShayyAviShudhI divyau pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
tena pArtho raNe shUrastasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.14:
ashvatthAmnaH punarbANAH kShipramabhyasyato raNe |
jagmuH parikShayaM shIghramabhUttenAdhiko.arjunaH
shlokas.15:
tataH karNo mahachchApaM vikRRiShyAbhyadhikaM ruShA |
avAkShipattataH shabdo hAhAkAro mahAnabhUt
shlokas.16:
tatra chakShurdadhe pArtho yatra visphAryate dhanuH |
dadarsha tatra rAdheyaM tasya kopo.atyavIvRRidhat
shlokas.17:
sa roShavashamApannaH karNameva jighA.nsayA |
avaikShata vivRRittAbhyAM netrAbhyAM kurupu~NgavaH
shlokas.18:
tathA tu vimukhe pArthe droNaputrasya sAyakAn |
tvaritAH puruShA rAjannupAjahruH sahasrashaH
shlokas.19:
utsRRijya cha mahAbAhurdroNaputraM dhana~njayaH |
abhidudrAva sahasA karNameva sapatnajit
shlokas.20:
tamabhidrutya kaunteyaH krodhasa.nraktalochanaH |
kAmayandvairathe yuddhamidaM vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
karNa yatte sabhAmadhye bahu vAchA vikatthitam |
na me yudhi samo.astIti tadidaM pratyupasthitam
shlokas.2:
avochaH paruShA vAcho dharmamutsRRijya kevalam |
idaM tu duShkaraM manye yadidaM te chikIrShitam
shlokas.3:
yattvayA kathitaM pUrvaM mAmanAsAdya ki~nchana |
tadadya kuru rAdheya kurumadhye mayA saha
shlokas.4:
yatsabhAyAM sma pA~nchAlIM klishyamAnAM durAtmabhiH |
dRRiShTavAnasi tasyAdya phalamApnuhi kevalam
shlokas.5:
dharmapAshanibaddhena yanmayA marShitaM purA |
tasya rAdheya kopasya vijayaM pashya me mRRidhe
shlokas.6:
ehi karNa mayA sArdhaM pratipadyasva sa~Ngaram |
prekShakAH kuravaH sarve bhavantu sahasainikAH
shlokas.7:
karNa uvAcha||
bravIShi vAchA yatpArtha karmaNA tatsamAchara |
atishete hi vai vAchaM karmeti prathitaM bhuvi
shlokas.8:
yattvayA marShitaM pUrvaM tadashaktena marShitam |
iti gRRihNAmi tatpArtha tava dRRiShTvAparAkramam
shlokas.9:
dharmapAshanibaddhena yadi te marShitaM purA |
tathaiva baddhamAtmAnamabaddhamiva manyase
shlokas.10:
yadi tAvadvane vAso yathoktashcharitastvayA |
tattvaM dharmArthavitkliShTaH samayaM bhettumichChasi
shlokas.11:
yadi shakraH svayaM pArtha yudhyate tava kAraNAt |
tathApi na vyathA kAchinmama syAdvikramiShyataH
shlokas.12:
ayaM kaunteya kAmaste nachirAtsamupasthitaH |
yotsyase tvaM mayA sArdhamadya drakShyasi me balam
shlokas.13:
arjuna uvAcha||
idAnImeva tAvattvamapayAto raNAnmama |
tena jIvasi rAdheya nihatastvanujastava
shlokas.14:
bhrAtaraM ghAtayitvA cha tyaktvA raNashirashcha kaH |
tvadanyaH puruShaH satsu brUyAdevaM vyavasthitaH
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
iti karNaM bruvanneva bIbhatsuraparAjitaH |
abhyayAdvisRRijanbANAnkAyAvaraNabhedinaH
shlokas.16:
pratijagrAha tAnkarNaH sharAnagnishikhopamAn |
sharavarSheNa mahatA varShamANa ivAmbudaH
shlokas.17:
utpetuH sharajAlAni ghorarUpANi sarvashaH |
avidhyadashvAnbAhvoshcha hastAvApaM pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.18:
so.amRRiShyamANaH karNasya niSha~NgasyAvalambanam |
chichCheda nishitAgreNa shareNa nataparvaNA
shlokas.19:
upAsa~NgAdupAdAya karNo bANAnathAparAn |
vivyAdha pANDavaM haste tasya muShTirashIryata
shlokas.20:
tataH pArtho mahAbAhuH karNasya dhanurachChinat |
sa shaktiM prAhiNottasmai tAM pArtho vyadhamachCharaiH
shlokas.21:
tato.abhipeturbahavo rAdheyasya padAnugAH |
tA.nshcha gANDIvanirmuktaiH prAhiNodyamasAdanam
shlokas.22:
tato.asyAshvA~nsharaistIkShNairbIbhatsurbhArasAdhanaiH |
AkarNamuktairabhyaghna.nste hatAH prApatanbhuvi
shlokas.23:
athApareNa bANena jvalitena mahAbhujaH |
vivyAdha karNaM kaunteyastIkShNenorasi vIryavAn
shlokas.24:
tasya bhittvA tanutrANaM kAyamabhyapatachCharaH |
tataH sa tamasAviShTo na sma ki~nchitprajaj~nivAn
shlokas.25:
sa gADhavedano hitvA raNaM prAyAduda~NmukhaH |
tato.arjuna upAkroshaduttarashcha mahArathaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vaikartanaM jitvA pArtho vairATimabravIt |
etanmAM prApayAnIkaM yatra tAlo hiraNmayaH
shlokas.2:
atra shAntanavo bhIShmo rathe.asmAkaM pitAmahaH |
kA~NkShamANo mayA yuddhaM tiShThatyamaradarshanaH
AdAsyAmyahametasya dhanurjyAmapi chAhave
shlokas.3:
asyantaM divyamastraM mAM chitramadya nishAmaya |
shatahradAmivAyAntIM stanayitnorivAmbare
shlokas.4:
suvarNapRRiShThaM gANDIvaM drakShyanti kuravo mama |
dakShiNenAtha vAmena katareNa svidasyati
iti mAM sa~NgatAH sarve tarkayiShyanti shatravaH
shlokas.5:
shoNitodAM rathAvartAM nAganakrAM duratyayAm |
nadIM prasyandayiShyAmi paralokapravAhinIm
shlokas.6:
pANipAdashiraHpRRiShThabAhushAkhAnirantaram |
vanaM kurUNAM ChetsyAmi bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.7:
jayataH kauravIM senAmekasya mama dhanvinaH |
shataM mArgA bhaviShyanti pAvakasyeva kAnane
mayA chakramivAviddhaM sainyaM drakShyasi kevalam
shlokas.8:
asambhrAnto rathe tiShTha sameShu viShameShu cha |
divamAvRRitya tiShThantaM giriM bhetsyAmi dhAribhiH
shlokas.9:
ahamindrasya vachanAtsa~NgrAme.abhyahanaM purA |
paulomAnkAlakha~njA.nshcha sahasrANi shatAni cha
shlokas.10:
ahamindrAddRRiDhAM muShTiM brahmaNaH kRRitahastatAm |
pragADhaM tumulaM chitramatividdhaM prajApateH
shlokas.11:
ahaM pAre samudrasya hiraNyapuramArujam |
jitvA ShaShTisahasrANi rathinAmugradhanvinAm
shlokas.12:
dhvajavRRikShaM pattitRRiNaM rathasiMhagaNAyutam |
vanamAdIpayiShyAmi kurUNAmastratejasA
shlokas.13:
tAnahaM rathanIDebhyaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
ekaH sa~NkAlayiShyAmi vajrapANirivAsurAn
shlokas.14:
raudraM rudrAdahaM hyastraM vAruNaM varuNAdapi |
astramAgneyamagneshcha vAyavyaM mAtarishvanaH
vajrAdIni tathAstrANi shakrAdahamavAptavAn
shlokas.15:
dhArtarAShTravanaM ghoraM narasiMhAbhirakShitam |
ahamutpATayiShyAmi vairATe vyetu te bhayam
shlokas.16:
evamAshvAsitastena vairATiH savyasAchinA |
vyagAhata rathAnIkaM bhImaM bhIShmasya dhImataH
shlokas.17:
tamAyAntaM mahAbAhuM jigIShantaM raNe parAn |
abhyavArayadavyagraH krUrakarmA dhana~njayam
shlokas.18:
taM chitramAlyAbharaNAH kRRitavidyA manasvinaH |
AgachChanbhImadhanvAnaM maurvIM paryasya bAhubhiH
shlokas.19:
duHshAsano vikarNashcha duHsaho.atha vivi.nshatiH |
Agatya bhImadhanvAnaM bIbhatsuM paryavArayan
shlokas.20:
duHshAsanastu bhallena viddhvA vairATimuttaram |
dvitIyenArjunaM vIraH pratyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.21:
tasya jiShNurupAvRRitya pRRithudhAreNa kArmukam |
chakarta gArdhrapatreNa jAtarUpapariShkRRitam
shlokas.22:
athainaM pa~nchabhiH pashchAtpratyavidhyatstanAntare |
so.apayAto raNaM hitvA pArthabANaprapIDitaH
shlokas.23:
taM vikarNaH sharaistIkShNairgArdhrapatrairajihmagaiH |
vivyAdha paravIraghnamarjunaM dhRRitarAShTrajaH
shlokas.24:
tatastamapi kaunteyaH shareNAnataparvaNA |
lalATe.abhyahanattUrNaM sa viddhaH prApatadrathAt
shlokas.25:
tataH pArthamabhidrutya duHsahaH savivi.nshatiH |
avAkirachCharaistIkShNaiH parIpsanbhrAtaraM raNe
shlokas.26:
tAvubhau gArdhrapatrAbhyAM nishitAbhyAM dhana~njayaH |
viddhvA yugapadavyagrastayorvAhAnasUdayat
shlokas.27:
tau hatAshvau vividdhA~Ngau dhRRitarAShTrAtmajAvubhau |
abhipatya rathairanyairapanItau padAnugaiH
shlokas.28:
sarvA dishashchAbhyapatadbIbhatsuraparAjitaH |
kirITamAlI kaunteyo labdhalakSho mahAbalaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha sa~Ngamya sarve tu kauravANAM mahArathAH |
arjunaM sahitA yattAH pratyayudhyanta bhArata
shlokas.2:
sa sAyakamayairjAlaiH sarvatastAnmahArathAn |
prAchChAdayadameyAtmA nIhAra iva parvatAn
shlokas.3:
nadadbhishcha mahAnAgairheShamANaishcha vAjibhiH |
bherIsha~NkhaninAdaishcha sa shabdastumulo.abhavat
shlokas.4:
narAshvakAyAnnirbhidya lohAni kavachAni cha |
pArthasya sharajAlAni viniShpetuH sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
tvaramANaH sharAnasyanpANDavaH sa babhau raNe |
madhya.ndinagato.archiShmA~nsharadIva divAkaraH
shlokas.6:
upaplavanta vitrastA rathebhyo rathinastadA |
sAdinashchAshvapRRiShThebhyo bhUmau chApi padAtayaH
shlokas.7:
sharaiH santADyamAnAnAM kavachAnAM mahAtmanAm |
tAmrarAjatalohAnAM prAdurAsInmahAsvanaH
shlokas.8:
ChannamAyodhanaM sarvaM sharIrairgatachetasAm |
gajAshvasAdibhistatra shitabANAttajIvitaiH
shlokas.9:
rathopasthAbhipatitairAstRRitA mAnavairmahI |
pranRRityadiva sa~NgrAme chApahasto dhana~njayaH
shlokas.10:
shrutvA gANDIvanirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
trastAni sarvabhUtAni vyagachChanta mahAhavAt
shlokas.11:
kuNDaloShNIShadhArINi jAtarUpasrajAni cha |
patitAni sma dRRishyante shirA.nsi raNamUrdhani
shlokas.12:
vishikhonmathitairgAtrairbAhubhishcha sakArmukaiH |
sahastAbharaNaishchAnyaiH prachChannA bhAti medinI
shlokas.13:
shirasAM pAtyamAnAnAmantarA nishitaiH sharaiH |
ashmavRRiShTirivAkAshAdabhavadbharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
darshayitvA tathAtmAnaM raudraM rudraparAkramaH |
avaruddhashcharanpArtho dashavarShANi trINi cha
krodhAgnimutsRRijadghoraM dhArtarAShTreShu pANDavaH
shlokas.15:
tasya taddahataH sainyaM dRRiShTvA chaiva parAkramam |
sarve shAntiparA yodhA dhArtarAShTrasya pashyataH
shlokas.16:
vitrAsayitvA tatsainyaM drAvayitvA mahArathAn |
arjuno jayatAM shreShThaH paryavartata bhArata
shlokas.17:
prAvartayannadIM ghorAM shoNitaughatara~NgiNIm |
asthishaivalasambAdhAM yugAnte kAlanirmitAm
shlokas.18:
sharachApaplavAM ghorAM mA.nsashoNitakardamAm |
mahArathamahAdvIpAM sha~NkhadundubhinisvanAm
chakAra mahatIM pArtho nadImuttarashoNitAm
shlokas.19:
AdadAnasya hi sharAnsandhAya cha vimu~nchataH |
vikarShatashcha gANDIvaM na ki~nchiddRRishyate.antaram

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha duryodhanaH karNo duHshAsanavivi.nshatI |
droNashcha saha putreNa kRRipashchAtiratho raNe
shlokas.2:
punarIyuH susa.nrabdhA dhana~njayajighA.nsayA |
visphArayantashchApAni balavanti dRRiDhAni cha
shlokas.3:
tAnprakIrNapatAkena rathenAdityavarchasA |
pratyudyayau mahArAja samastAnvAnaradhvajaH
shlokas.4:
tataH kRRipashcha karNashcha droNashcha rathinAM varaH |
taM mahAstrairmahAvIryaM parivArya dhana~njayam
shlokas.5:
sharaughAnsamyagasyanto jImUtA iva vArShikAH |
vavarShuH sharavarShANi prapatantaM kirITinam
shlokas.6:
iShubhirbahubhistUrNaM samare lomavAhibhiH |
adUrAtparyavasthAya pUrayAmAsurAdRRitAH
shlokas.7:
tathAvakIrNasya hi tairdivyairastraiH samantataH |
na tasya dvya~Ngulamapi vivRRitaM samadRRishyata
shlokas.8:
tataH prahasya bIbhatsurdivyamaindraM mahArathaH |
astramAdityasa~NkAshaM gANDIve samayojayat
shlokas.9:
sa rashmibhirivAdityaH pratapansamare balI |
kirITamAlI kaunteyaH sarvAnprAchChAdayatkurUn
shlokas.10:
yathA balAhake vidyutpAvako vA shilochchaye |
tathA gANDIvamabhavadindrAyudhamivAtatam
shlokas.11:
yathA varShati parjanye vidyudvibhrAjate divi |
tathA dasha dishaH sarvAH patadgANDIvamAvRRiNot
shlokas.12:
trastAshcha rathinaH sarve babhUvustatra sarvashaH |
sarve shAntiparA bhUtvA svachittAni na lebhire
sa~NgrAmavimukhAH sarve yodhAste hatachetasaH
shlokas.13:
evaM sarvANi sainyAni bhagnAni bharatarShabha |
prAdravanta dishaH sarvA nirAshAni svajIvite

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmo durAdharShaH pratApavAn |
vadhyamAneShu yodheShu dhana~njayamupAdravat
shlokas.2:
pragRRihya kArmukashreShThaM jAtarUpapariShkRRitam |
sharAnAdAya tIkShNAgrAnmarmabhedapramAthinaH
shlokas.3:
pANDureNAtapatreNa dhriyamANena mUrdhani |
shushubhe sa naravyAghro giriH sUryodaye yathA
shlokas.4:
pradhmAya sha~NkhaM gA~Ngeyo dhArtarAShTrAnpraharShayan |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya bIbhatsuM samavArayat
shlokas.5:
tamudvIkShya tathAyAntaM kaunteyaH paravIrahA |
pratyagRRihNAtprahRRiShTAtmA dhArAdharamivAchalaH
shlokas.6:
tato bhIShmaH sharAnaShTau dhvaje pArthasya vIryavAn |
samaparyanmahAvegA~nshvasamAnAnivoragAn
shlokas.7:
te dhvajaM pANDuputrasya samAsAdya patatriNaH |
jvalantaH kapimAjaghnurdhvajAgranilayA.nshcha tAn
shlokas.8:
tato bhallena mahatA pRRithudhAreNa pANDavaH |
ChatraM chichCheda bhIShmasya tUrNaM tadapatadbhuvi
shlokas.9:
dhvajaM chaivAsya kaunteyaH sharairabhyahanaddRRiDham |
shIghrakRRidrathavAhA.nshcha tathobhau pArShNisArathI
shlokas.10:
tayostadabhavadyuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
bhIShmasya saha pArthena balivAsavayoriva
shlokas.11:
bhallairbhallAH samAgamya bhIShmapANDavayoryudhi |
antarikShe vyarAjanta khadyotAH prAvRRiShIva hi
shlokas.12:
agnichakramivAviddhaM savyadakShiNamasyataH |
gANDIvamabhavadrAjanpArthasya sRRijataH sharAn
shlokas.13:
sa taiH sa~nChAdayAmAsa bhIShmaM sharashataiH shitaiH |
parvataM vAridhArAbhishChAdayanniva toyadaH
shlokas.14:
tAM sa velAmivoddhUtAM sharavRRiShTiM samutthitAm |
vyadhamatsAyakairbhIShmo arjunaM saMnivArayat
shlokas.15:
tatastAni nikRRittAni sharajAlAni bhAgashaH |
samare.abhivyashIryanta phalgunasya rathaM prati
shlokas.16:
tataH kanakapu~NkhAnAM sharavRRiShTiM samutthitAm |
pANDavasya rathAttUrNaM shalabhAnAmivAyatim
vyadhamattAM punastasya bhIShmaH sharashataiH shitaiH
shlokas.17:
tataste kuravaH sarve sAdhu sAdhviti chAbruvan |
duShkaraM kRRitavAnbhIShmo yadarjunamayodhayat
shlokas.18:
balavA.nstaruNo dakShaH kShiprakArI cha pANDavaH |
ko.anyaH samarthaH pArthasya vegaM dhArayituM raNe
shlokas.19:
RRite shAntanavAdbhIShmAtkRRiShNAdvA devakIsutAt |
AchAryapravarAdvApi bhAradvAjAnmahAbalAt
shlokas.20:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya krIDataH puruSharShabhau |
chakShUMShi sarvabhUtAnAM mohayantau mahAbalau
shlokas.21:
prAjApatyaM tathaivaindramAgneyaM cha sudAruNam |
kauberaM vAruNaM chaiva yAmyaM vAyavyameva cha
prayu~njAnau mahAtmAnau samare tau vicheratuH
shlokas.22:
vismitAnyatha bhUtAni tau dRRiShTvA sa.nyuge tadA |
sAdhu pArtha mahAbAho sAdhu bhIShmeti chAbruvan
shlokas.23:
nedaM yuktaM manuShyeShu yo.ayaM sa.ndRRishyate mahAn |
mahAstrANAM samprayogaH samare bhIShmapArthayoH
shlokas.24:
evaM sarvAstraviduShorastrayuddhamavartata |
atha jiShNurupAvRRitya pRRithudhAreNa kArmukam
chakarta bhIShmasya tadA jAtarUpapariShkRRitam
shlokas.25:
nimeShAntaramAtreNa bhIShmo.anyatkArmukaM raNe |
samAdAya mahAbAhuH sajyaM chakre mahAbalaH
sharA.nshcha subahUnkruddho mumochAshu dhana~njaye
shlokas.26:
arjuno.api sharA.nshchitrAnbhIShmAya nishitAnbahUn |
chikShepa sumahAtejAstathA bhIShmashcha pANDave
shlokas.27:
tayordivyAstraviduShorasyatoranishaM sharAn |
na visheShastadA rAja.NllakShyate sma mahAtmanoH
shlokas.28:
athAvRRiNoddasha dishaH sharairatirathastadA |
kirITamAlI kaunteyaH shUraH shAntanavastathA
shlokas.29:
atIva pANDavo bhIShmaM bhIShmashchAtIva pANDavam |
babhUva tasminsa~NgrAme rAja.Nlloke tadadbhutam
shlokas.30:
pANDavena hatAH shUrA bhIShmasya ratharakShiNaH |
sherate sma tadA rAjankaunteyasyAbhito ratham
shlokas.31:
tato gANDIvanirmuktA niramitraM chikIrShavaH |
AgachChanpu~Nkhasa.nshliShTAH shvetavAhanapatriNaH
shlokas.32:
niShpatanto rathAttasya dhautA hairaNyavAsasaH |
AkAshe samadRRishyanta ha.nsAnAmiva pa~NktayaH
shlokas.33:
tasya taddivyamastraM hi pragADhaM chitramasyataH |
prekShante smAntarikShasthAH sarve devAH savAsavAH
shlokas.34:
taddRRiShTvA paramaprIto gandharvashchitramadbhutam |
shasha.nsa devarAjAya chitrasenaH pratApavAn
shlokas.36:
nedaM manuShyAH shraddadhyurna hIdaM teShu vidyate |
paurANAnAM mahAstrANAM vichitro.ayaM samAgamaH
shlokas.37:
madhya.ndinagataM sUryaM pratapantamivAmbare |
na shaknuvanti sainyAni pANDavaM prativIkShitum
shlokas.38:
ubhau vishrutakarmANAvubhau yuddhavishAradau |
ubhau sadRRishakarmANAvubhau yudhi durAsadau
shlokas.39:
ityukto devarAjastu pArthabhIShmasamAgamam |
pUjayAmAsa divyena puShpavarSheNa bhArata
shlokas.40:
tato bhIShmaH shAntanavo vAme pArshve samarpayat |
asyataH pratisandhAya vivRRitaM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.41:
tataH prahasya bIbhatsuH pRRithudhAreNa kArmukam |
nyakRRintadgArdhrapatreNa bhIShmasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.42:
athainaM dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyatstanAntare |
yatamAnaM parAkrAntaM kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.43:
sa pIDito mahAbAhurgRRihItvA rathakUbaram |
gA~Ngeyo yudhi durdharShastasthau dIrghamivAturaH
shlokas.44:
taM visa~nj~namapovAha sa.nyantA rathavAjinAm |
upadeshamanusmRRitya rakShamANo mahAratham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhIShme tu sa~NgrAmashiro vihAya; palAyamAne dhRRitarAShTraputraH |
uchChritya ketuM vinadanmahAtmA; svayaM vigRRihyArjunamAsasAda
shlokas.2:
sa bhImadhanvAnamudagravIryaM; dhana~njayaM shatrugaNe charantam |
AkarNapUrNAyatachoditena; bhallena vivyAdha lalATamadhye
shlokas.3:
sa tena bANena samarpitena; jAmbUnadAbhena susa.nshitena |
rarAja rAjanmahanIyakarmA; yathaikaparvA ruchiraikashRRi~NgaH
shlokas.4:
athAsya bANena vidAritasya; prAdurbabhUvAsRRigajasramuShNam |
sA tasya jAmbUnadapuShpachitrA; mAleva chitrAbhivirAjate sma
shlokas.5:
sa tena bANAbhihatastarasvI; duryodhanenoddhatamanyuvegaH |
sharAnupAdAya viShAgnikalpA;nvivyAdha rAjAnamadInasattvaH
shlokas.6:
duryodhanashchApi tamugratejAH; pArthashcha duryodhanamekavIraH |
anyonyamAjau puruShapravIrau; samaM samAjaghnaturAjamIDhau
shlokas.7:
tataH prabhinnena mahAgajena; mahIdharAbhena punarvikarNaH |
rathaishchaturbhirgajapAdarakShaiH; kuntIsutaM jiShNumathAbhyadhAvat
shlokas.8:
tamApatantaM tvaritaM gajendraM; dhana~njayaH kumbhavibhAgamadhye |
AkarNapUrNena dRRiDhAyasena; bANena vivyAdha mahAjavena
shlokas.9:
pArthena sRRiShTaH sa tu gArdhrapatra; A pu~NkhadeshAtpravivesha nAgam |
vidArya shailapravaraprakAshaM; yathAshaniH parvatamindrasRRiShTaH
shlokas.10:
sharaprataptaH sa tu nAgarAjaH; pravepitA~Ngo vyathitAntarAtmA |
sa.nsIdamAno nipapAta mahyAM; vajrAhataM shRRi~NgamivAchalasya
shlokas.11:
nipAtite dantivare pRRithivyAM; trAsAdvikarNaH sahasAvatIrya |
tUrNaM padAnyaShTashatAni gatvA; vivi.nshateH syandanamAruroha
shlokas.12:
nihatya nAgaM tu shareNa tena; vajropamenAdrivarAmbudAbham |
tathAvidhenaiva shareNa pArtho; duryodhanaM vakShasi nirbibheda
shlokas.13:
tato gaje rAjani chaiva bhinne; bhagne vikarNe cha sapAdarakShe |
gANDIvamuktairvishikhaiH praNunnA;ste yodhamukhyAH sahasApajagmuH
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvaiva bANena hataM tu nAgaM; yodhA.nshcha sarvAndravato nishamya |
rathaM samAvRRitya kurupravIro; raNAtpradudrAva yato na pArthaH
shlokas.15:
taM bhImarUpaM tvaritaM dravantaM; duryodhanaM shatrusaho niSha~NgI |
prAkShveDayadyoddhumanAH kirITI; bANena viddhaM rudhiraM vamantam
shlokas.16:
arjuna uvAcha||
vihAya kIrtiM vipulaM yashashcha; yuddhAtparAvRRitya palAyase kim |
na te.adya tUryANi samAhatAni; yathAvadudyAnti gatasya yuddhe
shlokas.17:
yudhiShThirasyAsmi nideshakArI; pArthastRRitIyo yudhi cha sthiro.asmi |
tadarthamAvRRitya mukhaM prayachCha; narendravRRittaM smara dhArtarAShTra
shlokas.18:
moghaM tavedaM bhuvi nAmadheyaM; duryodhanetIha kRRitaM purastAt |
na hIha duryodhanatA tavAsti; palAyamAnasya raNaM vihAya
shlokas.19:
na te purastAdatha pRRiShThato vA; pashyAmi duryodhana rakShitAram |
paraihi yuddhena kurupravIra; prANAnpriyAnpANDavato.adya rakSha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
AhUyamAnastu sa tena sa~Nkhye; mahAmanA dhRRitarAShTrasya putraH |
nivartitastasya girA~Nkushena; gajo yathA matta ivA~Nkushena
shlokas.2:
so.amRRiShyamANo vachasAbhimRRiShTo; mahArathenAtirathastarasvI |
paryAvavartAtha rathena vIro; bhogI yathA pAdatalAbhimRRiShTaH
shlokas.3:
taM prekShya karNaH parivartamAnaM; nivartya sa.nstabhya cha viddhagAtraH |
duryodhanaM dakShiNato.abhyagachCha;tpArthaM nRRivIro yudhi hemamAlI
shlokas.4:
bhIShmastataH shAntanavo nivRRitya; hiraNyakakShyA.nstvaraya.nstura~NgAn |
duryodhanaM pashchimato.abhyarakSha;tpArthAnmahAbAhuradhijyadhanvA
shlokas.5:
droNaH kRRipashchaiva vivi.nshatishcha; duHshAsanashchaiva nivRRitya shIghram |
sarve purastAdvitateShuchApA; duryodhanArthaM tvaritAbhyupeyuH
shlokas.6:
sa tAnyanIkAni nivartamAnA;nyAlokya pUrNaughanibhAni pArthaH |
ha.nso yathA meghamivApatantaM; dhana~njayaH pratyapatattarasvI
shlokas.7:
te sarvataH samparivArya pArtha;mastrANi divyAni samAdadAnAH |
vavarShurabhyetya sharaiH samantA;nmeghA yathA bhUdharamambuvegaiH
shlokas.8:
tato.astramastreNa nivArya teShAM; gANDIvadhanvA kurupu~NgavAnAm |
saMmohanaM shatrusaho.anyadastraM; prAdushchakAraindrirapAraNIyam
shlokas.9:
tato dishashchAnudisho vivRRitya; sharaiH sudhArairnishitaiH supu~NkhaiH |
gANDIvaghoSheNa manA.nsi teShAM; mahAbalaH pravyathayAM chakAra
shlokas.10:
tataH punarbhImaravaM pragRRihya; dorbhyAM mahAsha~NkhamudAraghoSham |
vyanAdayatsa pradisho dishaH khaM; bhuvaM cha pArtho dviShatAM nihantA
shlokas.11:
te sha~NkhanAdena kurupravIrAH; saMmohitAH pArthasamIritena |
utsRRijya chApAni durAsadAni; sarve tadA shAntiparA babhUvuH
shlokas.12:
tathA visa~nj~neShu pareShu pArthaH; smRRitvA tu vAkyAni tathottarAyAH |
niryAhi madhyAditi matsyaputra;muvAcha yAvatkuravo visa~nj~nAH
shlokas.13:
AchArya shAradvatayoH sushukle; karNasya pItaM ruchiraM cha vastram |
drauNeshcha rAj~nashcha tathaiva nIle; vastre samAdatsva narapravIra
shlokas.14:
bhIShmasya sa~nj~nAM tu tathaiva manye; jAnAti me.astrapratighAtameShaH |
etasya vAhAnkuru savyatastva;mevaM hi yAtavyamamUDhasa~nj~naiH
shlokas.15:
rashmInsamutsRRijya tato mahAtmA; rathAdavaplutya virATaputraH |
vastrANyupAdAya mahArathAnAM; tUrNaM punaH svaM rathamAruroha
shlokas.16:
tato.anvashAsachchaturaH sadashvA;nputro virATasya hiraNyakakShyAn |
te tadvyatIyurdhvajinAmanIkaM; shvetA vahanto.arjunamAjimadhyAt
shlokas.17:
tathA tu yAntaM puruShapravIraM; bhIShmaH sharairabhyahanattarasvI |
sa chApi bhIShmasya hayAnnihatya; vivyAdha pArshve dashabhiH pRRiShatkaiH
shlokas.18:
tato.arjuno bhIShmamapAsya yuddhe; viddhvAsya yantAramariShTadhanvA |
tasthau vimukto rathavRRindamadhyA;drAhuM vidAryeva sahasrarashmiH
shlokas.19:
labdhvA tu sa~nj~nAM cha kurupravIraH; pArthaM samIkShyAtha mahendrakalpam |
raNAdvimuktaM sthitamekamAjau; sa dhArtarAShTrastvarito babhAShe
shlokas.20:
ayaM kathaM svidbhavatAM vimukta;staM vai prabadhnIta yathA na muchyet |
tamabravIchChAntanavaH prahasya; kva te gatA buddhirabhUtkva vIryam
shlokas.21:
shAntiM parAshvasya yathA sthito.abhU;rutsRRijya bANA.nshcha dhanushcha chitram |
na tveva bIbhatsuralaM nRRisha.nsaM; kartuM na pApe.asya mano niviShTam
shlokas.22:
trailokyahetorna jahetsvadharmaM; tasmAnna sarve nihatA raNe.asmin |
kShipraM kurUnyAhi kurupravIra; vijitya gAshcha pratiyAtu pArthaH
shlokas.23:
duryodhanastasya tu tannishamya; pitAmahasyAtmahitaM vacho.atha |
atItakAmo yudhi so.atyamarShI; rAjA viniHshvasya babhUva tUShNIm
shlokas.24:
tadbhIShmavAkyaM hitamIkShya sarve; dhana~njayAgniM cha vivardhamAnam |
nivartanAyaiva mano nidadhyu;rduryodhanaM te parirakShamANAH
shlokas.25:
tAnprasthitAnprItamanAH sa pArtho; dhana~njayaH prekShya kurupravIrAn |
AbhAShamANo.anuyayau muhUrtaM; sampUjaya.nstatra gurUnmahAtmA
shlokas.26:
pitAmahaM shAntanavaM sa vRRiddhaM; droNaM guruM cha pratipUjya mUrdhnA |
drauNiM kRRipaM chaiva gurU.nshcha sarvA;~nsharairvichitrairabhivAdya chaiva
shlokas.27:
duryodhanasyottamaratnachitraM; chichCheda pArtho mukuTaM shareNa |
Amantrya vIrA.nshcha tathaiva mAnyA;ngANDIvaghoSheNa vinAdya lokAn
shlokas.28:
sa devadattaM sahasA vinAdya; vidArya vIro dviShatAM manA.nsi |
dhvajena sarvAnabhibhUya shatrU;nsa hemajAlena virAjamAnaH
shlokas.29:
dRRiShTvA prayAtA.nstu kurUnkirITI; hRRiShTo.abravIttatra sa matsyaputram |
AvartayAshvAnpashavo jitAste; yAtAH pare yAhi puraM prahRRiShTaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vijitya sa~NgrAme kurUngovRRiShabhekShaNaH |
samAnayAmAsa tadA virATasya dhanaM mahat
shlokas.2:
gateShu cha prabhagneShu dhArtarAShTreShu sarvashaH |
vanAnniShkramya gahanAdbahavaH kurusainikAH
shlokas.3:
bhayAtsantrastamanasaH samAjagmustatastataH |
muktakeshA vyadRRishyanta sthitAH prA~njalayastadA
shlokas.4:
kShutpipAsAparishrAntA videshasthA vichetasaH |
UchuH praNamya sambhrAntAH pArtha kiM karavAma te
shlokas.5:
arjuna uvAcha||
svasti vrajata bhadraM vo na bhetavyaM katha~nchana |
nAhamArtA~njighA.nsAmi bhRRishamAshvAsayAmi vaH
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tAmabhayAM vAchaM shrutvA yodhAH samAgatAH |
AyuHkIrtiyashodAbhistamAshirbhiranandayan
shlokas.7:
tato nivRRittAH kuravaH prabhagnA vashamAsthitAH |
panthAnamupasa~Ngamya phalguno vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.8:
rAjaputra pratyavekSha samAnItAni sarvashaH |
gokulAni mahAbAho vIra gopAlakaiH saha
shlokas.9:
tato.aparAhNe yAsyAmo virATanagaraM prati |
AshvAsya pAyayitvA cha pariplAvya cha vAjinaH
shlokas.10:
gachChantu tvaritAshchaiva gopAlAH preShitAstvayA |
nagare priyamAkhyAtuM ghoShayantu cha te jayam
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
uttarastvaramANo.atha dUtAnAj~nApayattataH |
vachanAdarjunasyaiva AchakShadhvaM jayaM mama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
avajitya dhanaM chApi virATo vAhinIpatiH |
prAvishannagaraM hRRiShTashchaturbhiH saha pANDavaiH
shlokas.2:
jitvA trigartAnsa~NgrAme gAshchaivAdAya kevalAH |
ashobhata mahArAjaH saha pArthaiH shriyA vRRitaH
shlokas.3:
tamAsanagataM vIraM suhRRidAM prItivardhanam |
upatasthuH prakRRitayaH samastA brAhmaNaiH saha
shlokas.4:
sabhAjitaH sasainyastu pratinandyAtha matsyarAT |
visarjayAmAsa tadA dvijA.nshcha prakRRitIstathA
shlokas.5:
tataH sa rAjA matsyAnAM virATo vAhinIpatiH |
uttaraM paripaprachCha kva yAta iti chAbravIt
shlokas.6:
Achakhyustasya saMhRRiShTAH striyaH kanyAshcha veshmani |
antaHpuracharAshchaiva kurubhirgodhanaM hRRitam
shlokas.7:
vijetumabhisa.nrabdha eka evAtisAhasAt |
bRRihannaDAsahAyashcha niryAtaH pRRithivI~njayaH
shlokas.8:
upayAtAnatirathAndroNaM shAntanavaM kRRipam |
karNaM duryodhanaM chaiva droNaputraM cha ShaDrathAn
shlokas.9:
rAjA virATo.atha bhRRishaM prataptaH; shrutvA sutaM hyekarathena yAtam |
bRRihannaDAsArathimAjivardhanaM; provAcha sarvAnatha mantrimukhyAn
shlokas.10:
sarvathA kuravaste hi ye chAnye vasudhAdhipAH |
trigartAnnirjitA~nshrutvA na sthAsyanti kadAchana
shlokas.11:
tasmAdgachChantu me yodhA balena mahatA vRRitAH |
uttarasya parIpsArthaM ye trigartairavikShatAH
shlokas.12:
hayA.nshcha nAgA.nshcha rathA.nshcha shIghraM; padAtisa~NghA.nshcha tataH pravIrAn |
prasthApayAmAsa sutasya heto;rvichitrashastrAbharaNopapannAn
shlokas.13:
evaM sa rAjA matsyAnAM virATo.akShauhiNIpatiH |
vyAdideshAtha tAM kShipraM vAhinIM chatura~NgiNIm
shlokas.14:
kumAramAshu jAnIta yadi jIvati vA na vA |
yasya yantA gataH ShaNDho manye.ahaM na sa jIvati
shlokas.15:
tamabravIddharmarAjaH prahasya; virATamArtaM kurubhiH prataptam |
bRRihannaDA sArathishchennarendra; pare na neShyanti tavAdya gAstAH
shlokas.16:
sarvAnmahIpAnsahitAnkurU.nshcha; tathaiva devAsurayakShanAgAn |
alaM vijetuM samare sutaste; svanuShThitaH sArathinA hi tena
shlokas.17:
athottareNa prahitA dUtAste shIghragAminaH |
virATanagaraM prApya jayamAvedaya.nstadA
shlokas.18:
rAj~nastataH samAchakhyau mantrI vijayamuttamam |
parAjayaM kurUNAM chApyupAyAntaM tathottaram
shlokas.19:
sarvA vinirjitA gAvaH kuravashcha parAjitAH |
uttaraH saha sUtena kushalI cha parantapa
shlokas.20:
ka~Nka uvAcha||
diShTyA te nirjitA gAvaH kuravashcha parAjitAH |
diShTyA te jIvitaH putraH shrUyate pArthivarShabha
shlokas.21:
nAdbhutaM tveva manye.ahaM yatte putro.ajayatkurUn |
dhruva eva jayastasya yasya yantA bRRihannaDA
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato virATo nRRipatiH samprahRRiShTatanUruhaH |
shrutvA tu vijayaM tasya kumArasyAmitaujasaH
AchChAdayitvA dUtA.nstAnmantriNaH so.abhyachodayat
shlokas.23:
rAjamArgAH kriyantAM me patAkAbhirala~NkRRitAH |
puShpopahArairarchyantAM devatAshchApi sarvashaH
shlokas.24:
kumArA yodhamukhyAshcha gaNikAshcha svala~NkRRitAH |
vAditrANi cha sarvANi pratyudyAntu sutaM mama
shlokas.25:
ghaNTApaNavakaH shIghraM mattamAruhya vAraNam |
shRRi~NgATakeShu sarveShu AkhyAtu vijayaM mama
shlokas.26:
uttarA cha kumArIbhirbahvIbhirabhisa.nvRRitA |
shRRi~NgAraveShAbharaNA pratyudyAtu bRRihannaDAm
shlokas.27:
shrutvA tu tadvachanaM pArthivasya; sarve punaH svastikapANayashcha |
bheryashcha tUryANi cha vArijAshcha; veShaiH parArdhyaiH pramadAH shubhAshcha
shlokas.28:
tathaiva sUtAH saha mAgadhaishcha; nandIvAdyAH paNavAstUryavAdyAH |
purAdvirATasya mahAbalasya; pratyudyayuH putramanantavIryam
shlokas.29:
prasthApya senAM kanyAshcha gaNikAshcha svala~NkRRitAH |
matsyarAjo mahAprAj~naH prahRRiShTa idamabravIt
akShAnAhara sairandhri ka~Nka dyUtaM pravartatAm
shlokas.30:
taM tathA vAdinaM dRRiShTvA pANDavaH pratyabhAShata |
na devitavyaM hRRiShTena kitaveneti naH shrutam
shlokas.31:
na tvAmadya mudA yuktamahaM devitumutsahe |
priyaM tu te chikIrShAmi vartatAM yadi manyase
shlokas.32:
virATa uvAcha||
striyo gAvo hiraNyaM cha yachchAnyadvasu ki~nchana |
na me ki~nchittvayA rakShyamantareNApi devitum
shlokas.33:
ka~Nka uvAcha||
kiM te dyUtena rAjendra bahudoSheNa mAnada |
devane bahavo doShAstasmAttatparivarjayet
shlokas.34:
shrutaste yadi vA dRRiShTaH pANDavo vai yudhiShThiraH |
sa rAjyaM sumahatsphItaM bhrAtR^I.nshcha tridashopamAn
shlokas.35:
dyUte hAritavAnsarvaM tasmAddyUtaM na rochaye |
atha vA manyase rAjandIvyAva yadi rochate
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pravartamAne dyUte tu matsyaH pANDavamabravIt |
pashya putreNa me yuddhe tAdRRishAH kuravo jitAH
shlokas.37:
tato.abravInmatsyarAjaM dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
bRRihannaDA yasya yantA kathaM sa na vijeShyati
shlokas.38:
ityuktaH kupito rAjA matsyaH pANDavamabravIt |
samaM putreNa me ShaNDhaM brahmabandho prasha.nsasi
shlokas.39:
vAchyAvAchyaM na jAnIShe nUnaM mAmavamanyase |
bhIShmadroNamukhAnsarvAnkasmAnna sa vijeShyati
shlokas.40:
vayasyatvAttu te brahmannaparAdhamimaM kShame |
nedRRishaM te punarvAchyaM yadi jIvitumichChasi
shlokas.41:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yatra droNastathA bhIShmo drauNirvaikartanaH kRRipaH |
duryodhanashcha rAjendra tathAnye cha mahArathAH
shlokas.42:
marudgaNaiH parivRRitaH sAkShAdapi shatakratuH |
ko.anyo bRRihannaDAyAstAnpratiyudhyeta sa~NgatAn
shlokas.43:
virATa uvAcha||
bahushaH pratiShiddho.asi na cha vAchaM niyachChasi |
niyantA chenna vidyeta na kashchiddharmamAcharet
shlokas.44:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prakupito rAjA tamakSheNAhanadbhRRisham |
mukhe yudhiShThiraM kopAnnaivamityeva bhartsayan
shlokas.45:
balavatpratividdhasya nastaH shoNitamAgamat |
tadaprAptaM mahIM pArthaH pANibhyAM pratyagRRihNata
shlokas.46:
avaikShata cha dharmAtmA draupadIM pArshvataH sthitAm |
sA veda tamabhiprAyaM bhartushchittavashAnugA
shlokas.47:
pUrayitvA cha sauvarNaM pAtraM kA.nsyamaninditA |
tachChoNitaM pratyagRRihNAdyatprasusrAva pANDavAt
shlokas.48:
athottaraH shubhairgandhairmAlyaishcha vividhaistathA |
avakIryamANaH saMhRRiShTo nagaraM svairamAgamat
shlokas.49:
sabhAjyamAnaH pauraishcha strIbhirjAnapadaistathA |
AsAdya bhavanadvAraM pitre sa pratyahArayat
shlokas.50:
tato dvAHsthaH pravishyaiva virATamidamabravIt |
bRRihannaDAsahAyaste putro dvAryuttaraH sthitaH
shlokas.51:
tato hRRiShTo matsyarAjaH kShattAramidamabravIt |
praveshyatAmubhau tUrNaM darshanepsurahaM tayoH
shlokas.52:
kShattAraM kururAjastu shanaiH karNa upAjapat |
uttaraH pravishatveko na praveshyA bRRihannaDA
shlokas.53:
etasya hi mahAbAho vratametatsamAhitam |
yo mamA~Nge vraNaM kuryAchChoNitaM vApi darshayet
anyatra sa~NgrAmagatAnna sa jIvedasa.nshayam
shlokas.54:
na mRRiShyAdbhRRishasa~Nkruddho mAM dRRiShTvaiva sashoNitam |
virATamiha sAmAtyaM hanyAtsabalavAhanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAj~naH suto jyeShThaH prAvishatpRRithivI~njayaH |
so.abhivAdya pituH pAdau dharmarAjamapashyata
shlokas.2:
sa taM rudhirasa.nsiktamanekAgramanAgasam |
bhUmAvAsInamekAnte sairandhryA samupasthitam
shlokas.3:
tataH paprachCha pitaraM tvaramANa ivottaraH |
kenAyaM tADito rAjankena pApamidaM kRRitam
shlokas.4:
virATa uvAcha||
mayAyaM tADito jihmo na chApyetAvadarhati |
prashasyamAne yaH shUre tvayi ShaNDhaM prasha.nsati
shlokas.5:
uttara uvAcha||
akAryaM te kRRitaM rAjankShiprameva prasAdyatAm |
mA tvA brahmaviShaM ghoraM samUlamapi nirdahet
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa putrasya vachaH shrutvA virATo rAShTravardhanaH |
kShamayAmAsa kaunteyaM bhasmachChannamivAnalam
shlokas.7:
kShamayantaM tu rAjAnaM pANDavaH pratyabhAShata |
chiraM kShAntamidaM rAjanna manyurvidyate mama
shlokas.8:
yadi hyetatpatedbhUmau rudhiraM mama nastataH |
sarAShTrastvaM mahArAja vinashyethA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.9:
na dUShayAmi te rAjanyachcha hanyAdadUShakam |
balavantaM mahArAja kShipraM dAruNamApnuyAt
shlokas.10:
shoNite tu vyatikrAnte pravivesha bRRihannaDA |
abhivAdya virATaM cha ka~NkaM chApyupatiShThata
shlokas.11:
kShamayitvA tu kauravyaM raNAduttaramAgatam |
prashasha.nsa tato matsyaH shRRiNvataH savyasAchinaH
shlokas.12:
tvayA dAyAdavAnasmi kaikeyInandivardhana |
tvayA me sadRRishaH putro na bhUto na bhaviShyati
shlokas.13:
padaM padasahasreNa yashcharannAparAdhnuyAt |
tena karNena te tAta kathamAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.14:
manuShyaloke sakale yasya tulyo na vidyate |
yaH samudra ivAkShobhyaH kAlAgniriva duHsahaH
tena bhIShmeNa te tAta kathamAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.15:
AchAryo vRRiShNivIrANAM pANDavAnAM cha yo dvijaH |
sarvakShatrasya chAchAryaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
tena droNena te tAta kathamAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.16:
AchAryaputro yaH shUraH sarvashastrabhRRitAmapi |
ashvatthAmeti vikhyAtaH kathaM tena samAgamaH
shlokas.17:
raNe yaM prekShya sIdanti hRRitasvA vaNijo yathA |
kRRipeNa tena te tAta kathamAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.18:
parvataM yo.abhividhyeta rAjaputro maheShubhiH |
duryodhanena te tAta kathamAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.19:
uttara uvAcha||
na mayA nirjitA gAvo na mayA nirjitAH pare |
kRRitaM tu karma tatsarvaM devaputreNa kenachit
shlokas.20:
sa hi bhItaM dravantaM mAM devaputro nyavArayat |
sa chAtiShThadrathopasthe vajrahastanibho yuvA
shlokas.21:
tena tA nirjitA gAvastena te kuravo jitAH |
tasya tatkarma vIrasya na mayA tAta tatkRRitam
shlokas.22:
sa hi shAradvataM droNaM droNaputraM cha vIryavAn |
sUtaputraM cha bhIShmaM cha chakAra vimukhA~nsharaiH
shlokas.23:
duryodhanaM cha samare sanAgamiva yUthapam |
prabhagnamabravIdbhItaM rAjaputraM mahAbalam
shlokas.24:
na hAstinapure trANaM tava pashyAmi ki~nchana |
vyAyAmena parIpsasva jIvitaM kauravAtmaja
shlokas.25:
na mokShyase palAya.nstvaM rAjanyuddhe manaH kuru |
pRRithivIM bhokShyase jitvA hato vA svargamApsyasi
shlokas.26:
sa nivRRitto naravyAghro mu~nchanvajranibhA~nsharAn |
sachivaiH sa.nvRRito rAjA rathe nAga iva shvasan
shlokas.27:
tatra me romaharSho.abhUdUrustambhashcha mAriSha |
yadabhraghanasa~NkAshamanIkaM vyadhamachCharaiH
shlokas.28:
tatpraNudya rathAnIkaM siMhasaMhanano yuvA |
kurU.nstAnprahasanrAjanvAsA.nsyapaharadbalI
shlokas.29:
ekena tena vIreNa ShaDrathAH parivAritAH |
shArdUleneva mattena mRRigAstRRiNacharA vane
shlokas.30:
virATa uvAcha||
kva sa vIro mahAbAhurdevaputro mahAyashAH |
yo me dhanamavAjaiShItkurubhirgrastamAhave
shlokas.31:
ichChAmi tamahaM draShTumarchituM cha mahAbalam |
yena me tvaM cha gAvashcha rakShitA devasUnunA
shlokas.32:
uttara uvAcha||
antardhAnaM gatastAta devaputraH pratApavAn |
sa tu shvo vA parashvo vA manye prAdurbhaviShyati
shlokas.33:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAkhyAyamAnaM tu ChannaM satreNa pANDavam |
vasantaM tatra nAj~nAsIdvirATaH pArthamarjunam
shlokas.34:
tataH pArtho.abhyanuj~nAto virATena mahAtmanA |
pradadau tAni vAsA.nsi virATaduhituH svayam
shlokas.35:
uttarA tu mahArhANi vividhAni tanUni cha |
pratigRRihyAbhavatprItA tAni vAsA.nsi bhAminI
shlokas.36:
mantrayitvA tu kaunteya uttareNa rahastadA |
itikartavyatAM sarvAM rAjanyatha yudhiShThire
shlokas.37:
tatastathA tadvyadadhAdyathAvatpuruSharShabha |
saha putreNa matsyasya prahRRiShTo bharatarShabhaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastRRitIye divase bhrAtaraH pa~ncha pANDavAH |
snAtAH shuklAmbaradharAH samaye charitavratAH
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThiraM puraskRRitya sarvAbharaNabhUShitAH |
abhipadmA yathA nAgA bhrAjamAnA mahArathAH
shlokas.3:
virATasya sabhAM gatvA bhUmipAlAsaneShvatha |
niSheduH pAvakaprakhyAH sarve dhiShNyeShvivAgnayaH
shlokas.4:
teShu tatropaviShTeShu virATaH pRRithivIpatiH |
AjagAma sabhAM kartuM rAjakAryANi sarvashaH
shlokas.5:
shrImataH pANDavAndRRiShTvA jvalataH pAvakAniva |
atha matsyo.abravItka~NkaM devarUpamavasthitam
marudgaNairupAsInaM tridashAnAmiveshvaram
shlokas.6:
sa kilAkShAtivApastvaM sabhAstAro mayA kRRitaH |
atha rAjAsane kasmAdupaviShTo.asyala~NkRRitaH
shlokas.7:
parihAsepsayA vAkyaM virATasya nishamya tat |
smayamAno.arjuno rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.8:
indrasyApyAsanaM rAjannayamAroDhumarhati |
brahmaNyaH shrutavA.nstyAgI yaj~nashIlo dRRiDhavrataH
shlokas.9:
ayaM kurUNAmRRiShabhaH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
asya kIrtiH sthitA loke sUryasyevodyataH prabhA
shlokas.10:
sa.nsaranti dishaH sarvA yashaso.asya gabhastayaH |
uditasyeva sUryasya tejaso.anu gabhastayaH
shlokas.11:
enaM dasha sahasrANi ku~njarANAM tarasvinAm |
anvayuH pRRiShThato rAjanyAvadadhyAvasatkurUn
shlokas.12:
tri.nshadenaM sahasrANi rathAH kA~nchanamAlinaH |
sadashvairupasampannAH pRRiShThato.anuyayuH sadA
shlokas.13:
enamaShTashatAH sUtAH sumRRiShTamaNikuNDalAH |
astuvanmAgadhaiH sArdhaM purA shakramivarShayaH
shlokas.14:
enaM nityamupAsanta kuravaH ki~NkarA yathA |
sarve cha rAjanrAjAno dhaneshvaramivAmarAH
shlokas.15:
eSha sarvAnmahIpAlAnkaramAhArayattadA |
vaishyAniva mahArAja vivashAnsvavashAnapi
shlokas.16:
aShTAshItisahasrANi snAtakAnAM mahAtmanAm |
upajIvanti rAjAnamenaM sucharitavratam
shlokas.17:
eSha vRRiddhAnanAthA.nshcha vya~NgAnpa~NgU.nshcha mAnavAn |
putravatpAlayAmAsa prajA dharmeNa chAbhibho
shlokas.18:
eSha dharme dame chaiva krodhe chApi yatavrataH |
mahAprasAdo brahmaNyaH satyavAdI cha pArthivaH
shlokas.19:
shrIpratApena chaitasya tapyate sa suyodhanaH |
sagaNaH saha karNena saubalenApi vA vibhuH
shlokas.20:
na shakyante hyasya guNAH prasa~NkhyAtuM nareshvara |
eSha dharmaparo nityamAnRRisha.nsyashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.21:
eva.nyukto mahArAjaH pANDavaH pArthivarShabhaH |
kathaM nArhati rAjArhamAsanaM pRRithivIpatiH

shlokas.1:
virATa uvAcha||
yadyeSha rAjA kauravyaH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
katamo.asyArjuno bhrAtA bhImashcha katamo balI
shlokas.2:
nakulaH sahadevo vA draupadI vA yashasvinI |
yadA dyUte jitAH pArthA na prAj~nAyanta te kvachit
shlokas.3:
arjuna uvAcha||
ya eSha ballavo brUte sUdastava narAdhipa |
eSha bhImo mahAbAhurbhImavegaparAkramaH
shlokas.4:
eSha krodhavashAnhatvA parvate gandhamAdane |
saugandhikAni divyAni kRRiShNArthe samupAharat
shlokas.5:
gandharva eSha vai hantA kIchakAnAM durAtmanAm |
vyAghrAnRRikShAnvarAhA.nshcha hatavAnstrIpure tava
shlokas.6:
yashchAsIdashvabandhaste nakulo.ayaM parantapaH |
gosa~NkhyaH sahadevashcha mAdrIputrau mahArathau
shlokas.7:
shRRi~NgAraveShAbharaNau rUpavantau yashasvinau |
nAnArathasahasrANAM samarthau puruSharShabhau
shlokas.8:
eShA padmapalAshAkShI sumadhyA chAruhAsinI |
sairandhrI draupadI rAjanyatkRRite kIchakA hatAH
shlokas.9:
arjuno.ahaM mahArAja vyaktaM te shrotramAgataH |
bhImAdavarajaH pArtho yamAbhyAM chApi pUrvajaH
shlokas.10:
uShitAH sma mahArAja sukhaM tava niveshane |
aj~nAtavAsamuShitA garbhavAsa iva prajAH
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yadArjunena te vIrAH kathitAH pa~ncha pANDavAH |
tadArjunasya vairATiH kathayAmAsa vikramam
shlokas.12:
ayaM sa dviShatAM madhye mRRigANAmiva kesarI |
acharadrathavRRindeShu nighna.nsteShAM varAnvarAn
shlokas.13:
anena viddho mAta~Ngo mahAnekeShuNA hataH |
hiraNyakakShyaH sa~NgrAme dantAbhyAmagamanmahIm
shlokas.14:
anena vijitA gAvo jitAshcha kuravo yudhi |
asya sha~NkhapraNAdena karNau me badhirIkRRitau
shlokas.15:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA matsyarAjaH pratApavAn |
uttaraM pratyuvAchedamabhipanno yudhiShThire
shlokas.16:
prasAdanaM pANDavasya prAptakAlaM hi rochaye |
uttarAM cha prayachChAmi pArthAya yadi te matam
shlokas.17:
uttara uvAcha||
archyAH pUjyAshcha mAnyAshcha prAptakAlaM cha me matam |
pUjyantAM pUjanArhAshcha mahAbhAgAshcha pANDavAH
shlokas.18:
virATa uvAcha||
ahaM khalvapi sa~NgrAme shatrUNAM vashamAgataH |
mokShito bhImasenena gAvashcha vijitAstathA
shlokas.19:
eteShAM bAhuvIryeNa yadasmAkaM jayo mRRidhe |
vayaM sarve sahAmAtyAH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
prasAdayAmo bhadraM te sAnujaM pANDavarShabham
shlokas.20:
yadasmAbhirajAnadbhiH ki~nchidukto narAdhipaH |
kShantumarhati tatsarvaM dharmAtmA hyeSha pANDavaH
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato virATaH paramAbhituShTaH; sametya rAj~nA samayaM chakAra |
rAjyaM cha sarvaM visasarja tasmai; sadaNDakoshaM sapuraM mahAtmA
shlokas.22:
pANDavA.nshcha tataH sarvAnmatsyarAjaH pratApavAn |
dhana~njayaM puraskRRitya diShTyA diShTyeti chAbravIt
shlokas.23:
samupAghrAya mUrdhAnaM sa.nshliShya cha punaH punaH |
yudhiShThiraM cha bhImaM cha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.24:
nAtRRipyaddarshane teShAM virATo vAhinIpatiH |
samprIyamANo rAjAnaM yudhiShThiramathAbravIt
shlokas.25:
diShTyA bhavantaH samprAptAH sarve kushalino vanAt |
diShTyA cha pAritaM kRRichChramaj~nAtaM vai durAtmabhiH
shlokas.26:
idaM cha rAjyaM naH pArthA yachchAnyadvasu ki~nchana |
pratigRRihNantu tatsarvaM kaunteyA avisha~NkayA
shlokas.27:
uttarAM pratigRRihNAtu savyasAchI dhana~njayaH |
ayaM hyaupayiko bhartA tasyAH puruShasattamaH
shlokas.28:
evamukto dharmarAjaH pArthamaikShaddhana~njayam |
IkShitashchArjuno bhrAtrA matsyaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.29:
pratigRRihNAmyahaM rAjansnuShAM duhitaraM tava |
yuktashchAvAM hi sambandho matsyabhAratasattamau

shlokas.1:
virATa uvAcha||
kimarthaM pANDavashreShTha bhAryAM duhitaraM mama |
pratigrahItuM nemAM tvaM mayA dattAmihechChasi
shlokas.2:
arjuna uvAcha||
antaHpure.ahamuShitaH sadA pashyansutAM tava |
rahasyaM cha prakAshaM cha vishvastA pitRRivanmayi
shlokas.3:
priyo bahumatashchAhaM nartako gItakovidaH |
AchAryavachcha mAM nityaM manyate duhitA tava
shlokas.4:
vayaHsthayA tayA rAjansaha sa.nvatsaroShitaH |
atisha~NkA bhavetsthAne tava lokasya chAbhibho
shlokas.5:
tasmAnnimantraye tvAhaM duhituH pRRithivIpate |
shuddho jitendriyo dAntastasyAH shuddhiH kRRitA mayA
shlokas.6:
snuShAyA duhiturvApi putre chAtmani vA punaH |
atra sha~NkAM na pashyAmi tena shuddhirbhaviShyati
shlokas.7:
abhiSha~NgAdahaM bhIto mithyAchArAtparantapa |
snuShArthamuttarAM rAjanpratigRRihNAmi te sutAm
shlokas.8:
svasrIyo vAsudevasya sAkShAddevashishuryathA |
dayitashchakrahastasya bAla evAstrakovidaH
shlokas.9:
abhimanyurmahAbAhuH putro mama vishAM pate |
jAmAtA tava yukto vai bhartA cha duhitustava
shlokas.10:
virATa uvAcha||
upapannaM kurushreShThe kuntIputre dhana~njaye |
ya evaM dharmanityashcha jAtaj~nAnashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.11:
yatkRRityaM manyase pArtha kriyatAM tadanantaram |
sarve kAmAH samRRiddhA me sambandhI yasya me.arjunaH
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bruvati rAjendre kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
anvajAnAtsa sa.nyogaM samaye matsyapArthayoH
shlokas.13:
tato mitreShu sarveShu vAsudeve cha bhArata |
preShayAmAsa kaunteyo virATashcha mahIpatiH
shlokas.14:
tatastrayodashe varShe nivRRitte pa~ncha pANDavAH |
upaplavye virATasya samapadyanta sarvashaH
shlokas.15:
tasminvasa.nshcha bIbhatsurAninAya janArdanam |
Anartebhyo.api dAshArhAnabhimanyuM cha pANDavaH
shlokas.16:
kAshirAjashcha shaibyashcha prIyamANau yudhiShThire |
akShauhiNIbhyAM sahitAvAgatau pRRithivIpate
shlokas.17:
akShauhiNyA cha tejasvI yaj~naseno mahAbalaH |
draupadyAshcha sutA vIrAH shikhaNDI chAparAjitaH
shlokas.18:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha durdharShaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
samastAkShauhiNIpAlA yajvAno bhUridakShiNAH
sarve shastrAstrasampannAH sarve shUrAstanutyajaH
shlokas.19:
tAnAgatAnabhiprekShya matsyo dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
prIto.abhavadduhitaraM dattvA tAmabhimanyave
shlokas.20:
tataH pratyupayAteShu pArthiveShu tatastataH |
tatrAgamadvAsudevo vanamAlI halAyudhaH
kRRitavarmA cha hArdikyo yuyudhAnashcha sAtyakiH
shlokas.21:
anAdhRRiShTistathAkrUraH sAmbo nishaTha eva cha |
abhimanyumupAdAya saha mAtrA parantapAH
shlokas.22:
indrasenAdayashchaiva rathaistaiH susamAhitaiH |
AyayuH sahitAH sarve parisa.nvatsaroShitAH
shlokas.23:
dasha nAgasahasrANi hayAnAM cha shatAyutam |
rathAnAmarbudaM pUrNaM nikharvaM cha padAtinAm
shlokas.24:
vRRiShNyandhakAshcha bahavo bhojAshcha paramaujasaH |
anvayurvRRiShNishArdUlaM vAsudevaM mahAdyutim
shlokas.25:
pAribarhaM dadau kRRiShNaH pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
striyo ratnAni vAsA.nsi pRRithakpRRithaganekashaH
tato vivAho vidhivadvavRRite matsyapArthayoH
shlokas.26:
tataH sha~NkhAshcha bheryashcha gomukhADambarAstathA |
pArthaiH sa.nyujyamAnasya nedurmatsyasya veshmani
shlokas.27:
uchchAvachAnmRRigA~njaghnurmedhyA.nshcha shatashaH pashUn |
surAmaireyapAnAni prabhUtAnyabhyahArayan
shlokas.28:
gAyanAkhyAnashIlAshcha naTA vaitAlikAstathA |
stuvantastAnupAtiShThansUtAshcha saha mAgadhaiH
shlokas.29:
sudeShNAM cha puraskRRitya matsyAnAM cha varastriyaH |
AjagmushchArusarvA~NgyaH sumRRiShTamaNikuNDalAH
shlokas.30:
varNopapannAstA nAryo rUpavatyaH svala~NkRRitAH |
sarvAshchAbhyabhavatkRRiShNA rUpeNa yashasA shriyA
shlokas.31:
parivAryottarAM tAstu rAjaputrImala~NkRRitAm |
sutAmiva mahendrasya puraskRRityopatasthire
shlokas.32:
tAM pratyagRRihNAtkaunteyaH sutasyArthe dhana~njayaH |
saubhadrasyAnavadyA~NgIM virATatanayAM tadA
shlokas.33:
tatrAtiShThanmahArAjo rUpamindrasya dhArayan |
snuShAM tAM pratijagrAha kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.34:
pratigRRihya cha tAM pArthaH puraskRRitya janArdanam |
vivAhaM kArayAmAsa saubhadrasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.35:
tasmai sapta sahasrANi hayAnAM vAtaraMhasAm |
dve cha nAgashate mukhye prAdAdbahu dhanaM tadA
shlokas.36:
kRRite vivAhe tu tadA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
brAhmaNebhyo dadau vittaM yadupAharadachyutaH
shlokas.37:
gosahasrANi ratnAni vastrANi vividhAni cha |
bhUShaNAni cha mukhyAni yAnAni shayanAni cha
shlokas.38:
tanmahotsavasa~NkAshaM hRRiShTapuShTajanAvRRitam |
nagaraM matsyarAjasya shushubhe bharatarShabha
